Kahit masakit, I told myself na okay na ako sa ganito knowing na I’ll drown with the thought na di mo ako kaya panindigan. Words do really hurt more than actions, kahit di mo ako kausapin kasi di ka pa okay, kahit di mo ako pansinin, I was okay with it cause it helped you but I completely lost it when you said you were in doubt of us. I lost myself when you told me that you dont have plans on seeing me in your future anymore kasi di mo kaya. It wasn’t just a normal breakdown when I couldn’t stop crying. Normally I’m able to compose my emotions but at that time, I guess I felt so small na di kaya ipaglaban even if given all the chances to. I know I dont seem like it but I was so sad to the point nothing mattered to me anymore. it didnt matter to me na hanggang dito lang tayo. it didnt matter to me na hanggang pangarap nalang yung mga sinasabi natin na we’d share one roof someday, na we wont need to say goodbyes anymore. It all became a fantasy I ended up referring as just a dream in the end. What did I expect? I’m the one stupid for actually believing it would be possible. I felt so worthless in every possible way but I couldn’t tell you that cause alam ko mas natakot ako mawala ka. We’ll find our way back to each other? You can hope for it but dont tell me that if I really am the one, hahanapin lang natin ang isa’t isa cause no. I know you’ll take that as a discouragement but you should open your eyes cause that’s just something you should be ready for. I do care about you, fixing us? not working out? I understand the part na you’re scared but I hope you understood that it was hard on my end as the one between us that doesn’t have a choice but to accept it. Unexpectedly getting back together is impossible, this is not a work of fate, it’s an act of risk. bahwa hingga hari ini, aku masih menyebut namanya dalam hatiku.

tapi untuk tetap memberi ruang bagi sesuatu yang pernah begitu bermakna.

ada bagian dalam diriku yang diam-diam masih ingin dia tahu:

bahwa aku masih mengingat caranya mengelus kepalaku saat aku nyaris tertidur di kelas,
bagaimana dia menyebut namaku dengan nada ringan: “Zhik…”

bahwa aku gak butuh dia sempurna.

bahwa aku gak takut dia akan menyakitiku lagi.
Aku lebih takut dia gak akan pernah kembali.
Dan aku lebih takut aku akan menyakitinya lagi.
Aku tahu risikonya. Aku tahu ketakutannya.
Tapi aku juga tahu, cinta itu tentang tumbuh, bukan tentang sempurna.
Dan aku mau tumbuh bersamanya, jika masih ada kesempatan.

Jika dia tahu…
bahwa meskipun dia berharap aku menemukan cinta baru,
hatiku masih berharap dia lah yang akan pulang dan mengisi ruang yang tak pernah benar-benar ditempati siapa pun setelah dia pergi.

Jika dia tahu semua ini,
mungkin dia gak akan kembali.
Atau mungkin dia akan diam saja.
Tapi gak apa-apa…
karena bagiku, cukup jika dia tahu.

I always asked myself why you couldn’t just stay away from her. I know you two were friends for a long time, but I never understood why that still matters to you so much. You were never in a relationship with her, so I kept telling myself I shouldn’t be bothered. I tried so hard to accept it. I even wanted to be her friend too. She’s pretty. She’s smart. She’s kind. She’s the kind of girl everyone likes. I looked at her and thought, maybe we could be friends. Maybe she’s not the problem.

But I kept asking you to set boundaries. You told me you would. And for a while, you did. But then suddenly, you were talking to her again like nothing happened. Like everything I asked didn’t matter. And it was never her who started talking again. It was always you. You were always the one who messaged her. You were always the one who couldn’t let go.

I even talked to her. She explained things clearly. She said you were just friends. She even unfriended you on Facebook and stayed away. She did that for me. Because she respected me. Because she saw how uncomfortable I was. She knew how I felt. And she did something about it. Meanwhile, you couldn’t even do that one thing I kept asking you to do.

Maybe you stayed away for a while. But then we broke up for a different reason. And the first thing you did was run back to her. You messaged her. You ranted to her. You became close again. And the same thing happened in your other relationships, didn’t it? When things went bad, you always went back to her. 

You even talked to her about our fights. That hurts more than anything. Because you never really talked to me. You never really opened up to me like that. You’d rather talk to her about your problems with me instead of talking to me. And that says a lot.

You probably think I’m crazy for still checking on her, for still thinking about all of this. But the truth is, I’m more obsessed with her than I ever was with you. I don’t even think about you anymore. I just keep comparing myself to her. Even when I know there's nothing going on between you two now. Even when I know she doesn’t like you. Or maybe she does. I don’t know. I just know that you liked her before. You waited for her, but she got into a relationship, so you never had the chance to tell her how you felt.

And maybe you still love her. Somewhere deep inside you, maybe the feelings never went away. Maybe that’s why you always go back to her. Maybe she likes you too, even just a little bit. But I can’t blame her for that. She was kind to me. She had the decency to step away when you couldn’t.

That’s what hurts the most. She didn’t even owe me anything. But she respected me more than you ever did.

Hi, it's been 5 days since I last opened this web. This is my first message, and as I'm writing this, I haven't searched for any messages/initials from the past 5 days.
I didn’t open it because I was incredibly busy but now I’m planning to stop opening it for good. Honestly, these past 5 days felt like I got my life back, I got my sleep back.
 
I’ve been on this site for months, and during that time, my sleep schedule was a mess. I don’t know why, but I became so addicted to checking every initial from A to Z, every name, staying up until midnight, even though I used to be asleep by 9 PM.

In the past months, I missed out on 3 really important opportunities just because I was too busy scrolling through this anonymous site instead of regularly checking my own email. So I guess I really need to stop being on this site for good.

It’ll break my heart to leave this site, because it means letting go of the only way I might still hear about you.

I do miss you, but I realize that what I need to focus on is my real life. I need to live in the present, in the real world. I can’t keep losing myself, drowning in daydreams and what-ifs.

You should move forward with your life too. Be happy with whoever you're with now, and whoever will be by your side in the future. I genuinely wish you all the best in life. Dear Zech,

I’m writing this letter not because you asked me to write again, but because I’ve been meaning to say what I truly feel in the most honest and sincere way.

I know things between us have been rocky lately. We’ve been on and off, and sometimes, nights end in negativity that makes it hard to sleep. The promises we once made, like never going to bed with a heavy heart, feel like they’ve been broken—and that hurts.

First, I want to say I’m deeply sorry.
I’m sorry for my immaturity, for moments when I just wanted to be understood instead of trying harder to understand you.
But I swear, I do try. I always try to understand you.
I’m sorry for the times I’ve hurt you.
I’m sorry if I often seem mad, annoyed, or distant.
I’m sorry for running away when things get difficult.

I always believed you were my home, so why do I keep running away from the one person I consider my safe place? That thought breaks me. Because despite everything, I still want you to be my home. A place where I can just be me. A place where I feel sure. But if I’m being completely honest, I’ve been struggling in our relationship lately. And I know you are too.

Even though we don’t want things to be like this, maybe this season is just part of our journey. Still, my love for you hasn’t changed. It never will. Losing you would feel like losing a part of myself. The thought of you not being by my side feels like that painful moment when you try so hard not to cry that your throat aches. Losing you would feel like the heartbreak I felt when I lost Roru. That was when I realized just how special you are to me.

It drowns me to even imagine you being gone. I don’t want to lose you—not even for a second. It would feel like losing my other half. The dreams and promises we made would haunt me if you were no longer part of my life. I still keep your sweater with me whenever we argue or when I miss you. And it helps that we wear the same perfume. It makes me feel like you’re still near.

I’m telling you all of this not to make you feel guilty, but to let you know how deeply I love you, and how painful it would be to see you happy without me. I will always try my best to be better—for us. I don’t want you to go. But if you are tired or if you feel like you’re losing yourself, please tell me. I will understand.

Earlier, I prayed to God. I asked Him that if you are not meant for me, then I hope He removes you from my life—because I don’t want us to keep hurting. But I also asked Him if I could keep you forever. I prayed that He allows us to love each other until our very last breath. That He helps us through everything. You are the only one I have. I know that you are a blessing because Go gave me you when i had nothing. 

I love you, Zech. I really do.
That’s why I want to take care of you.
Because I cannot imagine living without you by my side.

I've read the message you wrote under my name—or what I'm assuming to be mine. I admit I was late reading it, but the effects doesn't come in time. I never shoul have checked, I refused using internet for days the day I saw your repost about what I also assumed dedicated to me. I knew it was my fault for keeping myself updated for something new, considering that we both decided to cut ties, and connection. But I couldn't help but wonder what's on your mind, perhaps It is not necessary to know anymore. My heart sank reading what you wrote, for the first time I've read something from you after waiting for so long. I love that website, I feel safe there, it is the only place where i can write for you and hope you'd check. I always check if there was something for me too, praying that you'd write me one as a response but nothing ever came. My hope lingers everywhere, waiting, and anticipating, doubting your mind games and expect the most possible situation. I thought if I check once again I'll feel the same old feeling of hurt, but this time it was more painful because my prayers were answered and ironically I seem to regret what I wished for because now the night is nothing but anguish. 

I love and hate the reference you used, I wonder if it's on purpose. 10 things you hate about me. How clever, you seem to know very well just how to break me. Your message made me understand things in your perspective, but I don't wanna unravel the depth of uneasiness and hatred you have for me. At first, I was full of rage and despair, like the day Allie Hamilton found out that Noah actually write for her after she waited for years and years, believing he doesn't think of her or even thought of writing for her. But this is not it, not The Notebook and definitely not 10 things I hate about you. If you think about it, it is way more horror than 500 days of summer. 

I am left to wonder what made you write for me, and if you only did it because I write for you. Reciprocation is nice but not without intentions. 

I think this will be the last thing I'll write for you in here, I understand that you hate when I still think of you and write about you so I must not let it happen again. 

But I will tell you for the last time that our friendship is a treasure to me, a movie that isn't available on my TV, a poem I wish I wrote, and a unfinished song rotting in my bedroom 

I found solace in a danger that awaits.  Sold my heart and soul for a wandering eyes, and someone not quite tall but had it all.

You walk in when I couldn't find a way out, you stayed in times I find staying as daunting. And when the night becomes suffocating you always make sure I will not sleep lost in despair. You answered my misery—a mystery you feel hopefull for. You learned the answers for me yet I despised your wisdom, your philosophical answers or just the truth that you know me, even behind hundreds of damaged walls

I no longer find the dark hours horrifying nor agonizing when it comes to talking to the moon—you loved the moon, I've done the same. You turned the night into something beautiful, by simply being awake in an abandoned night. 

You remarked that there is something that runs between us, thicker than any blood, and stronger than any bond. We were inseparable, and that was all it took. You are someone I looked up to, like the sky on a sunday day, full of hope and promises. 

In your companion I first felt the refuge in the world of masculinity, I had hoped that all men that I knew would be like you in the next morning. They will have hair as soft as the clouds, a smile that is as beautiful as a gem, and a soul as colorful and bright. You are a dreamboat, a vision and a pearl of wisdom.

But I cannot live longer,  admiring every little thing about you. 

I loved you, truly. You are my bestfriend and you still are, even when you told me you no longer want me as your bestfriend. That day of confrontation at the library was the day I knew you would leave me someday but I cried and hoped you'd change your mind, but I guess I can't change you for who you are. 

You always knew just how I hated my mom, you were the only person I entrusted with my family situation and my feelings. You knew how much I've cried for her, how much I despise her for her selfishness and how I long for her every night like a sickness growing wild. 

You knew how she changed me, how she made my life miserable and how I live my day believing every person that I love will leave just because my own mother did not find motives to stay. And I was right, but I don't blame you any ditress, for all of it was mine and most of them I caused. My desperation for happiness comes daunting, the thought of waiting is a pill I also can't swallow. I pray you get the life you always dreamed of. I aspire myself to be better for my well-being.

don’t know how to measure the depth of what I feel for you—no compass, no map, no clock could ever capture it. It’s something far greater than words, and yet here I am, trying to weave it into this letter, hoping you might feel a whisper of the love I carry in my chest.

Loving you is not something I chose—it simply happened, like the way the sky turns golden at dusk, or the way the ocean kisses the shore again and again, never tired, never doubting. It’s natural. It’s constant. It’s infinite.

I love you with a quiet kind of certainty, the sort that doesn’t shout or demand, but stays, even when everything else fades. Even if the seasons shift, even if years stretch on, even if your path leads you somewhere far from mine—i'll still be here. Waiting.

Time means nothing when it comes to you. I would wait a lifetime if i must. A thousand lifetimes, if that’s what it takes. Because loving you is not about conditions or timelines—it’s about faith. It’s about hope. It’s about believing that some hearts are meant to meet again, no matter how long it takes.

You are my calm in chaos, my softness in a world that can be cruel, my reason to keep holding on. And though we may be walking different roads right now, every step i take is with you in my heart.

So, dwi, if ever you feel alone, if ever you forget how much you are loved—remember this: there’s someone out there who would cross time, space, and sorrow just to see you smile. And that someone is me.

I love you. And i’ll wait for you, no matter how long. Always.

With all my heart,
Yours, endlessly.

There's a saying that even if two people live in the same town, or even go to the same school, if they’re not meant to be, they’ll never end up together again. And they'll never see each other again. Maybe that’s true. But I’ve always believed that some things don’t have to follow that idea. No matter the distance or the time, I always seem to come across you somehow. Not because I try to, but because life just finds a way to remind me. We broke up a long time ago. Since then, I’ve seen so many versions of you. I’ve seen you change and grow. I’ve seen you in other relationships. I’ve seen your wins and your struggles. I remember the nights when everything was heavy for you, especially with your family. When you felt like everything was too much. You looked so tired, like you just wanted to escape it all. And even if I couldn’t do anything, I remember those times clearly.

I also saw you fall in love again. I saw how much you liked him. I saw how he took care of you and how he did everything I failed to do. I won’t act like I didn’t notice it. He gave you the safety and comfort I couldn’t give, and that hurt. But I get it. He made you feel like you were enough. And that’s something I should’ve done.

I noticed how you changed too. You’re more calm now. Your hair’s longer like you always wanted it to be. Back then, you’d always talk about growing it out, but you never really got the chance to. Now you have it, and you look so happy with it. You look more at peace.

I saw how hard you worked. I saw the stress, the breakdowns, and everything in between. But I also saw you make it. You got into the university you always talked about. The one you dreamed of for so long. And I’m genuinely proud of you.

You’re doing things now that you used to only hope for. And I wish I could tell you that I’m happy for you face-to-face. But I know I don’t have a place in your life anymore. That’s okay. I just needed to say this. You’ve come so far. You’re doing great. I messed up, and I lost you. But even with everything, you’re still one of the most important people that ever walked into my life. And I won’t ever deny that.

I don't know where to begin, but maybe I should start with the truth, I still think about you.

You were never just a passing moment. You were a season in my life that felt like home. You were that almost, that what-if, that "we could’ve." From the very start, I felt something different with you. We matched in ways I couldn’t explain—our jokes, our energy, even the silence between us had chemistry. We were always teased like we were already something. And maybe we were, just not officially.

Remember how I told you I'd make you a ring from my guitar string? I never got to give it to you. You ended up with a real ring—one that someone else gave you. I'm happy for you, really... but I’d be lying if I said it didn’t sting.

We shared secrets no one else knew. You stayed up late like me. We were always in sync—same games, same widgets, same timing. Like the universe was playing with us. It always rained when something significant happened: after I confessed, after our last kiss, even during my dream. Always after the rain.

And about that—our kiss? The one at school, quick like the wind. And the last one? At your place. It wasn't perfect, but it was real. For two people who didn’t know much about kissing, we made it feel like something. Something worth remembering.

But I let go. I walked away. I said it's better if we’re just friends. Maybe I was scared, maybe I wasn’t ready. Maybe I was already too deep in something else and I forced myself to move on, even if I hadn’t.

And now here we are—still in the same circle, still sharing little moments, still pretending. You grabbed my hand the other day, just like in my dream. Three fingers. A second of contact. Then you pulled away.

You're in a relationship now. So am I. But I see you, I feel these signs, and I can’t tell if it’s coincidence or destiny. And yet, you said you don’t want to talk about the past. So I stay quiet. I act like I’ve moved on. I act like I’m okay.

But the truth is…
I still wonder.
I still miss the idea of you.
I still hold guilt for not choosing you when I had the chance.
You were patient, ready to give it all. I wasn’t. And that’s on me.

Now, you give chocolates and wear rings from someone else. Now, I distance myself to not make things worse. I tell myself you're happier now. Maybe that's the only thing that matters.

But in another life, in another version of us, maybe I don’t walk away. Maybe I give you that ring. Maybe we kiss without the weight of goodbye.

If I could tell you everything, I’d say:
It wasn’t just a phase.
You mattered.
And I still carry pieces of you with me.

Wherever you are right now, I hope you will receive my message.

Hi Rapha, it's ate. First off, I just want to say sorry for all my lacking actions when it comes to fulfilling the responsibility of being your big sister. Ate is sorry because she couldn't give you more support and attention. I regret not spending more time with you now that you've passed away. If we were given another chance in life, I would for sure prioritize our brother/sister relationship. 

Wherever you are, I hope you are well and free from all the pain.

Rapha, sorry dahil hindi kita nabigyan ng rason para lumapit sakin at kausapin ako tungkol sa mga problema mo at sa celebrations mo. Not once have I ever asked how your day went.

How was school?
Are you getting along well with your other classmates?
Is everything okay?

I want to ask you that right now. I miss you, I miss everything about you.

You're my brother, my duo, my only kakampi, my kasama sa fam gatherings, my ka-jamming, my talented little brother. You give inspiration and important feedbacks to my daily life that I only realized today.

Miss na kita Raphaaaaa, sorry dahil tumanggi ako na makipaglaro sayo, sorry hindi kita nasamahan mag-enroll. I'm so sorry.. I wasn't there for you.

Gusto kitang makita, maka-usap, at bigyan ng mahigpit na yakap. Living without you feels suffocating. Lahat ng plano ko ay kasama ka. Magiging succesful pa ako para maging suporta sayo in the future. I wanted to be a big sister that you can rely on. Unti-unti ko yun nafufulfill kapag nililibre kita. Naiisip ko palagi na bigyan ka ng pasalubong - pagkain sa manila na normally hindi mo nakikita sa SJDM. Lalo na ng 24 Chicken, dahil alam ko kung gaano mo kafavorite ang pritong manok.

You are the main reason why I come home to SJDM. I'm sorry for forgetting that, i'm sorry.

I miss you so bad.
 
I will continue to pray for you and your soul. I love you rapatitong, wag ka na magcringe kasi minimean ko lahat ng nakasulat dito.

I'm sorry for being the worse sister you ever had. If I were given a chance to live another life, I would still choose to be your sister and sa life na yun, sisiguraduhing kong alam mo at aware kang may nagmamahal sayo.

Sincerely,
Reziel Noelline Erese

You deserved honesty, not silence.This isn’t me asking for anything. I just wanted you to know the truth. I’m sorry for vanishing without an explanation. Earlier… I realized something strange—I don’t really eat lunch anymore. Not because I’m not hungry, but because ever since that day, food just doesn’t feel the same. I was always alone eating, day after day, sitting quietly with no one beside me. I had gotten used to it, numb to the silence. But then you… you invited me to eat lunch with you. It was so simple, yet it meant the world to me.

You probably didn’t think much of it—just a kind, casual offer from a friend. But for me, it was a moment that broke through the loneliness I didn’t even know was weighing me down. And in that moment, something inside me changed. I realized… I was falling in love with you.

I tried to keep my cool, to act like it was nothing, but I couldn’t even hold a proper conversation. I was so shy—stuttering over every word, heart pounding, hands fidgeting—because being near you made everything feel so intense and real. You brought color into something that used to be so dull.

But please… don’t feel like you have to return these feelings. I know I’m not the type of person someone like you would fall for. You’re strong, kind, and full of light—and I’m just someone quietly admiring you from a safe distance.

That’s why I’ve made a silent promise to myself: I won’t give you hints. I won’t try to make you notice. Because our friendship means more to me than anything my heart feels. And if keeping these feelings hidden is what it takes to protect what we have, then I’ll gladly carry them alone.

You made me feel seen, even just for a moment—and that moment changed everything.

Thank you for always being by my side—for being the girl who looks out for me like a mom, with so much care, patience, and understanding. I may not say it often, but I truly owe you more than I can ever explain. You’ve been my comfort, my safe place, and sometimes even the strength I didn’t know I needed.

Salamat, Ma.

message:
to you, whom i once secretly liked,

i'm not writing this to make you realize anything, nor do i expect a reply. i'm writing this because i'm tired of keeping everything to myself.

you might not know, or you might know but pretend not to care. i don't know which hurts more: your ignorance or your seemingly casual attitude. i once loved you, even if it was silently, even if i was embarrassed, and even if it was only from afar.

i once believed your songs touched a part of my heart. i thought you understood me or at least realized i was there. but after a while, i realized it wasn't me you were looking for. and that's okay.

i just want to stop hoping.
i want to stop waiting for something that won't come.
i don't want to hurt myself by thinking about you anymore.

because i deserve to be loved back.
i deserve to be loved without having to guess.
i deserve someone who doesn't just like making me upset but also knows how to protect my heart.

thank you for making me feel nervous, jealous, and harboring little hopes.
but i have to say goodbye to all of that.

starting today, i won't look for you in songs anymore.
i won't look for your name in other people's stories.
i won't pretend to be strong anymore, hoping you'll realize.

congratulations on moving on with your life.
i will also start going back to my life—without you in it.

from me,
who finally learned to stop,
not because i don't love you,
but because i know you don't belong here.

few days ago, i came across a message while searching my name and it felt too personal, as if it was written about us. it brought back memories i’ve been trying to bury. but i don’t even know if you were the one who wrote it or i was just assuming things again. but regardless who wrote it naman na, i know you have someone else you’re surely willing to take the risk for. and this will be the last time i’m writing letters you had the POSSIBILITY to read.

i remember seeing that message around june 13, and the first thing that crossed my mind was to reach out to you even though i wasn’t sure if it was really from you. i assume things by thinking that maybe you were trying to say something without directly saying it, but if it really came from you, i guess you weren’t telling the truth. not because i don’t believe you, but because your actions showed otherwise. buti nalang hindi ko tinuloy, i had so many questions running through my mind. what if i contacted you again? would anything really change? or would we just fall back into the same painful cycle we always do? the same cycle where one of us ends up broken, and that someone is always me. every time i think about breaking the silence between us, i remember how exhausting it was to love someone who constantly walked away. i’m really sorry po. i think my love for you was so overwhelming that instead of bringing us closer, it scared you away, or maybe you never really wanted to stay in the first place. i used to think you were being unfair, because every time you came back, i was the one left hanging. i was always the one who tried and waited, even though you were the one who always came back. bumabalik ka ba because you truly wanted to? o dahil alam mong kahit anong mangyari hindi magbabago ang pagtanggap ko sa’yo? we both know i was never capable of turning you away. 

so please, jed, don’t reach out to me again unless you are absolutely sure about what you want from me. don’t contact me unless you’re ready to choose us and stay through everything. please, don’t get me wrong, jed. i still love you. i still find myself searching for your presence in a room full of people. i still want to gaze into your eyes and hold you whenever you need someone. i don’t want to love anyone else the way i love you. and honestly, i feel genuinely happy whenever you reach out because that’s all i ever wanted, to feel like you still cared. we both know i was never strong enough to ignore you. but now i’m scared. i don’t want to feel or see you losing interest in me again. that’s how it feels whenever you ghost me, and it hurts more than i can ever explain. i don’t think i can handle that anymore. i’m tired of rebuilding myself over and over again just to be shattered once more. i was just protecting myself but it didn't changed the fact that i deeply love everything about you. 

i saw your instagram notes about him. it hurt for a while, but seeing that you’ve finally found someone you’re willing to take the risk for and someone you’re ready to choose the way i always chose you. the peace is louder now. not for me, but for you. i’m genuinely happy for you, jed. i truly hope he gives you the love you’ve always deserved, the kind of love that never makes you feel the need to run or hide. 

and maybe someday, you’ll come across all the letters i’ve written for you, the ones i never had the courage to send. maybe one day, you’ll finally understand the kind of love i carried for you over the past six years. don’t give me even the smallest bit of attention if you want me to move on from you. and honestly, that’s what you’ve been doing at school anyway and it hurts so so much. malapit ka nga sa'kin, ramdam ko naman na wala na ikaw pake kaya siguro i’m starting to think of letting you go, and i think that’s the hardest part, kasi ayaw kong malimutan ang pakiramdam kung paano ang mahalin ka but i owe myself the chance to heal for something i’ve never really had. i’ll continue cheering you on quietly from a distance, hoping you heal from everything that’s been holding you back from real happiness. keep being the amazing person i’ve always admired, jed. i love you.

i don’t really know how to explain it but reading what you wrote after waking up from a drunk head and playing wither on. i felt it even more. like a bruise i forgot i had. it felt like someone i used to love softly knocking again not to come back but just to remind me they existed. and i think that’s what hurt the most. and i think that's what's keeping us hurting till now. your words reminded me of past life by ariana. with its line, “maybe in a past life, i was yours and you were mine.” because that's how it felt. like something that existed in a different version of time. deep, wordless, unfinished.
maybe we met from the past cause we are not the future. maybe we were never meant to last, just to leave something behind in each other that we’d carry forward quietly. but what really hit me was the line, “always wonder what would happen if i let you lose me.” because that’s what haunts me every single time. like... if i had let you let go of me. if i had stepped back instead of holding steady when you leaned in with your silence, with your grief. would that have made it easier? or would it have just made us strangers with heavy hearts and no memory to return to? i think we both kept showing up without ever really saying it. and when things end without a goodbye they never really feel like they’re over. they just hang there. and no matter how far you get, something always pulls you back to the version of you that existed with them. because you can’t forget it. not the red shirt.
not the weight of my head on your shoulder. not the quiet love you gave without asking for anything in return. we don’t always get closure. sometimes, we just keep circling the same memory until it fades enough to stop hurting but never enough to disappear. maybe that’s what love is sometimes. not forever. just a safe place someone can fall into, even if only for a season. and maybe that’s enough. even if it still hurts. and maybe we had enough. i don't want you to keep hurting. P.S. adding intro cause past life wasn’t on the list. but this ain’t random at all. maybe the title itself is already saying the truth about what you said last. we write still. and never said goodbyes. that’s why we come back here and start at its intro. knowing nothing about its end. - Vivi

Hi there sunshine! I hope this message finds you well. This is not a rejection letter but an appreciation and gratitude. Thank you for noticing me. No words can ever explain how grateful I am to have you in my life, Ayel. You are the most awesome and bravest person I know. I wish I could die right now so that I can have that next life with you. Our time may be limited, and I hate that part, but I want you to know that I'll be here for you whenever and wherever. You are my unexpected, and forbidden love. You bring light to me. That is why you are my sun, you are the source, and without u we cannot see the way we are taking, the world is cold, and without heat and sunlight many creatures will die. We cannot survive or produce food without sunlight. You are my sun, your rays reached me even in the darkest part of my life. Your light helped me show the path that I needed to take. Your light reminded me that there is still hope. I am one of the darkest and saddest people u could ever meet, but u saw me as me, u saw me as your lucky charm, your star, which I could never imagine. I wish we could stay like this forever. If only I could freeze time so that we could stay at each other's side and have this moment for a lifetime, but sadly, destiny couldn't even grant it. But despite all of that, maybe destiny has a greater plan for us. I don't want to ruin our relationship, same as our friendship, but I am not ready to commit. I am sorry if I'm not as brave as you. I am sorry that I couldn't risk it all. This letter does not intend to hurt you, but if it did, I'm very sorry, my sunshine. I don't want you to hold on to me forever, kasi there are no promises on that. And remember this: If ever that day comes and I am not by your side anymore, I'll always support you, love you, cherish you, remember you, hold you, and cheer for you. I’m not sure if you ever think of me anymore. Maybe not. And that’s okay I never expected you to. I’m writing this not because I want to change anything, and not because I haven’t moved forward. I just wanted to let you know: even after all this time, I still keep you in my quiet prayers.

You never chose me, and I’ve made peace with that. But just because love wasn’t returned, doesn’t mean it wasn’t real at least from my side. I carry no bitterness, no regrets. Only gentle prayers, whispered when the world feels quiet.

I’m sorry, if my words back then ever came at the wrong time. If I ever made you feel uncomfortable, or put weight on your heart that wasn’t meant to be there. I didn’t mean to disturb your peace  and certainly not to hurt mine. I just loved in the only way I knew how: honestly.

You may never know how much you meant to someone like me and maybe you don’t need to. What matters is that your name still finds its way into my prayers. Not because I’m holding on, but because I still want the best for you.

This isn’t a wish to be remembered, or a longing to return. It’s just my way of saying: you were cared for, and maybe in some quiet way, still are. If ever life feels too heavy, I hope kindness finds you. And if you ever wonder whether anyone truly meant it- this, now, is the answer.

Take care, truly.
-From me, who once hoped to be your home, but now quietly prays you always find one.

No one had ever made me feel like that before.

You gave me hope when I was struggling to find any. You kept urging me to hold on, to stay a little longer. You never made a big deal of it, but your quiet encouragement meant everything to me. You reminded me that life, even when it feels unbearable, is still worth living. You were my light when I couldn’t see my way forward, and I hope you know that. I hope you know how much your love changed me.

That’s what I love about you, Kal. Not just your words, but your heart. You care so deeply, even when the world doesn’t always care back. That strength—that quiet, unwavering strength—is something I’ve always admired in you.

I know we may never talk again. I’ve made peace with that, even if it still hurts sometimes. But no matter how much distance life puts between us, I’ll always be here, cheering you on from afar. Whether you're on the soccer field chasing your dream or just getting through the ups and downs of everyday life—I’ll be rooting for you. Always.

Sometimes I wonder if we were the definition of “right person, wrong time.” Maybe in another life, we get it right. Maybe in another world, we don’t have to say goodbye. Maybe there, we grow together instead of apart.

I promise, if there’s another universe out there where soulmates get a second chance—where timing doesn’t get in the way—I’ll come looking for you. Every time.

Hi Maxine… or should I say Xine — the nickname I gave you back then, remember?

It’s been years since we broke up, and I don’t really know what pushed me to write this, but here I am.
I just want to say… thank you.
Thank you for teaching me how to love, even if it came with pain.
Thank you for all the things you gave me, for the time, the care — everything.
And yes, even thank you for hurting me and leaving me.
Because if you didn’t, I wouldn't be where I am now. I wouldn't have learned.

You were my lesson, Xine. And I needed that.

I’m happy now — truly.
With someone you once called a friend.
You know who I’m talking about.
No, she was never yours. You were never together.
But yes, I know what they say — that she broke some "girl code."
I know you two aren’t close anymore. But honestly? I don't regret being with her.

Because I love her.
And she loves me in the way I always wished I was loved before.

So thank you — for letting go, for walking away.


Also… I’m sorry.
For the words I said when we were still together.
For being immature, selfish, and careless with your heart.
I was young, and I know that’s not an excuse, but I still want to say sorry.
I regret hurting you, Maxine C******

I saw your Instagram — itssurmax — and though I don’t remember the numbers, I saw a new face in your profile.
People told me about the rebound after me — but I know that girl in the photo isn’t her.
Either way, I’m glad.
I’m happy you’re finding someone who’s there for you now.
And I hope this time, you choose to treat her right.

Please Xine…
Do the things for her that you couldn't do for me.
Choose her. Love her the way you should've loved.
Respect her. Make her feel like she’s never second.

And Max… I hope you’ve grown stronger.
I hope you're no longer relying on your friends to fix you, or save you.
I hope you're learning to stand on your own.

I know you left LF**, and wherever you are now —
Please take care of yourself.
And take care of the girl you're with now.
I hope she brings you peace.
May God bless you both.

Even if we never speak again, even if we’re strangers now…
I still pray for you.
Because deep down, I know you're not a bad person.
You were just lost. You didn’t know how to love fully yet.
And maybe… neither did I.

I’m sorry for how toxic things got between us.
But still — thank you, Xine.

For the love.
For the heartbreak.
And for leading me to where I am now.

— Someone who once loved you, but now finally understands or you know as s*****

I honestly don’t even know where to begin, because there are so many things I’ve wanted to say to you. But I know I can’t keep carrying this silence with me. I need to say this, no matter how late it is, and no matter how much time has passed between us. I’m sorry. Truly, genuinely, wholeheartedly—I’m sorry. I’ve replayed our moments together so many times in my head, trying to figure out what I could’ve done differently, what I should’ve said, how I could’ve made things right before everything slipped away. The truth is, you didn’t deserve the way I acted. You didn’t deserve the distance, the confusion, the way I made you feel like you didn’t matter to me. Because you did. You still do.

You’re not overreacting about me being distant with you lately. You were never overreacting. You saw the way I pulled back, the way I stopped being present, and I hate that I didn’t give you the honesty and clarity you deserved. You noticed it because you cared. You reached out, probably more times than I deserved, trying to keep a connection I should’ve been fighting for too. And instead of responding the way I should have, I let my silence speak louder than any words, and that silence hurt you. I know it did. And that is something I will never stop regretting.

You weren’t just someone I liked. You weren’t just a chapter in my life. You were my best friend. You were someone I trusted with parts of myself that I rarely let anyone see. You understood me in a way I can’t even explain. And I didn’t just lose a relationship or a friendship—I lost a piece of myself when I lost you. You were always there, with your support, your patience, your warmth. You saw the best in me, even when I was at my lowest. And I took that for granted. I took you for granted. That’s one of the hardest truths I’ve had to accept.

I think about all the memories we made, all the things we said and promised, and it still hurts to realize how far apart we are now. I miss you. I miss the late-night conversations, the way we used to laugh at things that made no sense, the way we felt like we could talk about anything. I miss feeling like someone truly understood me. And I know that’s my fault. I let the gap between us grow, and I didn’t do enough to stop it. I didn’t fight hard enough for someone who meant the world to me.

Thank you—for everything. For the times you stayed even when I was difficult, for the way you were patient with me, for how you made me feel like I mattered. You gave me memories that I’ll carry with me forever. You gave me a kind of comfort and safety that not everyone is lucky enough to find. I know I didn’t always show it, but I was thankful. I was thankful for you. For your existence, your presence, your friendship, your love. Even in moments when I was silent or distant, you meant so much more to me than I ever said out loud.

I understand if you don’t want to be friends with me again. I understand if too much has happened, if the pain is still there, or if you’ve already started moving on. And even though that hurts, I respect it. I would never ask you to go backwards, or to reopen wounds you’ve already tried to heal. But I just want you to know that I see everything now. I see how I failed you, how I didn’t show up in the way I should have, how I let someone so important to me slip through my fingers. And I’ll never forget that. I’ll never forget you.

You were more than just a moment in my life. You were a person who changed me. Someone who made me feel something real, something rare. And even if we never speak again, I will always be grateful for you. I’ll always remember the way you made me feel seen. I’ll always carry the good we had, even if it ended painfully. I just hope you find happiness, healing, and peace. I hope the world is kinder to you than I was. And I hope that one day, even if it’s just for a second, you’ll look back and know that you mattered. That you were loved. That you were everything to someone, even if they didn’t show it the way they should have.

Thank you for being a part of my life. I’m sorry I wasn’t better at holding onto you.

                                                           -Ancinee

naalala mo pa ba yung date nayun? I wrote it down in my journal. It was the moment when we finally held hands and hugged. I still remember how I couldn’t sleep at all that night, because all I could think about was your warm hands and how your fingers interlaced with mine, perfectly.

Hi Vaibhav,

This will be the last message I write to you.

I'm sorry, Vaibhav, for bothering you when you needed sleep and rest more than spending time with me. Please send my apologies to mama too, for bothering her yesterday.

Thank you so much for these past three months.
I've decided to delete all of our chats because I no longer want to see how I kept begging for your attention in them.

I only kept our anonymous chat—
the message that made me open my heart to you when we first met.
Haha, reading it again, I realize there were many lies between us.
You said you needed someone who could understand you, and said that was me...
But no, I wasn’t that good and I wasn’t that understanding.
I’m the type of person who needs things to be explain again n again until I get it.
I said I wanted someone who could love me as I am and that I hated love bombing in a relationship—
and well… it all ended just as I expected.

I still love you, but I choose myself—like you chose yourself.
I want to protect myself to like I used to be before you came.

When you said “IT’S OVER!”,
I took that as the end too.
No more tears, no more heartbreak—
I just needed a clear closure from you.
I don’t want to cry anymore, or beg just to be noticed.
And you don’t need someone like me who alwais asking for attention and time when you’re already drained—physically and emotionally.

We’re completely different people, and I hate that fact, but it’s the truth.

You know, on the day I triggered yet another argument...
I also fought with my mama.
I fought with you too, and all those thoughts gave me a terrible headache and fever.
I needed you, but I knew I had to understand.

I’m sorry, Vaibhav, for never truly trusting you from the beginning.
I’m sorry I couldn’t understand your past—about that girl, and about your family.

Since the fights became frequent, there were moments I just wanted to be comforted—
but the phrase “if he wanted to, he would” turned out to be true.
And clearly, you didn’t want me.

I don’t know what will happen after this.
Maybe going back to our separate lives sounds like the best path.

Mr. Fox will be always my partner sleep every night and I'll continue again to make penguin even though we're not together. I want bring them to my graduation, take a picture. And of course I'll taking care caca and cici like you said, they always be your cats too.

Take care of yourself, Vaibhav.
May your days always be blessed,
may your heart be happy,
may your work go smoothly,
may your mom always be healthy.
Eat well, don’t forget to drink water,
go to the gym and stay healthy.

Goodbye,
-Afii

There was a time when I thought what we had could grow into something in the form of friendship, trust, and softness. Because you embodied that in ways I didn’t quite expect. You had a quiet care, and a way of holding me like you never wanted to let go. And if I had to honest, I had known you probably liked me even before you told me. You would show it more than me, and I’m sorry for not acting on it back then. I think I was just too insecure to accept it, and I had also just emotionally shut down after that year. That’s why I’d constantly apologize to you about not telling you my true feelings, because I had my suspicions about yours for the longest time. And I had hoped you would talk to me again, because I know I’d be too scared to go up to you. I think I held onto that hope for longer than I’d wish to admit. So when you finally talked to me again the beginning of this year, I felt relieved. And when you finally told me your feelings I was too happy to see the consequences of my waiting around. That we didn’t have much time left together. In you, I saw what I had always wished for. And even if I never knew all the parts you believed to be bad, I was willing to understand them and remind you exactly why I had so much feelings for you. Because you are someone caring, someone kind, and someone I know I could’ve learned with. That’s why I tried so hard to get it right with you. Not because I was naive, but because I truly believed in you even if I was scared of getting hurt. After what I went through with that other guy there was confusion and the lies I could never understand. He turned out to be the person I didn’t think he could ever be. I ended up not allowing myself to be sad or angry about it openly because we weren’t ever together. But I realized after that year that it wasn’t healthy to suppress my feelings. And I don’t think you ever knew what happened, but it had truly brought me to a bad place mentally. I thought I was stronger but I guess I wasn’t. I ended up forcing myself to grow from it. Into someone with clearer boundaries, someone who no longer tolerated emotional half-effort. But with you, I opened back up carefully and with patience even knowing how much of an impatient person I am. I wanted to fight for you without losing myself, and I think I managed to do that this time around. And that’s what I’m proud of. Even if the priority of myself had been of fear of getting hurt, I made sure to try and at least give you an undeniable part of myself. My understanding and my underwhelming care. I know my feelings can be overbearing, so I tried not to overstep. And in the end I’m not sure if that was the right thing to do. But hey, we live and we learn. But I also need to be honest about how I felt after our last conversation and throughout the time we spent together. There’s moments I felt I was offering all of myself. My thoughts and fears, just for you to understand. And afterwards I felt you’d drift farther out of reach. You said you weren’t good at communicating, and I believed you. I knew you held some fear and I saw it, as well as the vulnerability you probably didn’t quite know how to show. I knew and saw it because I held that same anxiety. But I tried to meet you halfway. I wished I said this earlier, that I was willing to be there for you. Even if you didn’t want to talk to me, I was willing to just sit by your side in silence. I didn’t want to be fully shut out. I wanted to hear your whole story, not just the highlights. And I also wanted to be seen fully, not just in the parts I showed you. But I wanted you to take the initiative to get know all of me. I wanted to tell you about all the pain I carried, about what happened with that guy, about how long I’ve been trying to believe someone could treat me right and stay. You didn’t need to save me from my doubt, I just wanted you to stay by my side and understand. The day we kissed, I was nervous and unsure. I was shaking and you comforted me. So I tried to let you in. I tried to get to know you, but we never had another moment like that. And even then, I don’t know if you ever really saw me. And I’m not talking of the version you may have made up in your head, but the actual and complex me. The me that had so much fear of feeling too much for another person again, because I knew how it felt when it ended last time. Maybe that’s why this hurts the way it does. Because I finally had something good, but it never reached its full potential. We drifted apart not because of some kind of direct disrespect but from a quiet indifference I felt from you, and that you probably felt from me. You never wanted to hurt me, and I you. But it happened anyways. And no one really tells you how to deal with something that was never quite solid enough to hold. You probably don’t remember saying this but you once told me you weren’t going to disappear. When you said that I thought you could read my mind. Because I have always felt somewhat lonely. As if some of the people in my life weren’t permanent. That one day they can just leave whenever they wanted to. And your promise to me had almost made me feel as if that weren’t true anymore. But you did disappear, in a gentle way. And I waited. I waited for a message, for any sign that I meant enough to keep close. But it never came. So I never sent another. Not because I didn’t want to, but because I needed to see if you’d try. And you didn’t. I don’t mean to make you feel guilty or to shift the blame on you. I know that it wasn’t your intention to let me down, it just happened that way. I know I hurt you as well. For not allowing myself to be honest with you sooner and not allowing myself to be “too much” in fear that you’d not like the ugly I carry. And for not knowing quite exactly how to handle all of my feelings and thoughts without overwhelming you. So I don’t and cannot hate you. I remember you. I know you were probably unsure under our circumstances. I know you had your own ghosts. But I also know that if I was the one leaving, I would’ve fought for you. I wouldn’t have let time or distance keep me from someone I believed in. Because I believe in trying, even when the outcome is very uncertain and shaky. I guess I didn’t need that trust in you after all. I just needed to believe in you, which I did. And again, I can’t put that on you or disregard your feelings. I also understood why you wouldn’t at least try, and I’d never want to hold you back or be a burden. You were my first real thing. And even though you may never have known my full name, my hobbies, and what made me, me. I can’t deny that you not seeking those things out hurt a bit. Because I tried to learn every small detail about you. Like the ones you told me and the ones I noticed when you didn’t think I did. I took everything I knew about you and memorized it, because I really cared for you. I still do. I wish I had met you earlier. I wish I had told you sooner how much you meant to me. I wish you and I had shown up consistently, not just in words but in action. But I must say I feel like my words are as strong as any action I could’ve done. But mostly, I wish you peace and growth. I hope you find the strength to communicate fully, to feel bravely and openly, and to not run from what overwhelms you. I know you can, because I see so much potential from you. Thank you for your patience and handling the end with gentle words. And you’re right, I know I had snapped at you earlier and I’m sorry for that. This isn’t a wound, but a lesson that had unfortunately left a scar. But still, I won’t forget how far I’ve come. And I won’t forget how you were the first person who made me believe I could try again. That matters so much more than you can even imagine. James, thank you for always showing me kindness. For always caring. And for always being the authentic you. And lastly, thank you for making me feel comfortable enough to share my authentic self in this letter. Even If you never got to read it.

With love,

I am definitely sending it here, not until I revise it to its fullest perfection tho, and also I think I’ve gotten comfortable enough that if ever, the real “Laicel” ever reads this, that I’ll no longer be afraid of the thought… because at the end of the day, these were things I couldn’t say to her in person… so I can just treat them as if they were nonexistent… Anyway there’s no room for regret in any of these entries as I can’t delete them… But still yup! Class has recently restartes, and have been seeing her once again daily, yet as always I’m still the coward I’ve always been… not being comfortable with rejection when it comes to her, and always fearing it… when she’s been nothing but short of the kindest, and most compassionate person I’ve ever seen, I still vividly remember staring right into her eyes in those many times I’ve gotten the opportunity of doing so, and damn it, is it so enthralling… The feeling is unimaginable, she just is! Just having gotten to know the person that she is, has made me this deeply in love with her, yet because of my god damn stupidity, and own dumh decisions, and train of thought… I’ve completely grown estranged with her, and have not even spoken to her once in the past few days I’ve ran into her, and seen her. I instead avoided her, and always pretended I was doing something else… when really, all that was, and ever was on my mind through each of those times was “what should I say” “what if she ignores me” “will she find me bothersome” “will she just walk past me” damnnn ittt… I’m starting to detest my awful behavior… I confessed to her, and yet here I am, acting as if she’s a god damn stranger each time she’s near, if not out right avoiding her. Halooo!! To be honest with you, nagulat ako nung may nakita akong new messages using the nn I gave you sa send the song, since tayong dalawa lang naman may alam noʼn. But ayon, tama nga ʼyung hinala ko na ikaw nga ʼyon, hehe. Anyways, I have a feeling na rin naman na may problem ka and what that problem is, before you even put a message there. Sabi ko noʼn ano, "for sure nahihirapan or naguguluhan na ʼto sa school, lalo naʼt newly elected president pa naman ʼto." And ayon, tama nga ʼko. I always tell you naman before, ʼdi ba? Na you donʼt have to force yourself to do something, as long sa you did your best, be proud of it—be proud of yourself. If you feel like you need some rest, go ahead and do so. Nothingʼs wrong with getting a little bit time for yourself. Also, donʼt be too pressured in school; alam ko naman na president ka ng room niyo, and you have to take responsibility for that position, but donʼt get too pressured by it. I know rin naman na you have no other choice, since your classmates were the one to nominate, and vote you for that position, so much higher pressure, since much higher expectations from others. But donʼt worry, I know naman na you can lead people well, and you are a very charming person. Just trust yourself. Itʼs been so long since I last wrote something, so I still canʼt process my thoughts that well. But, just know that whatever you may be feeling as of the moment, it is valid. Donʼt let other people stress you out again, and just focus on yourself. I know naman na youʼre always trying your hardest, and Iʼm so proud of you for doing so. Imagine, you still did well even though I wasnʼt by your side anymore. That just shows how strong of a person you are, but that doesnʼt mean na you should always stay strong. You can be weak sometimes, you can let everything out, you can lean to someone when youʼre starting to struggle, you donʼt have to face everything alone. Isa pa ʼyan sa lagi kong sinasabi saʼyo noon, na as long as Iʼm here, you donʼt need to face your problems alone. Even now, you can still talk to me kahit wala na tayo, since ayun na ʼyung nakasanayan, and komportable tayo sa isaʼt-isa. Itʼs okay, tell me everything, lagi naman akong makikinig. I may not be able to respond immediately, but I sure will kapag pwede na, and kaya na. So change topic muna, you asked me if kilala pa rin ba kita, and sabi mo siguro hindi na, or hindi na talaga. Sabi mo nga, nagbago ka na, hindi man agaran, but may progress. Thatʼs good, Iʼm happy for you. To be honest, siguro nga hindi na kita kilala, and ayoko naman mag-pretend na I still know everything about you, but what I can say is that, I still understand you better than anyone else. I put my time and effort into knowing you better, maybe thatʼs why when it comes to other people, I donʼt gave the energy to even do anything. You are the only person that I have ever tried to understand so deeply. So yeah. Para naman sa mga sulat mo na about saʼkin, gusto kong makita and mabasa, para mas maintindihan ko, and malaman ko ko ʼyung mga bagay na hindi mo nasasabi saʼkin noon. But Iʼm sure naman na you wonʼt show me, and itʼs okay. Just know that kahit wala na tayo, kahit papaano, I still care for you. Thank you for your concerns and worries about me, Iʼm taking good care of myself naman. I hope ikaw din, but sigurado naman ako na sasabihin mo na hindi mo kaya. Naiintindihan ko naman, I just hope na a time will come that youʼll take better care of yourself. It takes time, so donʼt rush it. If youʼre wondering naman if may bago na ako, meron na. Joke langgg, hehe. Wala, and I think hindi na muna. Self ko muna, para if may dumating man, at least alam ko na nakapaghanda ako. Ayun lang naman, just remember everything that Iʼve told you. Goodluck and donʼt forget to take a rest. Take care!! 😚

Happy 16th Birthday, Cess! 🥳💗

Grabe, sixteen ka na. Now here you are, turning another year older (and wiser? char haha). I just really wanted to take the time to say how proud I am of you. Seriously.

I’m proud of how far you’ve come, even with everything you've had to carry. You might not always say it, but I know there are days when things get too much, and you still manage to smile, laugh, and show up — for others, and for yourself. That strength, kahit hindi mo laging napapansin, is something I deeply admire. And even on the days when you feel like you're not doing enough — trust me, you are. You’ve come such a long way, and I hope you're proud of that too.

Thank you for being you. Thank you for being my friend, and for all the little and big ways you show you care — the random chats, the asaran moments, the lowkey advice na minsan banat lang pero totoo rin naman, and even the silent company when we both don’t feel like talking. I don’t think I say this enough, but I genuinely appreciate you. You’re one of the people who makes things a little lighter, even without trying.

You’ve been such a constant in my life, and I just want you to know how grateful I am for that. Through the good days, the breakdowns, the “ano ba ‘tong buhay” moments — nandiyan ka. And I hope I’ve been the same kind of friend to you too. If not, know that I’m trying, and I’m always here, kahit hindi ako laging vocal.

Now that you’re 16, I hope this year brings you all the peace, happiness, and quiet joy you deserve. I hope you continue to grow in your own time, and I hope you learn to be gentler with yourself — kasi you already give so much of that softness and care to others. You deserve to feel that too.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ‘tong message kung walang konting asar HAHAHAHAH so ayan na nga — iwasan mo na ang pagsusungit minsan pls 😭 HAHAHA. Pero gets naman, that’s just part of who you are (and honestly, sanay na kami lol). Kahit sungit ka, love ka pa rin namin. You’re genuinely such a beautiful person, sungit or not.

So yeah, happy birthday again, Cess. I hope today feels good — not because everything’s perfect, but because you know you're loved and celebrated. Not just today, but always. Keep being your funny, weird, strong, thoughtful, sungit, and amazing self. I'm always rooting for you.

Love youuuu. 👻🫰🏻

— Btw, take time to listen to this song.
Why I decided to choose this song is because — there’s sometime I feel happy when talking with you, yes. Tama ka, you’re my happy pill. And second, It’s because I want to be beside you, as always. I will support and will talk to you when you need a shoulder. And the most important thing, is being here when you need me.

Even the way you walk into a room changes the atmosphere. You bring presence, meaning, gravity. People notice — I always notice.

 You don’t just listen to words — you listen to the silences between them. That kind of empathy is rare, and I treasure it in you.

Kaz, when you love, you love with everything. No half-measures. And to be on the receiving end of that love is the greatest honor of my life.

I love the way you remember small things about me — details I’ve long forgotten, but that you’ve quietly held onto.

I find comfort in your steadiness, your ability to ground me even when I feel like I’m spiraling.

 I want to explore the world with you — not just the physical one, but the world of your thoughts, your memories, your hopes.

You are layered, complicated, and beautiful in ways that never stop fascinating me. I could spend forever learning you.

You broke me in a way that left me questioning everything—whether I gave too much, or maybe too little.
You were my safe place. My comfort. Someone I thought shared my mindset, my pace, my heart.
You made me open up again. You made me believe that maybe I was worth loving, if I could give that kind of love to someone else.
But somewhere in the process, while trying to understand and hold on to you, I started losing myself.

I can’t take back the smiles, the inside jokes, the long conversations, the “baby”s, the shirt, the song I once thought belonged to “us.”
And the worst part is, I still notice you in the smallest things.
In a phrase I used to say that you’d repeat with a smile.
In a random playlist shuffle.
Even in the way I talk to people now—softer, more careful—because loving you changed me, whether I wanted it to or not.
That’s the part people don’t tell you about moving on. It’s not always big moments. Sometimes, it’s being caught off guard by a memory in the middle of an ordinary day.

And you know… our story reminds me of Orpheus and Eurydice.
He loved her enough to walk into the depths of the underworld just to bring her back. But in the end, his one mistake—turning around too soon—meant losing her forever.
Maybe that’s what happened with us. I tried too hard to hold on to something fragile. Maybe I turned around too soon, or maybe you were never meant to follow me out in the first place.

I don’t even know if I’ve healed. Some days, I feel nothing. Other days, the thought of you and him brings everything crashing back.
Maybe I’m healing. Maybe I’m just distracting myself. But I do know this: I had every right to be hurt.
You would be too if you were in my place.

And no, this isn’t about blame. We both had our flaws. But I loved you deeply and honestly. And if that love ever felt like “too much,” maybe it just meant you weren’t ready for something real.

Still, I hope he’s treating you well. I really do.
I hope he sees the same softness I saw in you—the one you tried to hide but couldn’t help showing.
And if you’re happy now, I hope it’s the kind of happiness that lasts…
Even if I’m not the one you get to celebrate it with. 
Also—congratulations on winning.
You deserved that moment.

To my dear, arthur.

My dear Arthur, you never showed up, and now, after looking at the newspapers I understand why. I don't imagine you will receive this letter but I nonetheless must send it. Arthur, oh, Arthur.
I was just starting to dream the silliest and softest of dreams. I miss you, and I will always miss you but I cannot live like that, and it seems you cannot live any other way. When I'm with you, the world makes sense, but when we are apart, I see clearly that your world is not a world from which one can escape. I'm so sorry, for everything, for everything long ago and for starting up that business again.
There's a good man, within you, Arthur, but he is wrestling with a giant. And the giant... wins, time and again.
You've broken my heart, again, and I fear I have broken yours. For that, I will never forgive myself but you must let me go now.
I enclose a ring you gave me many years ago, when we were both young, not because I don't like it, but because I care for it far too much and it reminds me too much of you. I hope, one day... you will find some people in love who can use this, for it kept me thinking of you all these years, and hope by returning it to you
I can finally be free.

ー goodbye.
            Mary.

(sana basahin kahit medyo mahaba) I don't even know how to start this letter, so I’ll begin with the truth: thank you. Thank you for being part of my life, even if things didn’t end the way I hoped.

For almost two years, I quietly held feelings for you. I didn’t have the courage to say it out loud. Maybe I was afraid of ruining what little we had, or maybe I was just afraid. We didn’t talk often, but every conversation—even the smallest one—meant more to me than I could ever express.

You were my safe space. My special friend. The one I kept hoping would see how much I cared without me having to say anything. I know that sounds unfair now, expecting someone to understand feelings I never voiced. But that’s how it was. You meant a lot to me.

I’ve been listening to Byahe a lot lately. Ang aga ko mag-relapse, haha. And that other song—fudge, my heart just hurts. I hate it. It’s such a beautiful song, but it makes my chest feel heavy and I don’t even know why. Fucking hell.

Please take care of yourself, okay? Don’t push yourself too hard. Let’s work and study hard—because I believe we’ll see each other again, somewhere out there. Maybe in that dream country we both talked about. I know you’ll move past whatever you’re dealing with right now. I know you can do it.

Take care, Kyle Swiss. Good luck on your journey. I’ll be silently cheering for you from afar. 🫡 May our paths cross again someday, at the right time. Not on some app. Not online. But in the real world.

And if not… well, that’s really sad. :(
Peace out. 

Always,

If you’re reading this, then it’s your birthday.

And if everything went as planned, the guitar I promised you is already with you.

I wrote this message a long time ago. Not today. Not recently. But back when I made that promise to you—when I told you, “Even if you leave me or even if you hate me one day, I’ll still get you that guitar.”

You probably thought I forgot. Or maybe you thought I said it just to sound sweet. But I remembered. I meant it.

Even after everything happened, even when we weren’t okay anymore, I never erased that promise from my mind.

So I worked. I saved money. Quietly. No one knew.
Not to impress you.
Not to make you feel guilty.
Just to keep my word.

I stopped studying for now—not because I gave up, but because life made me take another path. And while I was working, I always remembered one thing I needed to finish: this gift.

I don’t expect anything from you. No message, no thank you, no reaction.
I won’t show up in your life again. I’ve already stepped away.
And even if you try to find me, I won’t be there. I’ve made peace with letting go.

But I wanted to leave something behind before fully disappearing. Something that came from my heart. Something I promised. Something real.

You can play it, or not. Keep it, or give it away. It’s yours now.
And if one day you play a song with it—maybe you’ll remember that someone once cared enough to keep their word, no matter how things ended.

Happy birthday.
I hope you’re truly happy.

To Aubrey,

Hi its me M(im sure you already know..). I don’t know if you’ll ever read this, but I’ve carried these words for so long, they needed somewhere to go. And maybe, this is that place.

It’s been almost a year now. Things have changed. I've changed. But there's still a part of me that drifts back to you to us.

I remember how things ended. I remember how I hurt you.
And I still carry that regret like a scar I gave myself.

I was lost, selfish, and caught up in emotions I didn’t know how to handle. In my own mess, I failed to see how my actions were affecting you. I thought love meant pushing, fighting, making it work no matter what but I’ve learned the hard way that love also means knowing when to let go, when to let someone breathe, when to respect their heart. And I didn’t do that.

You were right to walk away.

There are days when I still go to the places we used to hang out. I sit there, in silence, and I remember. I remember your laugh, the way you’d light up when we’d talk about the stupidest things. I remember how you looked at me when you were serious, or how you'd rest your head on your hand, like the world could wait just a little bit longer.

I eat the meals we shared, and I try to taste them the same way, but it’s different now. There’s a gap where your presence used to be. I replay our memories more times than I’ll ever admit to anyone. The good ones, the bad ones, the moments I never understood at the time… but now, in hindsight, I see how much you truly gave me, and how poorly I handled that.

That realization hurts more than I can explain. I’m not asking for forgiveness not from you, and not from myself. But I want you to know that it’s never been easy. Every time I’ve had to live with what happened, it’s been like a constant reminder of how far I’ve fallen short.

But I’ve changed. Slowly. Not in the ways I thought I would, but in the ways that matter. I’ve learned to see things from your perspective what it felt like for you to love me, what it felt like for you to fight for something that was slipping away. I’ve learned that love is not just about the good times; it’s about being there when it gets hard, when you can’t find the easy answers.

This isn’t a plea for you to come back. I know that ship has sailed. You’ve probably moved on, and I hope that you’ve found the peace you deserve. I just needed to say it I’m sorry for all the pain I caused you. I’m sorry for not being the person you needed me to be.

You taught me how it feels to be truly loved. You also taught me how it feels to lose that love. And both will stay with me forever.

I still visit places we went. I still think about how we used to talk about everything, and how you could make even the smallest moments feel special. I miss that. I miss you. But I also understand why you had to leave, and I hope you can find peace in knowing that I’m not asking for anything from you anymore.

I chose this song—“Sparks”—because it reminds me of you. Of how soft it was. How warm. And how even now, there’s still a tiny flicker in the dark, glowing quietly… not to reignite anything, but just to say,
You mattered. A lot.

You say you love me. But your love comes with a price tag and a zipper. Your love only shows up when my clothes come off.
When I say no, you don’t hear it—or worse, you do, and keep going anyway. Like consent is a puzzle you just haven’t solved yet. Like “no” is a test, and you’re determined to pass it.
You talk more about my body than you’ve ever talked about my voice, my dreams, my mind. You don’t ask what keeps me up at night or what song I play on repeat. You just want to know what’s underneath.
Like that’s all I am—something to be unwrapped, exposed, captured. But you need to know what’s under my shirt. You need to memorize my skin like a conquest.
You can't even touch me, but still you try to own me—through a screen, with your endless questions and digital hands that don’t know how to stop reaching.
You dress your obsession up as love—but I know what this is. Love doesn’t make me feel smaller. Love doesn’t silence me unless I click "send".
You think your desire is flattering. It isn’t. It’s suffocating. It crawls under my skin and rots there.
You say I’m everything—but your “everything” ends at the edge of my skin.
Well, I am more than that.
And if you can’t love what’s clothed,
what’s hidden, what speaks and feels and chooses—then you don’t get to love me at all.
I am not your reward for persistence. I am not your prize for wearing me down.
And if you can't love the parts of me that stay clothed, that stay quiet, that say no—
then let me go.
Because I’m not yours. And I never was.

Dear Jack,

Gua enggak tahu harus mulai dari mana. Gua bahkan enggak tahu apa masih pantas manggil lu dengan nama yang selama ini gua simpan rapi di dada, sambil bisik-bisik sama semesta supaya lu denger.

Jack…
Lu tau nggak, rasanya mencintai seseorang yang enggak pernah benar-benar bisa dimiliki? Rasanya kaya berdiri di depan pintu yang nggak pernah dibukain, tapi gua tetap nungguin. Kaya ngirim ribuan surat yang enggak pernah dibales. Kaya berharap pada langit mendung yang nggak pernah nurunin hujan.

Gua pernah berharap, suatu hari lu bakal balik, bawa semua hal yang pernah lu janjiin. Kita ke selasar sunaryo. Lu cobain masakan gua. Kita dengerin lagu Keshi, atau diem-diem peluk di parkiran sambil ngomongin hal-hal kecil yang nggak penting. Gua pernah nunggu itu, Jack. Tapi gua sadar, gua cuma numpang hidup di kepala lu sebentar, sementara lu udah jadi isi penuh di hati gua.

Jack…
Gua bahagia kok, liat lu bahagia. Gua senyum pas lu posting dia. Tapi senyum itu selalu nangis di belakangnya. Rasanya lucu, ya? Gua bisa sebahagia itu karena lu, tapi sekaligus sehancur ini karena lu.

Gua enggak pernah minta lu balas perasaan gua. Gua enggak pernah maksa lu balik. Gua cuma pengen lu tahu, ada orang di sini yang pernah dan masih secinta itu sama lu. Yang rela disakitin berkali-kali asal bisa nungguin lu, asal bisa liat lu senyum dari jauh.

Dan mungkin, ini waktunya gua berhenti. Bukan karena rasa gua ilang. Tapi karena gua mulai sadar…
Gua pantas dicintai juga, Jack.
Gua pantas dipeluk seseorang yang enggak perlu gua minta buat tinggal.
Gua pantas ngerasain tenang tanpa harus jadi pilihan kedua.

Jadi kalau suatu hari lu baca ini, lu cuma perlu tahu…
Ada bagian dari hati gua yang enggak akan pernah bener-bener nutup buat lu. Tapi gua enggak akan nungguin lu di sana terus, Jack. Karena gua pelan-pelan mau belajar jadi rumah buat diri gua sendiri.

Gua sayang lu, Jack. Sayang banget. 
Selalu.

Aku masih selalu ingat semua momen yang kita lalui bersama. Dari cara kamu senyum, cara kamu marah, sampai cara kamu bikin aku merasa cukup. Semua itu gak pernah benar-benar pergi. Meskipun sekarang kita udah dijalan masing-masing, aku tetap peduli. Selalu. Jadi, tolong ya… jaga diri kamu baik-baik. Jaga kesehatan kamu. Mungkin aku gak bisa lagi ada di samping kamu buat ngingetin, tapi setiap malam sebelum tidur, doaku tetap ada buat kamu, semoga kamu selalu bahagia bahkan tanpa aku.

Dan kalau suatu hari nanti kamu nemuin seseorang yang lebih baik dari aku, yang bisa bikin kamu bahagia tanpa harus banyak luka, peluk dia erat-erat. Karena kamu pantas bahagia. Maaf kalau selama kamu sama aku, kamu gak pernah benar-benar ngerasain itu. Semoga kamu dapet orang yang bisa selalu ngertiin kamu, yang ga bikin kamu capek, yang tau gimana caranya nyembuhin luka-luka yang pernah aku tinggalkan.

Aku udah ngasih semuanya sebisa aku. Aku udah ngeluarin semua yang aku punya buat bikin kita bertahan. Dan aku cuma bisa berharap… semoga suatu saat kamu sadar, kalau cinta aku ke kamu ituu lebih dari yang pernah kamu tau.

Aku sayang kamu. Lebih dari apapun di dunia ini.
Dan maaf… maaf karena saat itu aku harus memilih keputusan untuk menyelesaikan hubungan ini, sayang. Bukan karena aku berhenti mencintai, tapi karena aku gatau lagi harus gimana buat nyelametin kita.

Terima kasih karena sudah datang didalam hidup aku. Senang pernah bertemu kamu. Hari di mana kita mulai semua ini “1 Juni 2023” akan selalu jadi hari yang aku simpan dalam hati. Hari di mana aku ngerasa punya seseorang yang begitu berarti.

Dan satu hal lagi…
Tanggal lahir kamu, “12 Maret 2009” akan selalu aku ingat. Hari di mana dunia kedatangan orang yang pernah aku cinta sepenuh hati.
