ASSALĀMU‘ALAIKUM WARAHMATULLĀHI WABARAKĀTUH

Salam hangat penuh cinta untukmu,
Lisna Khoirun Nisa’, sahabat yang luar biasa dan selalu aku banggakan.

Hari ini, tepat pada tanggal 20 Juni 2025, engkau genap berusia 21 tahun. Hari ini adalah momentum penuh makna, menjadi pengingat atas karunia Allah SWT yang telah memberimu umur panjang, hingga sampai pada fase kehidupan yang semakin matang dan dewasa.

Shēngrì kuàilè! 生日快乐! (Selamat ulang tahun!)
Semoga dengan bertambahnya usiamu, engkau dianugerahi umur yang berkah, kesehatan yang prima, kebahagiaan yang berlimpah, dan rezeki yang halal, cukup, dan penuh berkah.

Aku berdoa agar setiap langkahmu dimudahkan oleh Allah SWT, baik dalam urusan pekerjaan maupun dalam mencari nafkah untuk dirimu sendiri serta keluarga yang kau cintai: Bapak Maksum, Ibu Muafidah, adik Salma, dan adik Rehan.

Jika rasa lelah datang, jika sesekali ingin mengeluh itu wajar, karena kamu manusia biasa. Tapi tolong, jangan pernah menyerah ya. Nǐ hěn qiáng, zhēn de hěn lìhài 你很强，真的很厉害 (Kamu kuat, sungguh luar biasa). Aku sungguh bangga atas keteguhan hatimu.

Semoga kamu bisa menjadi pribadi yang semakin baik sebagai anak, cucu, dan kakak bagi keluarga tercintamu: Bapak Maksum, Ibu Muafidah, kakek-nenek, adik Salma dan adik Rehan. Teruslah menjadi anak yang sholehah, berbakti kepada orang tua, menjaga kerukunan dalam keluarga, dan berguna bagi agama, masyarakat, bangsa, dan negara.

Jadilah pribadi yang baik dalam keadaan apa pun. Hǎo rén yǒu hǎo bào 好人有好报 (Orang baik akan mendapat balasan yang baik). Semoga sifat-sifat positif dalam dirimu terus bertambah, dan yang kurang baik bisa kamu perbaiki secara perlahan. Semoga kamu senantiasa menjadi pribadi yang penuh kesabaran, ketulusan, dan kasih sayang.

Aku juga berdoa agar seluruh cita-cita dan harapanmu satu per satu dapat terwujud. Semoga engkau dijauhkan dari segala hal yang tidak baik, dari orang-orang yang membawa keburukan, dan dari segala bentuk kegelisahan yang tak perlu.

Qǐng zhùyì shēntǐ 请注意身体 (Tolong jaga kesehatanmu).
Cukupkan istirahat, kurangi makanan pedas dan mie instan, jangan telat makan. Overthinking boleh, tapi sewajarnya. Banyak-banyaklah berpikir positif dan berikan afirmasi baik pada dirimu bahwa hidup ini penuh berkah dan harapan yang akan menjadi nyata.

Semoga Lisna menyukai kado sederhana dariku. Tolong dijaga dan dimanfaatkan sebaik-baiknya ya. Aku tahu, kamu telah berjuang keras dalam bekerja. Selamat karena kamu berhasil meraih apa yang kamu inginkan melalui usaha dan kerja keras. Aku turut bahagia dan bangga padamu.

Semoga kamu kelak bertemu dengan jodoh yang benar-benar sesuai dengan harapanmu yang mencintaimu dengan tulus, yang menghargai dan menghormati keluargamu, serta siap tumbuh bersamamu dalam suka dan duka.
Zhù nǐ yǒu yī gè měihǎo de yuánfèn 祝你有一个美好的缘分 (Semoga kamu mendapatkan jodoh yang indah). 

Terima kasih ya Lis, karena telah memahami aku apa adanya. Kalau ada hal yang mengganjal di hatimu, tolong jangan dipendam sendiri. Cerita saja, aku selalu siap mendengar. Terima kasih juga karena sudah bersedia berteman denganku, yang masih banyak kekurangan dan sering merepotkanmu.

Maaf jika aku belum bisa menjadi teman yang sempurna untukmu. Maaf kalau aku pernah menyusahkan, membuatmu lelah karena cerita-ceritaku yang terlalu sering tentang dia tapi sekarang aku sedang belajar untuk perlahan melepaskan dan melangkah maju. Aku berusaha berubah, pelan-pelan, demi kebaikan diri sendiri dan agar kamu tidak terlalu terbebani.

Kalau aku berbuat salah, tolong diingatkan dan dimaafkan ya. Aku hanya bisa memberi ucapan, doa-doa yang baik, dan hadiah kecil, tapi semua itu datang dari lubuk hati yang tulus. Aku sungguh bersyukur bisa mengenalmu. Semoga persahabatan kita langgeng hingga akhir hayat.

Yǒngyuǎn zuò péngyǒu 永远做朋友(Selamanya jadi sahabat). 
Maaf jika ada kata-kata yang kurang tepat. Sekian, dan terima kasih dari hatiku yang terdalam. Doa terbaikku akan selalu menyertaimu, Lisna Khoirun Nisa’.
Aamiin yā rabbal ‘ālamīn.

message:
I do not know if these words will ever find you, nor if you would still recognize the voice behind them but I write them anyway, as one might press flowers in a book, simply for the keeping.

The days pass, and yet your name sits on the edge of everything, like the pale light that lingers before evening. I still think of your hands how they moved when you spoke, as though trying to catch thoughts before they drifted away. There is such gentleness in memory, though it stings.

I would not dare say I miss you not because it is untrue, but because the missing has become something quieter now, something I carry like a secret. Some things, after all, are not meant to be said aloud.

I hope you are well. I hope you have found soft mornings and laughter that stays long after the moment has passed. And if, on some distant evening, you think of me, I hope it is with something like fondness.

Yours, Still... Somehow.
Mclaren.

Ever since elementary, i admire you. The way you talk to the crowds, the way you smiled at everyone, the way you lead your team, it was wonderful to watch you from afar. It was as if i'm watching to a star that keeps shining and shining sunrise to sunsets. 

I remember when it was your first ever competition where in you accidentally won your first ever gold. Your smile never failed to scape from your lips and talk about your future as an athlete. Little did you know, I sneak out to watch you how dedicated you are but I can't see it. Haha, you were not dedicated but happiness never leaves that face of yours. I thought it was what you wanted but i had known that you only took this opportunity to skip classes. Haha how cute of you. This moment is only a one of a thousands things that will never leave my mind.

I was overwhelmed with this feeling but still, it continues to grow. Every second, minutes, hours, days and months passing by, this admiration starts to build this new feelings — love. I had considered every minute to get you to know me but still i don't you to either. Not because I am afraid, but because Istill wanted to see you shine as you take your paths for the future. I want to watch you in the crowd, but a lot more shiner than ever. 

It was perfect but then this and that happened. You graduated elementary as the class valedictorian. You start to plan where to enroll for high school and it was a shame that you chose the fardest one. 

You start to learned how to be independent that i actually liked. My star continues to grow, she's in her way. But that doesn't long. You continue to change but in the wrong way. How could you start to feel shame about yourself when you are the most shining star in our lives. I was sadden as those changes start to become anxieties that I no longer saw you come out to your house. I missed those smiles of yours, that now, all I could get to pic was your fainted smiles that never pass to your eyes. What happen my star? 

I wanted to be your shoulder, your tissue, your light but how could I? When all I could do is to watch you from afar. I was ashamed but still I wanted you to remember yourself again. That dedicated soul that lighten this heart of mine.

I was hurt but not as the way you've suffer yourselves but this hope that I was holding was right. Little by little i notice how you starts to spark. I wanted you to know me but remember if you read this, you already knew me and I would love you to search for me and also look at me, soon we'd meet. But still i don't want to ruin your journeys so continue to shine, not for everyone but for yourself. 

I love you, My Star. I know this is my last and i bid you a goodbye but don't worry, I am always here to watch you every single time. 

You are not alone.

aku nggak tau kamu sadar atau nggak,
tapi… akhir-akhir ini kamu tuh ngilang banget.
dan jujur aja, aku kangen.
not just "miss you" as in biasa aja,
tapi yang sampai mikir,
“are you really okay?”

aku tau kamu selalu jawab “nggak papa”,
selalu kasih alasan se-simple “nggak ada kuota” atau “lagi sibuk”.
tapi aku bisa ngerasa,
something’s not fine.
and maybe you don’t wanna talk about it.
it’s okay. i won’t force you.
tapi aku tetap di sini.
aku cuma pengen kamu tau itu.

i know you're the kind of person
yang selalu mikirin orang lain dulu sebelum diri sendiri.
yang selalu tanggung jawab, yang kuat banget.
yang keliatannya chill, tapi dalemnya mungkin lagi jungkir balik.
dan ya,
aku sadar kamu bukan tipe yang gampang percaya sama orang.
aku ngerti.
aku juga nggak maksa buat jadi orang yang kamu percaya.
aku cuma pengen jadi seseorang yang available
kalau kamu suatu hari nanti mau cerita.

you’ve always been that person for me, you know?
my place to rest when everything feels too much.
my safe space at school.
rumah, yang walaupun kadang berisik dan keras kepala,
tapi selalu ada.

dan sekarang,
kalau kamu lagi ngerasa capek,
kalau semuanya terasa berat,
please remember:
you don’t have to go through this alone.

kalau kamu butuh diem bareng, aku bisa.
kalau kamu butuh dengerin lagu sambil nangis, aku bisa.
kalau kamu butuh seseorang yang nggak nanya-nanya tapi tetap hadir,
aku juga bisa.

don’t think you’re alone, okay?

aku tau kamu kuat,
but even the strongest person needs to fall apart sometimes.
it’s not weakness.
it’s human.

and if you ever feel like no one sees your fight,
know that i do.
i always have.
and i always will.

so yeah,
no pressure to reply,
no pressure to talk.
just…
please take care of your heart.
and if you ever feel like coming home—
you know where to find me.

from someone who’ll always stay,
even in silence.
with all the love i have,
aku.

Good morning, yinyin, val, crush, baby, honeybunch, bff, bai, dude, or whatever names I have ever called you. Today’s my first day back at school, and though I’m gonna be surrounded by people and noise mamaya, I could already feel my heart being unusually quiet without you. I hope your day went well, or at the very least, I hope you felt even a little bit of peace. There’s not much on my mind right now that feels worth sharing, but I promised myself something— and that’s to show up for you in small ways, even from afar. So I’ll be sending you songs and letters every day. Not just to stay connected, but to remind you that no matter how far life stretches us, it’s still me against the world just for you.
I miss you in ways I don’t always know how to say. I miss the way you speak to me, the way your words feel like home no matter what mood I’m in. I love how you comfort me without trying too hard, how your presence alone can quiet the noise in my chest. There’s something about the way you carry joy— even in your randomness— that feels like sunlight. Every meme in your gallery, every out-of-nowhere lyric you send, every story you tell me about a song you love— it’s all etched into me. You made even the smallest things feel like magic.
Our conversations, filled with self-reacts and running jokes, became their own little universe. I even miss your voice cracks, which somehow sound like music to me, like little imperfections I wouldn’t trade for anything. I remember the way you’d sing for me, every song I asked for, no hesitation. And now, every song I hear finds a way to remind me of you. It’s strange— how someone can become the soundtrack of your life, even in their silence.
I miss when you called me your crush. I miss how you said “I love you” like it was the most natural thing in the world. And I know I only ever said it once, but I hope you felt it in every moment after, in the way I looked forward to your messages, in the way I listened to your voice, in the way I memorized you. I really did love every second we shared. I still do.
More than anything, I hope that maybe— just maybe— someday we’ll try again. In a time when we’re both more sure, more settled. In a season without pressure, where love can grow without fear, and where school or stress doesn’t cloud the way we feel. Until then, I’ll hold onto the memories, to the love we sparked, and to the hope that some stories, no matter how paused, are still meant to be continued.

Some people may not understand what we have. They might ask how I can love someone I’ve never met. But love isn’t limited to physical touch. It’s in the late-night conversations, the silly jokes, the virtual hugs, the promises we whisper into the void, hoping one day they’ll come true. 🤍

I won’t lie — long-distance can be hard. Not being able to be with you physically, not being able to run to you when I miss you, it aches. But every call we share, every “I miss you” text, every sweet “good night” reminds me that we’re fighting for something real. Something worth waiting for. And I will wait — because I believe in us. I believe in you. I believe in the day I’ll finally get to stand in front of you, smile through tears, and say, “So it was all real after all.” 🥺

I want to laugh with you until we can’t breathe. I want to do all the little things — like share a drink, take silly photos, or just sit in silence together — because I know even the simplest things will mean the world when I’m finally with you.

But until then, this is how we love. Through messages, calls, video chats, voice notes, and late-night wishes. Through patience and trust. Through the belief that what we’re building is stronger than any distance.

Thank you for being you — for being patient, understanding, affectionate, and just so full of love. You have no idea how much I appreciate the effort you put in to make me feel close, even when we’re far apart. You have made this first month unforgettable, and I can only imagine how beautiful the rest of our story will be. 🌍💞

I’ll get to look into your eyes without a screen in between, and I’ll finally get to say all these things face-to-face.

Until that day, I just want you to know how much I appreciate you. How much I adore you. How much I admire your strength, your kindness, your loyalty, your heart. You are such a beautiful soul, and I’m so lucky — so incredibly lucky — to be loved by you.

message:
Hi, I hope you'll know me by how I write this message I have for you. First, I just want to ask, how are you? I hope you're doing fine. Do your best in your class, okay? I know you're pretty tired in that sub, but I hope na somehow that's a bit better rn. You know, as much as I want you to be just fine after that night. Somehow I'm wishing that you're a bit affected too. I know, contradicting, right? I don't even know what I really want. I wish you to be fine, but I wish you not as well. Maybe I just want to see some proof that I mattered at some point. In simple words, I hope you miss me even just for a minute. To the point that you might want to give me a message. But still, I hope you're doing better than before. I don't know how I can move on. I'm stuck. I want to be fine, but I also don't want to let go. Yes, I'm waiting. I'm still waiting for you to message me, check me, or just simply invite me to play a game with you. I'm waiting for nothing; I know that. You've clearly told me that you're not really capable of liking me back, let alone loving me. Maybe I just have so much love for you that it led me to keep on waiting. Still having hopes that you'll be back one day. You know, I keep seeing you in my dreams even though I barely get sleep now. I miss you so much. There are a lot of things I want to ask you, but I guess I will not ask them here nor anymore. And, there's no day that passed that I didn't regret the action I took; it keeps on torturing me. I should not have cut you off. I can endure more seeing you in every app I am on. Even though I'll just be a shadow friend to you. I still want to know what's going on with your life. There are a lot of times I stopped myself from trying to reach out to you again just to ask for an update about you. But I do always ask for you from our common friend. She doesn't give me enough answers, but I'll take what I can have. I really miss you. Time flies so fast. The 7 months I had with you were the most amazing time I had in my life. You bring out a new version of me, a version of me that I didn't know was possible to exist. The smiles and laughs I had with you are the most genuine feelings I felt. The tears I poured out to you carry out the feelings I have for you. If one day I get a chance to go back to those times, I'll always go back. In October I met you; in November we got to know each other. The December we endure. The January of reality. The February of smiles. The March of courage. The April of sorrows. And, the May of ending. I'll still choose to keep coming back. And you know, even though I already told my mom that we are not talking anymore, she still asks for you sometimes. It pains me that I can no longer give the answer she wants to hear every time she asks how are you. I still have a lot to say; maybe I'll be back in here some time to continue, but as of now I'm getting blank, and I don't know anything more to say. I just hope you see this; I just hope you find me; I just hope you still remember what I said to you way back in April. I just hope you come back. Even just being friends with you. I'm sorry for the hard times I put you through. I don't really know where to start, and how will I move on from something that didn't get the chance to be mine.

P.S. If somehow you've truly liked the necklace, I hope you keep wearing it.

message: hi, my multo. aku mimpiin kamu, june 7th. itu hari minggu, aku baru siap shooting lomba, dan besok nya hari terakhir ujian, jadi aku udah ga terlalu sibuk. sore sore gitu awal nya aku mau mandi, aku udah nuang haircreambath, udah mau mandi sore pokoknya. tapi aku ngantuk banget jadi aku ketiduran di ruang tengah, pas banget di depan pintu. aku udah buat alarm biar ga ketiduran sampe malam gitu. aku mimpi kita lagi ada di suatu resto, itu tuh ada aku, kamu, mama aku, temen nya (tapi ga liat muka nya). kita duduk tuh kaya hadap hadapan. aku sebelah kamu, depan aku mama, depan kamu temen mama aku. aku peluk peluk kamu dari samping, kaya orang normal pelukan aja. bukan pelukan rindu atau gimana gimana, pokok nya tipe yang pacaran nya clingy gitu. terus perasaan aku ga enak, aku langsung liat ke arah kiri dan bener aja. ada mama kamu. disitu kita langsung panik dong, tapi mama aku ya biasa aja, mama aku juga langsung nyambut mama kamu gitu. terus temen mama aku yang hadap hadapan sama kamu tadi pindah, jadi mama kamu yg duduk di depan kamu. mama aku biasa aja, dan dia berbaur sama temen temen nya yang lain, tapi tetep duduk di tempat yang sama. mama kamu ngomong serius, kita berdua udah duduk tegak kaya orang panik gitu. terus mama kamu ngomong " kevin ini udah mau masuk sma, dia udah gabisa pacaran dan ga boleh pacaran ", aku langsung nepuk paha kamu, buat ngasi kode biar bilang kalau kita itu ga pacaran. di posisi itu dada aku udah sesak banget pengen nangis, tapi gatau kenapa aku ga nangis di situ. terus gatau gimana tiba tiba kita ada dirumah kamu,  rumah kamu dalam mimpi aku tuh kaya besar, megah, warna emas gitu. tapi aneh nya ada beberapa temen cowo aku juga, inti nya aku nanya ke kamu kaya " ini hubungan kita gimana? ", terus kamu jawab " udah gapapa, aman itu, kita bakal tetep bareng bareng " tapi kamu jawab nya nyantai banget, sambil main hp lagi. masi ada lagi sambungan nya, tapi susah jelasin nya dan ga terlalu penting juga. setau aku ya mimpiin orang lain itu karna kita terlalu mikirin dia, kalau dibilang mikirin kamu sih iya, tapi aku cuma mikir buat mau ngabarin kamu aja, karna aku udah selesaian semua tugas tugas aku. maksud nya tuh ga mikirin yang kaya terlalu serius, ya sekedar gitu doang. tapi kata temen aku itu karna ada 1 pihak yang rindu, ya aku dong yang rindu. tapi kan aku rindu nya setiap saat tapi kenapa mimpi nya baru hari itu gitu lo? kamu rindu ya? terus maksud dari mimpi aku apa ya? apa peringatan dari mama kamu? dan aku juga sebelum tidur itu biasa nya doa tidur sama doa biar di mimpiin kamu, tapi hari itu gaada lo, kok bisa ya?. pemikiran aku, kita selalu dipertemukan waktu kamu mau naik ke sekolah yang berikut nya. misalnya 2022 itu kan kamu mau masuk smp, kelas 6. terus 2024 kamu mau naik sma, kelas 9. apa kita bakal dipertemukan lagi waktu kamu mau kuliah gitu? eh kamu nanti sabtu libur kan ya? pulang jam 4? ih lama banget. semangat my mantan calon pacar. i lav ya

if time and death were to separate us for a hundredth eclipse, know this: every fiber of my flesh, every thread of my soul, shadow, breath, and sweat has been woven solely for you. long before the gods cleansed my spirit and granted me rebirth—before they pressed their hands upon my wounds to make them bleed anew—understand that I am still—and only—yours.

before i was flesh, i was yours. before i was shadow, my very being belonged to you.

heaven must summon all my scattered pieces again, must mold me whole, until i am formed once more—my feet able to wander this vast earth in search of you. and should i be born again in another world, in another time, with no feet to stand upon, then i shall crawl across every land, skin and bone aching only for the graceful touch of your hand, for the constellations you plant upon my face.

my dearest, Kai, i will find you—wherever, whenever you may exist. i shall not rest. i shall not cease to die and be reborn until i do. until we awaken in a world where nothing can sever our souls again. not time. not death. not even fate.

even if heaven collapses and empires are reduced to ash. even if the sun melts in the sky and the moon bleeds itself dry—my existence shall remain, and it shall end only when it melts into your embrace.

without you, i do not live—i merely exist. life shall begin the moment i fall into your arms. and when i do, let the gaps between your fingers be filled—forever—with mine.

loving you endlessly,

message:
Hi,

Making this letter for you is a bit awkward, but I really like you — for about several months now, maybe 8 months? I lost count because I wasn’t really sure about my feelings before, but I’m sure now. Liking you is fun. Magtan-aw sa imong dula, nya kapunay mo madaog, makes my heart proud — samot na adtong ikaw ang na-MVP and kamo ang champion overall sa midget.

I really am bad at expressing my feelings, but I’ll try for you. I know wa koy chance, but just so you know, I would definitely treat you better than your past. I would reassure you, love you loudly, would post you in my socials, make time for you, would communicate para we could understand each other, and would even dump my guy friends so you could feel nga ikaw ra gyud ang akoang ginalove.

I tried liking other guys to distract myself from the fact nga wala koy chance nimo, pero it doesn’t really work in the end. Kapunay gyud ko mangita nimo. Whenever I am at a place nga maka-huna-huna ko nga naa ka, pangitaon jud tika — especially if basketball court, because I know you really enjoy and love playing that sport.

I love cheering for you, by the way, pero silently lang, because I can’t compare to those people nga gina-admire sad ka — nya daghan kaayo hahahaha 😓. I never got the courage nga mo-express sa akoang feelings para sa imo because I know it wouldn’t work, because daghan kaayog makaangay nimo, and I definitely cannot compete with that — especially kay mga gwapa sila.

I had a dream about you last night. It felt real kay ikaw ug imong nawng jud mismo nakit-an nako, ga suot kas saninang green nga gi suot nimo kadtong ni dung kag crus dako, and mao nay first time nga niabot kas damgo nako hahahaha. I think about you halos everyday. Whenever mosimba ko, dili jud nako malimtan nga i-pray ka nako ni Lord, because I worry about your safety the most — how you are doing right now, and if okay ba ka.

I hope this letter finds you, and I pray nga you would succeed in life despite difficulties, and imong ipadayon imong passion sa basketball. I’m here to support you, and I love you.

Take care, Mr. Captain Ball!

First and foremost, I'm not that bijak pandai as you said, I gave my blood, sweat and tears for this result.  I had to sacrifice a lot just to secure these straight A’s because I knew that I wasn’t like the others who could study last minute and still do well. I wasn’t born with that luxury.  I stayed up when everyone else was sleeping, I studied when others were having fun, and I let go of a lot of things along the way especially this love shit thingy, cause I know that each stupid thing I did will mess up my daily routine n focus. I distanced myself from things that didn’t serve my purpose n waste my time. I have something bigger to chase and SPM was one of the stepping stones to get there. 

And let me just say this, I didn’t walk this journey alone. Every single person I was close to throughout this SPM journey played a huge role in my life. Aku terhutang budi dengan each person yang tolong aku throughout this journey tak kisahlah sis ke bro even lecturers sekalipun.  Every subject had someone I turned to, someone who explained, guided, and helped me understand the things I couldn’t grasp on my own. I would never have made it this far without them. They deserve every bit of success they get.

We live in a community. We survive by helping each other. I hate it when people easily assume someone tak jaga batas just because they see us interacting or working together. Don’t be quick to judge. I know what I did. I know the boundaries I set. And as long as no sis or no lecturer ever said I crossed the line, then I am at peace with my actions. You don’t know the full story and kau hanya dengar from other people's mouths, so don’t act like you know the whole thing. 

At the end of the day, we all have different paths. Kau ada jalan kau sendiri, aku pun ada jalan aku. Kau ada rezeki kau, aku pun ada rezeki aku. And I sincerely, from the bottom of my heart, I pray the best for you. Just because someone didn’t shine during SPM doesn’t mean they’re doomed forever. 

I truly believe that everyone in our batch is destined to become someone meaningful, someone who will benefit the ummah in their own unique way. Some may take a longer route, some may bloom later, but we’re all heading toward our own version of greatness. So keep going, and don’t ever think your worth is tied to a piece of paper. You’re worth so much more than that.

I’ve rewritten this letter so many times in my head, trying to find the right words, the ones that might reach you through all the silence that’s grown between us. The truth is, I don’t know if any words can undo the hurt I caused but I hope they can at least help you understand how sorry I am, and how much I still care.
Losing you has left a space in my heart that I haven’t been able to fill. You were more than just my best friend— you were my sister. I let my relationship pull me away from the one person who had been there through everything. I didn’t mean to make you feel like you didn’t matter. But I know I did, and I’m so sorry.

I wish I had done things differently. I wish I had fought harder to keep our friendship and not let love blind me to the value of someone who had already proven their loyalty a thousand times over.
Know that I still think of you. Every day. In memories, in music, in pictures. I miss you. I miss us. And even though I might not deserve another chance, I would be there in a heartbeat if you ever wanted to talk or find a way back to each other.
Whatever you choose, I’ll always be grateful for what we had. You helped shape who I am. I will always carry that with me.

With love, always,

in my old school i was always bullied and people always beat me up but ever since i move to cambridge collage i met jack and he changed my life.

"Best happy birthday!" Jack said as he gave me a rose. "Aww.thanks Jack! your the best", "i know right","so lets go?", "okay"...

as Jack and I were walking home he suddenly held my head looking all sad or whatever.. "is there a problem jack?", "no but.. i just wanna say that.. i. cant promise that i will be on your next birthday" Jack sighed as he looked down, "well.. why is that?", "ahmm.. theres something", "you sure u dont wanna tell me? so i can help?", "yea im sure", "okay".....

I wonder what Jack's reason.. oh wells time for celebrating!

as days passed.. Jack is starting to get paler and paler and his grades are becoming lower... "hey whats going on jack?", "CASSIE!" Jack shouted and hugged me and started tearing up. whats up with him.. "woah. calm down 1", "im sorry, im just gonna miss you".. "jack..? wha-", "promise me that you will never forget me", "JACK I" i shouted as Jack started to shut his mouth. "u have to tell me I whats going on?", "I-1-" "Bell ring" "you?", "oh look bell ring! see u in chemistry lesson" Jack excused and started walking away.. omg im so curious!

*1 year later (Cassie's 16th birthday)"

Finally the day i've been waiting for | My Sweet 16 Birthday Party | Now i just have to find Jack.. i hope he can come to the party.. "hey guys, have u seen jack?", "no sorry", "oh thanks anyways"... not anywhere again? his been absent for 2 weeks already.. what happend to that guy ! "CASSIE!"

..... Jack..?? oh.. its just mark.. "oh hey wutsup mark", "ur mom just called and said u have to go home now", "oh okay! thanks for telling me", "no problem"

i ran home to check what happend. as i reached home.. and opened the door

"HAPPY BIRTHDAY CASSIE I" all my Visitors Shouted.. i almost cry for joy i couldnt thank them but.. still no presence of Jack.. i searched for him while my mom starts cooking the food. "Cassie!" Oh jacks's mom is here !!! "hello, Aunt precious, where is Jack?", "ahmmm...Don havnt You told her?"... "tell me what ?..", "Darling.. Here is something to make you understand" Uncle Don hand me a paper and told me to read it looking all sad and start to tear up abit. (the paper)

"Dear Cassie,

Remember when i told you that i couldnt come to your birthday?.. well now you'll know why.. its because.. "sigh".. Cassie.. i have a brain cancer, and the doctor said that my life will last for 1 year and 3 weeks.. i wish i could say goodbye properly but.. i guess it was abit too late so i thought of writing this to you.. Cassie Promise me you'll take care of my mom and dad never let your eyes outta them. Your the only that i can trust to keep an eye on my parents. please take care of them and also.. im sorry i couldnt come to your sweet 16th birthday party.. but dont worry i still have my gift :) its on your closet. Im happy that i got to know you, i'll miss you Cass.. so much.. there there, stop your crying, its your birthday! be happy..! I love you bestfriend... Goodbye"

Heart beat Raise, Tears fall, feelings hurt, Broken heart. thats what i felt when i read the paper. MY BESTFRIEND IS DEAD? HOW COULD YOU LEAVE ME JACK !? you promised me we both will graduate together! ou promised me you'll stay old with me ! AND NOW YOUR LEAVING ?!!.... I ran upstairs to check my closet. And there was a portrait of Me and Him holding hands on my 15th birthday.. i hugged the picture so tightly as i began shouting! Jack! Why ?! I love you jack I please come backk !!! please jack.. "knock off

(next day)

I woke up on my parents bedroom while my dog Shakir was licking my face. my mom told me to wear my White dress to go to Jack's funeral.. I cant believe it Jack.. your finally happy.....

(Graduation day)

*Speech"

Untukmu, yang Penuh Luka
Aku pernah melihatmu,
bukan dengan mata… tapi dengan hati.
Aku tahu kamu menyimpan banyak hal—
luka, kecewa, kemarahan yang tidak pernah sempat kamu tunjukkan.
Kamu diam… tapi aku bisa mendengar hatimu berteriak minta didekap.
Dan aku ingin sekali ada untukmu.
Aku ingin jadi tempatmu bersandar,
menjadi ruang yang aman untuk semua luka yang tak bisa kamu ceritakan.
Tapi semakin aku mendekat,
aku sadar—aku pun belum sembuh sepenuhnya.
Dan jika dua jiwa yang sama-sama hancur saling bergantung,
bukan pulih yang terjadi…
tapi hancur bersama-sama, perlahan.

Bukan karena aku tidak peduli.
Bukan karena aku berhenti ingin merangkulmu.
Tapi karena aku sadar,
cinta bukan soal menyelamatkan seseorang dengan mengorbankan diri sendiri.

Jadi aku memilih pergi.
Bukan untuk meninggalkanmu… tapi untuk menjaga kita berdua.
Dan percayalah,
setiap langkah menjauh darimu adalah perjuangan paling berat yang pernah aku ambil.
Aku tahu kamu tidak akan melihat ini.
Tapi biarkan semesta menjadi saksi:
Aku mencintaimu, dalam bentuk yang paling sunyi dan dewasa.
Bukan dengan memiliki, tapi dengan melepaskan.
Semoga kamu suatu hari nanti bertemu pelukan yang kamu butuhkan.
Pelukan yang mampu menyembuhkanmu tanpa membuatmu merasa kecil.
Dan saat itu datang, aku akan tersenyum—meski dari jauh.
Sebab kau pantas bahagia.
Dan aku… sedang belajar bahagia juga, tanpa kamu. Meski terkadang aku berharap orang yang menjadi penyembuh mu adalah aku

Yang pernah ingin menjadi rumahmu,
Tapi akhirnya harus jadi kenangan.

To anyone who cares to know…

I’m tired.

Not the kind of tired that sleep can fix, but the kind that sits deep in your soul—the kind that weighs you down even when you’re trying your best to stand tall. These past days, weeks, maybe even months, have been a whirlwind of responsibilities I didn’t always ask for, but still carried with grace—or at least tried to.

Academics are suffocating. Deadlines, expectations, the pressure to perform—it never stops. Then there’s SSLG, publication work, and all the things people praise me for being involved in… but they don’t know what it takes. They don’t know how much of myself I pour into everything. And when I finally get a chance to pause, I’m left with nothing in the tank—burnt out, running on empty.

And then… there’s home.

The place that should give me peace is also where I’m starting to feel the most pain. It breaks my heart when the people closest to me begin to doubt me—my abilities, my intentions, my heart. I know I mess up sometimes. I know I can’t always explain everything. But it hurts deeply when their faith in me starts to fade, especially when I’m doing everything I can, even at the expense of my own well-being.

To the one who always listens—I’m sorry.

You see the real me, the raw and chaotic version. The one who feels too much, thinks too hard, and breaks in silence. I know I can be too much sometimes, and not enough other times. Thank you for staying. Thank you for listening when my words are messy, when my emotions are tangled, when I can’t even understand myself.

This is the real me.

Chaotic. Problematic. Exhausted. But still trying.

I smile, I joke, I show up for everyone else… but behind that smile is a storm I keep fighting. I keep hoping that maybe—just maybe—if I hold on a little longer, things will get better. Maybe the weight will lift. Maybe I’ll feel like myself again.

Until then, please know this:

I’m not okay, but I’m still here.
And for now, maybe that’s enough.

— Me

I was going home from school at around 7 or 8 at night. It had been a long day and I was exhauted. For some weird reason that I couldn't explain, I felt like someone I loved was close by or in danger. Suddenly, I hear a scream from INSIDE one of the tombs in the cemetary.

Instantly, I knew who it was: Angell

The one person in this entire world who actually gave a crap about me. The one person who I loved more than life itself. I han't seen him in a week and there had been a rumor that he had died and I'd been going through depression. (Which was probably the reason why I was walking through a cemetary instead of though the sidewalk like NORMAL people.)

I knew it was him, I just knew it.

I ran though all of the tombs until I thought li hear the thought directly under me.

It had his name on it but didn't have theyear or the day or anything of when he had died. Apparently, I had just discovered that he wasn't even dead.

I had no tools so I had to use my hands to dig up as much dirt as I could. I knew he only had a limited time before he ran out of air.

I dug up half of the grave when I collapsed to the ground.

"Don't worry, my love. I'm gonna get you out of there!" I had to scream to make sure that he heard me.

After I had gotten to his casket, it was silent. No screams from him or any signs of him even being alive.

I was terrified about what I might find inside of it.

I opened the casket and, laying there, was Angel. His eyes were closed and his nails full of blood.

In his hands, there was a note that said my name on it. I took it from his hands, letting my tears spill freely. It was a letter telling the reason why he was there, buried alive with not enough air.

My dearest love,

You might never find this note, and I pray that you do. I'm here in this grave and I died rying to protect you. I sacrificed my own life to save yours. Evil men were after you. They called me and told me if I wanted you to live, I had to sacrifice myself. I loved you so much that I accepted the deal. I hope you are alive and well and that you will not be horrified by what you are seeing. I hope you never forget the love that we had and I want you to know that I will always remember you. Even if I'm not with you in my physical state, just know that I will always be smiling down on you from heaven. Always know that I loved you deeply and as I told you so many times before: I would die for you than ever see you die in front of me. I guess now we know that I did love you more than life itself. I'll be waiting for you when you cross the most beautiful gates ever. I love you!

Sincerely,

Your Guardian ANGEL.

Hey, I know I unfriended and unfollowed you on all my socials, but I was going to add you back the next day. Then I found out that you had already blocked me on everything. I know it was super wrong of me to ghost you like that without even trying to explain the real reason.

Yesterday, when you screamed “GHOSTERR!” I almost cried right on the spot. I couldn’t even move. I was too stunned that you screamed at me like that. That was also the first time I saw you mad, and the worst part is, you were mad at me. I know it’s my fault that you’re super mad at me, but ghosting you wasn’t easy. Since the day I did that, I’ve been constantly thinking about what I did. It makes me cry every time. I don’t like hurting other people’s feelings. Knowing the fact it's your feelings I was hurting. 

When I saw you at SM, I was thinking whether to talk to you or not, but I couldn’t do it. The real reason I didn’t want to confront you was because I was scared. I was afraid you’d see me as someone who's really insecure.

I know you told me you’ve moved on from Jasmine, but I still feel like you haven’t. You're still friends with her, and when Mandy asked you, “What’s your type?” you said, “I can show you an ex.” That deeply hurt me and made me wonder, “Does he really like me?” I felt really insecure when you said that, not because I think I’m ugly or anything, but because I’m the complete opposite of her.

I also didn’t want you to stop talking to her since she’s your “GBF since childhood,” and I know you wouldn’t stop being friends with her just because I said so, especially since I don’t even have the right to ask, considering we’re not even together. Cuz What even are we, bru?

It also felt like you only wanted me because you couldn’t get her. You even mentioned her to a random you just met. And the day you talked to Mandy, I was thinking that maybe you really don’t like me that much, since other girls get your attention. You also had no plans on telling me that she was talking to you. She was clearly badmouthing me, and yet you were still talking to her. You even agreed to have streaks with her. If I hadn’t asked, I wouldn’t have even known. Maybe that’s when I started treating you more like a friend and made myself believe that I didn’t really like you. I have so much to say, but I can’t seem to find the right words. I’m saying this not because I want you to pity me, but because I think you deserve to know.

I’m sorry, but here are just some things in my mind that I can’t bring myself to tell you, even if I want to. I’m really sorry for what I did. I love you. I’m sorry.

Hi Inigo,
Thank you.
Thank you for all the love you gave me, in ways big and small. Thank you for every moment you looked at me like I mattered, for every time you made me feel like I was enough—even if just for a little while. I’ve been holding all these feelings inside, trying to make sense of everything, and maybe I never really will. But what I do know is that I loved you. And I still do.

Thank you for giving a piece of yourself to me, even if you didn’t mean to. Even if you didn’t see me the way I saw you. For me, those two months weren’t just “something”—they were everything. Every message, every call, every shared silence meant the world to me. I replay them in my head sometimes, wishing I could go back. Wishing I could hold on just a little longer.

I hope you find someone new someday—someone who sees you the way I did. Someone who will love you with everything they have, with no conditions, no doubts, just pure love. The kind of love I tried to give you, even if it wasn’t enough. Even if I wasn’t enough. And maybe she’ll be luckier than I was. Maybe she’ll get to stay.

You’re still my greatest love, Inigo. That hasn’t changed, even after everything I’ve heard. And yes, some of those things broke my heart. Things that made me question if any of it was real, if I ever truly mattered to you. But despite the pain, I can’t bring myself to hate you. I don’t even want to. That’s how much I loved you. That’s how much I still do.

I don’t understand how someone can love so deeply and still be forgotten so easily. It hurts, Inigo. It hurts that you denied I was ever your girlfriend, as if I was just someone passing by—just another face. But to me, you were never just anyone. You were everything. And losing you felt like losing a part of myself I’ll never get back.

Still… I’m grateful. Grateful for the chance to love you, even if it was one-sided at times. Grateful for the memories, even if they now bring more tears than smiles. I loved you with a heart that had never loved like that before, and maybe never will again.

This is the last message I’ll send. Not because I’ve stopped caring—but because I have to let go. For my own peace. I want you to take care of yourself, always. Please don’t forget to be kind to yourself. Don’t lose the goodness in your heart—the same goodness that made me fall for you in the first place.

Good luck on your high school journey. I hope it teaches you more about life, love, and yourself. I’ll keep my distance now, but I know I’ll still see you from afar—maybe at church, maybe somewhere else. I’ll just smile quietly and remember what we had… or at least what I thought we had.

You were my answered prayer once. And even though you’re no longer mine, you’ll always have a place in my heart.
-Sammi

to, Aisy 

Funny how it all started, Aisy. The first time I saw you was at the dojang when you came to pick up your little brother. I was just one of the coaches, and you were just another face passing by. I didn’t think anything of it, just another fleeting moment. But then somehow we met again, of all places, on Mobile Legends. I actually thought you were a guy at first, and one of your friends who trained with me recognized me. That’s how we ended up following each other on IG and eventually meeting in real life. That first meeting wasn’t anything special. I was only interested in your bike. At that time, I didn’t care about you or anyone really. I was cold, detached, completely in my own world. But you didn’t stop. You kept messaging me, teasing me, sending reels, asking me to play ML. You even made that silly 100-day challenge, saying if you couldn’t make me fall for you, I’d block you. But I didn’t block you. I never did. Somehow, without realizing it, I started liking you too. We were never official, never really called it anything, but we were more than friends. We were something warm, something close. Then suddenly, without warning, we ended. Just like that. No reason, no closure. Back to strangers again. Still, I remember you. Because in a world I kept closed off, you found a way in. You made me feel something, and that meant something. So thank you, for the short chapter we shared. I hope you’re doing okay, wherever you are now.

So yuns, this might be the last letter I ever write for you. I’ve already said everything my heart could possibly hold. I’ve said goodbye more times than I wanted to. In messages, in my head, in the quiet parts of the night. Each one felt like it would be the last. Each one never was. Pero now… I’m writing this with a heart that knows it has to stop trying to hold on. Loving you has started to hurt more than it heals. There’s something sad about knowing someone so deeply, only to have to say goodbye to them over and over again. Like rehearsing pain until it becomes part of who you are. But now pagod na po ako, love.
Not of you, never of you. Just of the ache of almost, of maybe, of what if. You were something real to me. You are something real.
A memory that breathes inside me. A story that began gently, beautifully, and ended far too soon. I’ve cried for you in silence. Wrote words I could never send. Wished for you in every version of the sky. But I can’t keep standing in the middle of what used to be,
hoping you’ll come back, or that time would rewind itself just for us.

This is my last goodbye, not just in words, but in spirit. Kasi you deserve someone who doesn’t have to fight time and distance to love you. And I deserve peace. I will always be grateful for you. For the days we laughed.
For the times we held each other in ways no one else ever did. For how you allowed me to see your soul, even the wounded parts.
For how we made a home out of places and moments and feelings. Thank you for being that person in my life. I won’t try to unlove you. That’s not how I heal. I will carry you gently in the softest part of my heart, not to hold on, but to remember. I won’t say I’ll forget. I won’t say I’ll stop caring. But I will stop chasing something that’s already gone.

This is the last goodbye. Wherever you are, I hope you’re okay. I hope you’re safe. I hope you find the kind of peace you gave me, even if just for a little while. Goodbye, bebi. Thank you for being a chapter in my life I’ll never wish away.

Hi. I still remember the first time we met. It was quiet. Awkward actually. Like two people trying to speak in a language neither of them fully understood. We struggled to talk, to connect. But even then, something inside me felt warm. It wasn't perfect, but it was real.
I didn’t know then how much you'd come to mean to me. But I was already thankful.
Thankful that I got the chance to meet you. Then came our second date. A little easier. A little softer. We laughed more. Talked more.
You helped me carry my bag. You gave me a bracelet. You lend me your umbrella. You paid for my fare without saying much, like it was the most natural thing in the world. And for the first time, we had a real conversation, maikli, yes, but it stayed with me. You stayed with me. And then… yung third. Valentine’s Day. You gave me a flower made out of spicy Kimnori and chocolate. It wasn’t about how grand it was, it was the way you thought about it, made it, gave it to me even if we barely spoke that day. Your silence didn’t make it less meaningful. I saw how genuine you are. And I appreciated every bit of it. Simula palang yon. The first three memories,  is simple, soft, pero enough na siya to plant something deep in me. What followed after was everything. Every moment we spent.
From holding your hand for the first time, to those long, warm hugs, that made me feel like nothing could ever go wrong. To walking side by side from the mini forest to Barasoain,
to sitting quietly sa bench sa gilid ng church.
Those places became ours. Sanctuaries where time paused and I felt safe. I remember our small talks, sometimes nonsense, sometimes dreams. I remember how we’d laugh, play, tease, and how we’d fall into silence and still feel close. Even yubg hard parts, misunderstandings, we tried to meet them softly. We listened. We stayed. We communicated. We chose each other, even kahit hindk madali. Barasoain became more than just a place. It became a memory.
A witness to the love we built slowly, quietly, carefully. And now… every time I pass it, I feel everything all over again. Not just pain, but the warmth, the comfort, the version of us that felt like home.

Raine, I loved the way you made me feel.
You made the world lighter, even when everything else felt heavy. I loved the way you opened up to me, how you let me see the parts you usually kept hidden. Even the wounded parts. Especially those. You trusted me with your quiet, your hurt, your depth. I was honored just to be there. Just to see you.
And kahit ngayon, even with everything that’s happened, I’m still thankful. Still happy I met you. Hindi mag babagi yon. But sometimes, even the most beautiful things have to end.
And I think… this is where ours does. If I were to answer honestly, yes, I regret something.
I regret that I had to choose between two painful things. To stay and hold on… or to let go and lose you. It was never easy. To end meant erasing everything, waking up each day without you, pretending I’m okay with it.
To continue meant having you, but never being able to hold you again. Never being able to run to you, to hug you after a long day. It meant constant aching. Bata pa tayo, Raine.
And love like this, as real as it is, can be heavy when the world keeps trying to pull it apart. I’m sorry for choosing to end it. Maybe I’ll regret it forever. But maybe… maybe it’s a pain that will make sense someday. 

Earlier, I wished for rain. So badly.
Because I thought, kapag umalan, maybe.... I’ll see you one more time. Maybe fate would be kind enough to give me a last look. And it did. But nung nakita kita, there was something heavy in the air. Something we both felt but never said out loud. We looked at each other like strangers wearing old hearts. I’m sorry for overstepping your boundaries. I know I shouldn’t have wanted to hug you. But I couldn’t stop myself.
Because part of me still hoped. Still wanted to feel all of you, one last time, even if it would tear me apart. I’m sorry if I annoyed you.
I just didn’t know how to keep you close,
even if just for a moment more. Ang hirap… loving someone who isn’t yours anymore.
It’s harder pretending I don’t still care. But know this, Raine, no matter how far we end up, no matter who we become,
a part of me will always carry you. Not in bitterness. Not in regret. But in quiet, soft memory. You were real. You were mine, even if it's just for a while. And that will always mean something to me. I love you. I probably still will for a long, long time.

There are so many things I have to say and say sorry for, and that's exactly why I'm making this letter.

First of all, i'm sorry for not providing further explanation about why I was breaking up with you. I gave you details, yes because you deserved to know. But no matter how i push myself behind my screen, I can't let out the whole reason. Is it selfless to say I'd rather keep the hurt to myself, just so you can experience less? But even so, what I did cannot be justified by any means, and if I can compensate for it I'm any way, I would.

Second of all, i'm sorry for adding up to your worries and emotional baggages. You were having problems with your father, and all I did was crush your heart even more. I was harsh, i'm sorry. My first thought was that it would be better if you were to hate me if only it meant for you to move on easier. But as i was texting messages to you that afternoon, hindi ko kinaya. Hindi ko kaya.

I know that everything wrong I did cannot be justified, and if you ever feel mad at me, that is completely understandable. I hated myself for breaking up with you, but even more when I think of HOW I did it in the first place. Whatever you may be feeling towards me, I hope you know that no matter how much my situation was telling me to let you go, my heart refused hardly. It's only because I was given two choices. And when I pick one, the other would be gone. That two choices felt like the whole world put their weight in my shoulder; but I can't go against my family, no matter how much i wanted to.

And just because I let you go, doesn't mean that I wanted to. It's because I had to. This is only a brief explanation and a peak at the mountains of paragraphs I have and want to say to you. Doing this can help ease all the guilt and hatred I feel towards myself.

I love you, always in all ways, I hope you still remember. There is not a day that passes where I don't remember you in anything. From cats, donuts, fries, and even your favorite colours. I loved you, and without a doubt, still loving you.

— DJDL (You know me.)

heart racing. That was when I knew nahulog na ako, I've fallen in love. 
If only I could write everything I like about you, I would kaso nga lang kulang ng isang page para lang sakanya. She were beautiful like the stars That shine brightly in the night I have never thought I would fall to a person like her. Her beauty and personality was one of the reasons why I fell in love with. Everyday that passes by hulog na hulog. I just love that person and love that person more than my words could ever express. I didn’t even bothered to know who she were at first but look at me now, bilang hinahanap in the midst of the crowds. Hindi naman sya special sa puso ko noon but bigla itong nagbago isang araw. ykyk Then her feelings are always valid for me and always making sure to remember that. I've always wanted to say that "it's okay to be mad at them, to cry, and to distance yourself if they do something to you."
That she don't need to hide her feelings; she doesnt need to be sorry for having emotions. She's not even dramatic, overreacting, or sensitive that its okay to show it. 
like Always making sure to remember that her feelings are valid.  "It's okay to think of yourself first before others. You're not selfish; you are just choosing yourself first your happiness, your peace of mind. "
am willing to love that person you until the end of the universe. Because, you love that person ofc, the way loving it so much that | can’t even love myself. 
I am willing to take all the risk just for you but at what cost, yes you love that person more than myself. If i could give you one thing in life i would give you an ability to see yourself through my eyes only, then you will realize how special she are to me. 
because you think that person should deserve all the love in this world, you deserve all the cares in this world. You deserve all the things in this world. that why  it comes to a point where  all u can say is please please you should rest even though I am the one who's getting tired, thought u should always rest at me" type shit 
If someone asked me why u love that person, I wouldn't know how to answer. First, because there are too many “whys" to mention. Second, my love to that person goes beyond reasons. It resides somewhere between loving that person on purpose and loving you for simply being you. As they said in the movie Set it Up, "You like because, and you love despite. You like someone because of all of their qualities, and you love someone despite some of their qualities.” 
 
If held at gunpoint, I'd say u love that person because her voice feels like an angel.I could listen to that persons voice for the rest of my life. if that world would turn into a gig she would be my favorite set, and everyone else would just fade into background noise. in the quiet corners of my heart, there exists a love that dares not speak its name. Because if I let it to, it will surely just shout one name, a name that belongs to her of course . Isn't  it funny that ang mga taong nating nagugustuhan ay ang mga taong wala tayong pag-asa. but I would choose  that once in a blue moon type of chance, but mukhang mas posible pa ang katagang "suntok sa buwan" sa kanya

Because of that fact, I'd rather love that person in silence than shoot my shot and lose. For in silence, there is no rejection, no sorrows, no moving on. It may be a little bittersweet at times, for heaven knows that I have a collection of all my unspoken letters for her, but I know this sadness won't last. Ano ba naman kasing karapatan kong malungkot gayong wala naman tayong nasimulan? 
However, there are times when this deafening silence still tries to find its way out of my lungs and shout. Shout and tell you all the genuine feelings hidden deep inside my heart. Because a part of me is still hoping, a hope that someday, somehow, the truth will reveal itself and will no longer try to hide in the sanctuary of darkness. 
But until then, this silent will continue to hold onto her token of affection, to admire you from afar, and to love that person in silence 
And that Person is You MeyAnn       
 
From C

(before reading this play wither by frank ocean on youtube)In our corner of lake, somewhere between day and night, I remember you in my red shirt that wasn’t yours but somehow looked better that way. December air clung to your sleeves, your hair smelled like fabric softener and cold wind, and your mom laughed from the doorway, called you Boldstar while you did the laundry with a grin that didn’t quite reach your eyes. The moment folded itself into me, half mundane, half magic. Just you, shirt oversized, sleeves too long.

We weren’t much for greetings. I’d show up, and you’d open the door like you knew I was already behind it. You never asked why I came, and I never explained. Familiarity made words optional. That night you leaned your head on my shoulder, not like the movies do, no swell of music, no grand line to follow it up. Just you, quiet, heavy. Tears warming my skin, your breath unsteady like your heart didn’t know where to land. I didn’t say anything. My hand just rested on your knee and the side of your head, steady, waiting for you to come back from wherever your thoughts had taken you.

And maybe I was never meant to follow you there. Maybe I was just meant to be the place you could rest for a moment.

seeing you crying sometimes, unexpected, like lightning in an open sky. In the back of the room when the others were laughing. Or at the edge of a bench we shared, or the floor we shared, but just space we made feel like home for a little while. You wiped your tears before anyone else could notice, but I noticed. I always noticed. And I hated how beautiful you looked even then, when the world didn’t deserve your softness, when you let it show anyway.

Some nights, I walk pretending the breeze could bring me back to that version of us. The one where we stayed quiet but understood. Where the things unsaid still filled the room louder than anything else. And when I pass through places where your laughter once echoed, behind school buildings, sidewalks, I wonder if you remember too. If the red shirt still lives? Does the lipstick still feel right? If the shoulder you cried on still makes its way into your dreams?

I replay it all like a film I can’t stop watching. You turning back to glance at me when I thought you were gone for good. The bench. Your fingers holding mine, the kiss we shared. I wonder if those were accidents or if you meant for me to remember them exactly like I do now. Like breadcrumbs you dropped, maybe to lead me somewhere that we felt the weight of each other long enough to leave a mark.

We never said goodbye. Maybe that’s why I still write.

I know starting this letter feels impossible.  The words "I'm sorry" feel inadequate, hollow even, compared to the pain I caused you. But I have to try.  Please, bear with me.
 
What I did was unforgivable.  There isn't a single day that goes by where I don't replay it all in my head, the hurt I inflicted on you, the trust I shattered.  And yes, the thought of the pain coming back to me—the karma—is a constant, heavy weight.  It haunts me, and I know parts of you, the memories of us, will always be a part of me, a constant reminder of my mistakes.
 
I didn't think.  I didn't consider the long-term consequences of my actions, the deep emotional wounds I was creating. You may think it was your trust I broke, but it was my own selfishness, my own insecurities that led me to treat you so poorly. I took you for granted, Gayle, assuming your love and loyalty were inexhaustible.  I was wrong.  Terribly, devastatingly wrong.  The promises I made, the promises I broke—they're a testament to my immaturity, my inability to commit to something real and beautiful.  The pain of knowing I lost you, that I let you go, is a constant ache in my chest.  You were open and proud of us, and I hid you away, a secret shame.  Remember that time you wanted me to meet your kuya?  My refusal wasn't just fear; it was a deep-seated terror, a self-sabotaging instinct that I now recognize as a symptom of my own issues.  That was the turning point, the moment I started pulling away, burying myself in my own anxieties.  It felt like a crushing weight, Gayle, a suffocating anchor instead of the safety and comfort it should have been.
 
I didn't fight for us. I was weak, self-absorbed, only concerned with my own pain, oblivious to the magnitude of yours. I made decisions without you, silencing your voice, ignoring your needs.  I was selfish, Gayle, utterly and completely selfish.  I didn't give you what you deserved—everything—only what I was capable of giving at the time.  I should have said you deserved better than me, that I needed to become better for you, not that I couldn't change. I should have been the one to change, to become worthy of your love, not someone else.
 
I was harsh, cold even.  The way I'd let go of your hand in crowds, the way I guarded myself against your touch—it wasn't just physical distance; it was emotional distance.  I saw you reaching for me, longing for intimacy, and I pulled away, requiring more from you than I should have.  You deserved to feel secure, to feel loved freely and openly.  And the gifts...your generous gifts made me feel small, inadequate.  I kept mine, hoping you'd forget, but that was just more of my selfishness, my insecurity.  I tried to be someone I wasn't, to be like the women you admired, thinking that would fill the void, make me enough.  It never did.  I overthought everything, never communicating, never expressing my fears, my jealousy, my deep, deep care for you.  I let my insecurities and my ego dictate my actions, driving a wedge between us.  I was terrified of letting your friends see me, of letting them see the real, flawed me.  And I was wrong.  So, so wrong.  I took your happiness, Gayle.  I stole it from you.
 
You didn't ask for much, my love.  Love, attention, time, effort—the bare minimum.  Yet, I failed to provide even that.  It's the foundation of any relationship, and ours lacked it from the beginning.  It was a vicious cycle, and it wasn't your fault.  You tried, you always tried, but I kept running away.  I understand how exhausting it must have been, how emotionally draining.  That's why I don't want you to chase me.  I want you to run, Gayle, to find your own happiness, your own freedom.  And when you reach the finish line, I hope you're prouder and happier than ever before.  If our paths never cross again, I will always wish you the best.
 
I'm changing, Gayle.  I'm working on myself, becoming a better person. I will cherish my next relationship, treat my partner like the invaluable treasure you were.  And I will never forget the lessons I learned, the pain I caused, and the woman who taught me what it means to truly love and be loved. 
 
Thank you, Gayle.  From the bottom of my heart, thank you.

Di lain waktu.
Di waktu yang lebih tepat.
Saat aku tak lagi perlu menyembunyikan rasa. Dan kamu… tak lagi terikat pada siapa-siapa.

I don’t even know where to begin, because no words ever feel enough to describe what I still feel for you — what we still feel for each other. What we had wasn’t perfect, but it was real. It is real. That love, the one we built through distance, time, longing, and faith — it still lives in me. And deep down, I believe that it still lives in you too.

We didn’t part ways because we stopped loving. We didn’t break up because we didn’t care. In fact, we ended things with love still in our hearts. And that’s the hardest kind of goodbye — the kind where love stays, but circumstances don't.

I understand why you had to step away. I know it wasn’t easy for you either. There were things in your life — heavy, complicated, overwhelming — that I couldn’t fix, no matter how badly I wanted to. But I never held that against you. I never blamed you. I never will. Because loving you also means respecting your struggles, your healing, and your silence.

But here’s what I need you to know, and I pray you carry this in your heart whenever the world feels too loud, too heavy:
I’m still here.

Not just as someone from your past. Not just as an “ex.” I’m still here as someone who loves you. Someone who still thinks of you when the nights get quiet. Someone who still finds you in the lyrics of sad songs and in the spaces between words I never say. Someone who, despite the distance, still chooses you in silence, every single day.

And truthfully… I miss you.
I miss you more than I ever expected to. I miss our conversations, your laughter, your thoughts, even your rants. I miss the way we made each other feel a little less alone in this world. I miss being the one you turned to when life felt like too much. I miss you — your soul, your softness, your strength.

If you ever feel tired — emotionally, mentally, even spiritually — please come to me. Talk to me. Cry to me. You don’t need to have the right words. You don’t even need to make sense. You can just be, and I’ll be here. Not to judge. Not to fix. Just to hold space for you. Just to remind you that someone still cares enough to sit with your pain, even from far away.

Maybe we’re not together now, but my heart hasn’t closed its door to you. I still carry you in every quiet prayer, in every moment I wish things were different, in every “what if” I whisper to myself at night. And in all of that… I still miss you.

I’m not waiting out of hope for something to change overnight. I’m just loving you the way real love should — quietly, gently, and freely. With no pressure. No timelines. No expectations. Just presence. Just care. Just me — still here, still yours, in a way that love allows when it’s deep and true.

And maybe someday… when God’s perfect time finally comes, our paths will cross again — no more distance, no more holding back, no more bad timing. Maybe one day, everything we hoped for will finally be possible. Not rushed, not forced — just beautifully aligned by His plan.

But until then, please remember this:
I’m still here.
Still cheering for you in silence.
Still loving you in prayers.
Still hoping for your healing, your peace, and your happiness — whether or not it leads back to me.

You’ll always have a special place in my heart.
Always with love,

~ Lili

Mempertahankan seseorang yang membuatmu mempertanyakan dirimu sendiri yang membuatmu merasa berlebihan, yang memintamu untuk membungkam jiwamu itu adalah ketidakadilan terbesar yang bisa kamu berikan pada hatimu. Daripada memandang sebelah mata dirimu karena bertahan lebih lama daripada yang seharusnya, karena memberikan hati kepada orang-orang yang tidak mampu menjaganya daripada kecewa karena kamu menetap. rayakanlah fakta bahwa kamu telah membuka matamu pada segala sesuatu yang tidak menumbuhkanmu, rayakanlah fakta bahwa kamu memiliki keberanian dan kekuatan untuk menjawab. rayakanlah fakta bahwa sekarang kamu telah sadar. Jangan memilih cinta yang setengah-setengah, Jangan memilih seseorang yang tidak bisa menghargai hatimu. Orang-orang yang menjauhimu karena waktu yang tidak tepat adalah orang-orang yang tidak mau menjadikan waktu untukmu, jadi kala itu sebagai akhir dari kisahmu. Untuk itu maafkanlah dirimu yang telah memberikan hatimu kepada orang-orang yang tidak bisa mencintaimu ataupun menghargainya. Maafkanlah dirimu yang telah jatuh cinta kepada orang-orang yang salah, karena mereka sesungguhnya bukan orang yang salah kamu memang telah ditakdirkan untuk bertemu dengan mereka, untuk jatuh cinta kepada mereka, untuk mendapatkan pengalaman bersama mereka, dan untuk mendapatkan pelajaran dari sana. I decided to write this down because I know somehow I will forget again how it made me feel and continue to act as nothing ever happen between us. No, this is not a love letter like you used to write in the notes and shared to me consistently throughout our relationship. This is a letter of unsaid things that I wish one day it reach out to you. 

Never was my intention to disrespect the love that you gave and made you think that I took your love and loyalty for granted. I admit that it was my fault for letting you in, and I wish I wasnt in a rush to have you that time. I thought it was fine to have you when I, myself, not in a fully stable state of mind. But, I was wrong. I dragged you down together with me, emotionally and mentally. 

I know its unfair to you that WE happened and I’m sorry. I’m sorry it left you with scars that will take you forever to heal fully, and the regrets. I’m sorry for the person you’ve become now. I’m very sorry for every single thing I did that hurt you. I live with the guilt for 4 years bcus I thought my decision that day was for the best of us. Well, maybe yes. Or no…

I admit that I dont remember most of our relationship, unless it is written somewhere or there are trace of it happened. But, I do remember that you were the light that brought me out from deep darkest dungeon. You were there when I had no one in my life to rely on. You’ve seen my flaws more than anyone ever have. And you stayed. Till today, you are one of the blessings that Im always thankful for because, I am who I am now because of you. The positive traits, the kindness, the warm of love you showed and allow me to feel is now a big part of me that I shared with others, and deep down I wish you could have this version of me too.

After we broke up, every single day, I wish nothing but the best for you. To be sucessful in whatever you do, to shine the brightest everywhere you go, and to finally find someone that can give you the love that you always deserve. I was worried that our relationship left you traumatised and deep scars, and you might not believe in love anymore. But, the moment when you said you met some people after me, I was relieved. I was genuinely happy for you, although I don’t really understand why it stings a bit. But I’m happy that you continue to find the warm of love you always deserve, even after the hell I put you through. I hope the girls get to experience the purest form of love that I got when I was with you. Or maybe better. 

Within the years, there are times you come by in my dreams just to be there, silently. Often I brush it off and take it just as it is, nothing more. The idea of going back to you was never in my mind for the past 4 years, I even resented the idea of it whenever my friends brought it up, as I believe I am now at the better side of the world than I am before. However, this year is different. I finally pray and asked god to show me my fate. I told him that whoever it is right now, I am willing to accept with an open heart, even if it is you that I resented before. (I resented you not because I hate you, but it reminds me of my biggest loss) I am just desperately curious about it. And that when it all started to happen. The dreams getting more often, my feelings keep drawing me back to you, and the rest you know it. The more im holding myself back and refuse to accept this, more signs coming in and I just had to give in. Deep down I hope we can start all over again, and finally start this healthy love relationship and this time with both of us being in a healthy and stable state of mind. I cant help to also noticed the walls you put between us, you put your guards up, which I fully understand if you say you want to remain as it is. But again, I put my trust in god and let things go according to his plan. 

I learned my lesson, hence now I’m not going to rush things out. Maybe one day when this letter finally reach you; it could be soon or 6 years later? We never know. But whenever you’re ready to talk, you know where to reach me out.

The day i started talking to you was one of the happiest moments of my life. Never in my wildest dreams did i imagine i’d end up falling for someone i once tried to ignore- someone i had secretly admired all along. I still remember how it all started back in grade 8. We weren’t that close, but even then, the bond we formed was already something special- a treasure. The secret glances, the pangayog assignment, the shy questions i asked your friend about who your crush was, the small signs of admiration i tried to hide, all of it was real. And through those simple things, i found myself drawn to you more than i ever expected. I’ve always admired how you went to school with your mga manghod. Every time we were on the same multicab, i’d quietly wonder why you’d stop at the front entrance of the school and not the back. It wasn’t until later that i realized it was because of your brothers. That small act made me admire you even more. It showed me your heart- how deeply you care and how responsible you are. And then, there were the times you helped your mama by selling her paninda. I loved seeing how you managed your time, how you balanced everything without ever complaining. You were already showing me the kind of man you were, long before we became what we are now. There’s something i’ve always wanted to tell you, something i’ve mentioned many times but never fully said what makes me fall for you. Maybe now is the right time. Back then, there was this one classmate who made fun of my ears- how they aren’t symmetrical. It was one of my insecurities. Maybe you don’t remember it, but when he brought it up to you, you simply said, “sus ka, ikaw no sagdi na.” and in that moment, something changed in me. You were the first person who didn’t laugh at me. You didn’t make me feel small- you made me feel safe. And i’ve admired you that much ever since. When the pandemic began, we still talked from time to time, but i often pushed you away- i was scared. Eventually, we stopped talking. But you came back. At a time when i had already promised myself not to fall in love again- you came back. And just like that, you changed everything. You made me believe in love again. You made me feel the most beautiful girl, even when i couldn’t see it myself. You made me feel heard, seen, and understood. Love, i don’t want you to ever forget that you are loved, you are enough, and you are more than enough. I may not fully know your pain, but i want you to know- i’m here and i will always be here. Through the highs and the lows, i will stand by your side. No matter what life throws at us, i’ll never let go of your hand and i would still pick you up. Don’t ever let anyone make you feel less. You are strong- stronger than you even know. And i love you for that strength, for your kindness, your courage, and your beautiful soul. There’s still a long road ahead of us, my love. And if the journey ever feels too heavy, it’s okay to rest, just don’t give up. I’ll be right beside you, cheering you on every step of the way.
I love you always, my lirans. You are, and will always be, loved by me.

lately, my world's been in a state of monochrome—no sense of color, energy, nor spark of life. or is it still in the state of that up until now? 

dating back to July 15, Pisay EDGE commenced. deserving scholars from all over the region were clamped into four different groups—Group A, B, C1, and C2. i was sectioned to Group A, and as for my two fellow passers and best friends, got sectioned off to C2. These were based on our last names, in which mine started with the third letter of the alphabet. fast forwarding my life's movie tape, i survived the first week—knowing almost everyone in the group, except for some boys. one of the boys that i considered as my acquaintance back then was Francis Nicholai Cea Benitez. he wasn't certainly my friend but he definitely my caught my eye with his iconic red hat, his inside joke of "Slave Partylist", and his cute smile. having the bored persona, i joined without hesitation, right away designated as the party's treasurer. yet through all of that, my perspective of the world was still in the vision of black, gray, and white.

then came the second week, i was in the mindset of just trying to survive as i had a few breakdowns in the first week, and i had a few close calls for supposed "backlogs". i was lost in the sea of mixed emotions, asking myself whether i should pursue this school, considering my overall performance found within the two weeks of EDGE. i knew that i was lacking some kind of motivation but t'was too late for the program was bound to end in four days. but suddenly—July 26, 2024 at 8:47pm, one friend of mine sent me a "DepEd Memo", in fact, was not. it contained something that i did not expect—a statement that expressed someone's feelings for me. dumbfounded was i, i was happy and shocked at the same time. i didn't want to believe that easily so i placed it at the back of my mind. morning came and Hugo told me that someone had a crush on me—Nicholai. it confirmed my suspicions :)) i still wouldn't believe that someone liked me for me, but there we go.

a short era of my life ended, now taking over was the vast complexities and surprises of Philippine Science Highschool-BRC. I got picked to be an honored student of Emerald, while he got to be a part of Sapphire. surprisingly, i felt sad, AND I DIDN'T KNOW WHYY!? little did i know that i was developing feelings for him. day by day, as my feelings intensified, faded hues started to appear. was he really going to bring back my sense to live on and forward? and my lover girl era? i didn't exactly know the answer back then since toxic mindsets were already taking over—study and study only type of stuff. suppression of feelings was a part, and it didn't feel right. the battle between dullness and beauty was flooding my entire life, not knowing what to follow, my mind or my fragile heart. i didn't want to deal with that stuff so i shoved it again somewhere in my mind that couldn't reach me with ease.

second week of formal classes—on a random Friday, Amber and i spotted him walking towards his carpool, and as the mabuting tao that i am, i waved at him as a mere sign of bye-bye. he then waved back, alongside a soft smile that melted my heart in an instant 🥹. the faded hues that once leaked through the cracks of my damaged world finally broke and showed me a new world—one filled with vibrant colors that seemed to never end. that moment made me feel like the happiest girl alive, happier than the moment where i won 1st place in the most important regional competition of my life. i knew my feelings were sincere na so i said to myself "wadafak, ang cute n'ya pala 🤧"!
