Their meeting was never planned  just two souls crossing paths by fate’s gentle hand. In the early days, everything felt light, easy, and warm. Laughter came naturally, and comfort settled between them like a soft whisper. He always found time for her, no matter how busy the day, and not a single sunset passed without shared stories and quiet confessions. For her, it was something new the first time her heart dared to open. But for him, friendships with women weren’t rare. Still, she offered him something rare, sincerity without expectation, affection without demands. Slowly, her heart leaned toward his, growing fonder with every shared moment. Yet, as time moved on, something shifted. His presence became scarce, his words shorter, the spark they once shared now flickering. She felt herself fading into the background of his world. Though he called her a friend, his kindness once spoke louder confusing her heart that longed for more. She stayed, hoping, giving her all, afraid to hope too much, knowing her flaws, knowing she might not be what he was looking for. And in the silence between what they were and what they could never be, she made the hardest choice to walk away. Not out of anger, but love. Because sometimes, leaving is the kindest way to say, “I care.”

Di tengah arus waktu yang tak henti mengalir, sering kali terdengar keluhan bahwa manusia kini sulit dipercaya. Namun barangkali bukan hanya soal kepercayaan yang hilang, melainkan bagaimana kita, sebagai sesama, perlahan memalingkan wajah dari satu sama lain. Kepercayaan sejatinya bukanlah sesuatu yang bisa direnggut begitu saja. Ia terkikis pelan dan diam-diam seiring berjalannya waktu, bukan semata karena manusia berubah menjadi jahat, tetapi karena manusia itu sendiri perlahan lupa bagaimana caranya untuk saling percaya.

Bukan karena hati menjadi lebih gelap, tetapi karena luka-luka yang pernah ada belum benar-benar pulih. Karena trauma yang dalam telah menanamkan ketakutan untuk kembali membuka pintu yang dulu pernah terbuka, hanya untuk dilukai. Kepercayaan pun menjadi rapuh, lebih rapuh dari yang kita sadari. Ia dihimpit oleh janji yang diingkari, kata yang tak pernah diucapkan, dan rasa sakit yang dipendam dalam diam. Kita hidup dalam dunia yang kerap kali memuja pencapaian pribadi, namun lupa bahwa tak seorang pun bisa benar-benar utuh tanpa kehadiran dan keyakinan dari orang lain.

Di balik layar-layar yang memisahkan, kita terbiasa menjaga jarak, membangun benteng, dan menyembunyikan luka-luka lama yang belum sempat disembuhkan. Dunia menjadi seperti medan perang antara kepercayaan dan kecurigaan, dan tanpa sadar kita menjadi tentara yang lelah, bukan hanya berperang dengan orang lain, tetapi juga dengan diri sendiri.

Namun, meski dikelilingi kekecewaan dan pengkhianatan, harapan belum sepenuhnya padam. Masih ada mereka yang, meski pernah terluka, memilih untuk percaya lagi. Karena mereka sadar bahwa tak semua yang datang akan menyakiti. Sebab keberanian untuk membuka hati bukanlah kelemahan, melainkan kekuatan yang sejati. Dan jika kamu pernah kehilangan kepercayaan, mungkin inilah waktunya untuk perlahan memulainya kembali, bukan untuk orang lain, tetapi untuk dirimu sendiri.

Tak semua yang datang akan memberikan luka, namun ia datang untuk menyembuhkan, menemani, dan menjaga

message:
Absolutely, I have. More than enough to hate you or to never speak to you again. But I can’t help that the love I have for you is still louder than the pain you caused.

I may hate you for what you did, but I also love you. It’s a cruel misfortune for my fragile, sensitive heart. I start arguments every day not because I want to fight, but because I can’t forget what you did to me when my love was pure, when my heart was still innocent.

You broke me in ways I didn’t know were possible. You made me question everything - my worth, my love, my sanity. I hate what you turned me into. I wasn’t always angry, hurt, lost and insecure like that.
 
You took all the best parts of me and left me in a million broken pieces. I was there when you were at your lowest, loving you while your world was falling apart. Even while you were breaking me. Even while I was bleeding. Don’t you remember it? 

I sat for hours, trying to understand how you could be so cruel to someone who only wanted to love you the way no one else ever did. My intentions were genuine. My love was real.

And then I realized, I’m not someone you’d ever fight to keep. The pain of being replaceable cuts deeper than a knife. Your apathy is like a wound that keeps reopening.

Sometimes, I wish I could show you the process of how you ruined me and make you live it on repeat. But even after everything, I still can’t hurt you the way you hurt me. How could you do it so easily?

In the end, I prayed for you before I prayed for myself. May God take care of you every second, everywhere you go. I hope my absence gives you the peace my love never could. I will always support you silently. I will always be proud of you. Even if I’m no longer a part of your life, I still wish for your happiness. I hope you find new reasons to live, to smile, and to love again.

Thank you for every memory we shared.

But that doesn’t mean I don’t miss you— because I do. I miss you in the quietest parts of my day, in the moments I used to share with you, in every version of silence I now face alone. I miss you every single day.

Still, none of this changes what I feel. I’ll continue to pour every drop of love I have into every word I write, even if you never read them. I don’t expect you to feel the same, and that’s okay. You don’t have to reciprocate anything. I’ve come to understand that sometimes, it’s far more meaningful to give than to receive.

Di tengah arus waktu yang tak henti mengalir, sering kali terdengar keluhan bahwa manusia kini sulit dipercaya. Namun barangkali bukan hanya soal kepercayaan yang hilang, melainkan bagaimana kita, sebagai sesama, perlahan memalingkan wajah dari satu sama lain. Kepercayaan sejatinya bukanlah sesuatu yang bisa direnggut begitu saja. Ia terkikis pelan dan diam-diam seiring berjalannya waktu, bukan semata karena manusia berubah menjadi jahat, tetapi karena manusia itu sendiri perlahan lupa bagaimana caranya untuk saling percaya.

Bukan karena hati menjadi lebih gelap, tetapi karena luka-luka yang pernah ada belum benar-benar pulih. Karena trauma yang dalam telah menanamkan ketakutan untuk kembali membuka pintu yang dulu pernah terbuka, hanya untuk dilukai. Kepercayaan pun menjadi rapuh, lebih rapuh dari yang kita sadari. Ia dihimpit oleh janji yang diingkari, kata yang tak pernah diucapkan, dan rasa sakit yang dipendam dalam diam. Kita hidup dalam dunia yang kerap kali memuja pencapaian pribadi, namun lupa bahwa tak seorang pun bisa benar-benar utuh tanpa kehadiran dan keyakinan dari orang lain.

Di balik layar-layar yang memisahkan, kita terbiasa menjaga jarak, membangun benteng, dan menyembunyikan luka-luka lama yang belum sempat disembuhkan. Dunia menjadi seperti medan perang antara kepercayaan dan kecurigaan, dan tanpa sadar kita menjadi tentara yang lelah, bukan hanya berperang dengan orang lain, tetapi juga dengan diri sendiri.

Namun, meski dikelilingi kekecewaan dan pengkhianatan, harapan belum sepenuhnya padam. Masih ada mereka yang, meski pernah terluka, memilih untuk percaya lagi. Karena mereka sadar bahwa tak semua yang datang akan menyakiti. Sebab keberanian untuk membuka hati bukanlah kelemahan, melainkan kekuatan yang sejati. Dan jika kamu pernah kehilangan kepercayaan, mungkin inilah waktunya untuk perlahan memulainya kembali, bukan untuk orang lain, tetapi untuk dirimu sendiri.

Tak semua yang datang akan memberikan luka, namun ia datang untuk menyembuhkan, menemani, dan menjaga

Hey Sayangku
I don’t even know how to begin this because this isn’t just a goodbye.
This is me writing through all the grief, confusion, and the love that still lingers even after I’ve walked away.
It feels surreal to be writing this.
Not because I stopped loving you but because some part of me still does.
Some part of me will probably always care in quiet ways, even after the world forgets that we were ever “us.”
I want you to know this first:
I never stopped caring about you.
Even when things got hard. Even when you pulled away.
Even when I felt like I was holding everything together with shaking hands.
I never stopped wishing you peace.
I didn’t leave because I didn’t love you.
I left because I was loving you while bleeding inside, and I couldn’t keep pretending I was okay.
I loved you with everything I had.
Even when I was tired.
Even when I was hurting.
Even when I was bleeding silently, hoping you’d notice that I was falling apart too.

Loving you was never a mistake.
Even now, I carry the soft moments like they still live inside me:
the little laughs, the warmth of being close to you, the quiet hope that maybe we could make it through everything — together.

But I’ve also carried the heavy parts. 
The silence when I needed you.
The ache of trying to help you when I was barely holding myself together.
And the guilt — the guilt of feeling like I wasn’t enough to save you, even when I gave you everything I could.

But the truth is, it was never my job to save you.
I tried. I stayed. I listened. I held space. I gave my energy, my time, my heart — all while I was bleeding silently inside.
I kept telling myself, “Maybe tomorrow he’ll come back to me fully.”
But tomorrow kept getting farther away.
I loved you. So deeply, so purely, with a kind of love I didn’t even know I had inside me. I gave it to you like it was endless — even when I was empty, even when I was tired, even when you gave me so little in return. You didn’t ask me to be your healer, but you didn’t stop me either. And maybe that’s what broke me.
You were hurting. I saw it. And I thought if I held you close enough, if I gave you enough love, maybe your pain would go away.
But instead of healing you, I became part of the chaos.
Instead of saving you, I started losing myself.
I stayed longer than I should have — not because I was weak, but because I believed in your healing more than you did.
I tried to be your light.
Your safety.
Your reason.
And maybe… I forgot that I needed someone to do the same for me.

You were gentle in moments. You were kind in ways that felt like home.
You had sadness in your eyes that I always tried to soften.
And I know — I know you were fighting battles in your mind, trying to be okay.
And I was trying to be your shelter, your calm, your reason to keep going.

But somewhere along the way, I lost myself.
I stopped hearing my own voice because I was so busy listening for yours.
I quieted my needs because I was afraid they’d be too loud for you to handle.
I held you with arms that were shaking from my own weight.
And every time I smiled while I was hurting, I told myself it was okay — because you needed me more.

But it wasn’t okay.
Because I needed me, too.
And I was disappearing.
I need to feel safe, grounded, wanted — without always wondering if I’m too much or not enough.

There were nights I cried alone, hoping you’d just notice.
There were moments I wanted to scream, “Please, see me. Love me like I love you.”
But your pain was louder.
Your distance became normal.
And I became the girl begging for love in a room filled with silence.

Even now, I don’t hate you.
How could I?
I saw your softness. I know your soul, even when it was clouded by sadness.
I saw the broken boy in you and tried to give him warmth.
I held you through things I barely understood.
I made excuses when you gave me pain instead of love.
But I also know now: love doesn’t work when it’s one-sided healing.
You can’t pour from an empty cup — and mine has been running dry for a long time.

I tried so hard. God, I tried.
To hold you.
To understand you.
To not leave.
To not be “one more person who gave up on you.”
But the truth is… I wasn’t supposed to save you. I was supposed to love you.
And love, real love, shouldn’t feel like self-destruction.

So today, I let you go — not because I want to, but because I have to.

I deserve a love that doesn’t make me question my worth.
A love where I don’t feel guilty for having needs.
A love where I’m not constantly shrinking to keep someone else comfortable.

I hope you heal.
I hope you do the work.
I hope you look in the mirror one day and finally see the man I always saw — kind, strong, capable, worthy.
I truly, deeply hope you heal.
I hope you find your light — not in me, not in someone else — but in your own soul.
Because there’s a beautiful version of you I always believed in… and I hope you finally believe in him too.
Because no love in the world can save you if you don’t want to be saved.


And as for me, I’ll take the memories with me — gently, respectfully — and move forward.
I’ll rebuild what I lost inside myself.
And maybe one day, when I look back, I’ll remember us not in pain, but with quiet gratitude.

And I hope when you love again, you’re ready.
Really ready.
Not halfway. Not afraid. Not running from your own heart.

As for me, I’ll carry our good moments quietly.
I’ll forgive you for the ways you couldn’t show up.
And I’ll forgive myself for staying longer than I should have.
I will always remember you.
But I’m choosing me now.
Not because I stopped loving you…
but because I finally started loving myself.

Thank you for what we shared.
Thank you for the love.

This is my goodbye.
Not in anger.
Not in bitterness.
But in love.
In grief.
In hope — for both of us.
Goodbye, my almost.
Goodbye, my lesson.

Take care of your soul.
Take care of the boy I once held in my arms.

With much love,
Maulida

Hi… 👋🏻

Actually, I’ve liked you since our very first day of school. Back when we weren’t part of OSPIS yet, just wearing any batik shirt we wanted. I saw you, and all I could think was:
“Damn, that face… unreal.” (gatau waktu itu tiba2 aja kepikiran gini) 😃🙏🏻

From that moment, I don’t know why, but I felt something.
But it wasn’t just about looks. 🙅🏻‍♀️

Back in 7th grade, during Saturday art club, I was feeling really unwell. Feverish, dizzy—I didn’t know whether to go to the clinic or just stay in class. Then suddenly, you came out holding a something and just wearing your shoes or sandals.

You looked at me and asked, “What’s wrong with you?”🤷🏻
I said, “Just a headache.”😵‍💫
You replied, “Oh.”
So simple, right? But that was our very first conversation, and I was freaking out inside.😑

When you joined EOS, I once asked a friend to put a bottle of NU (?) Milk Tea (botolnya biru) in your locker, with a little note that said, “Good luck with EOS.” 💪🏻
That was it. But for me, it was a big step.

And during the outing at Kebun Raya… you were riding a cream-colored basket bike—same as mine. At one point, you came up behind me, rang your bell, and passed me by.
I was actually about to catch up to my friends, but the moment you rode past, I changed course and started chasing after you instead. (bjir aul)
I don’t even know why I did that.
But in that split second, all that mattered was keeping up with you. Just riding behind you through the garden, like I was part of your story—even if only for a while. 🚴🏻‍♀️🚴🏻

And oh when you played the drums at the FLOSS event? I really liked you in that moment. Especially when you played “Still Into You.”😩
I don’t know who you were thinking about when you played that song, if anyone—but you on the drums? You were amazing. Seriously. 🤩

But behind all these feelings, I also heard something.🦻🏻
Someone said you liked someone else from a different class. And to be honest, that…
shocked me. Made me jealous. 🫥
But also made me realize: you’re free to like whoever you want.
I’m not anyone special. eaa
I even thought, “Maybe I should just get over this crush.”🙂‍↕️
But every time I thought that, I always came back to this one promise I made to myself:
“You have to confess. Someday. Whenever you’re ready.”

And today, I’ve chosen that day.
Our graduation day. June 17, 2025.
So…

Happy Graduation za 👨🏻‍🎓.
Thank you for being one of the most unforgettable parts of my life.
Even if you forget all of this, I won’t.
From me—someone who once liked you, and maybe still does. :)
Keep doing your best at MAN 2 💪🏻🙂‍↕️

I hope you like the bouquet I gave you 😃. I’m really sorry if it’s not arranged neatly—I was way too sleepy, eheh 😅 (mau keliaran effort sih wkwk). But please don’t hate it, okay? I promise I won’t like you anymore if it makes you uncomfortable😓 (well… depending on what my heart decides anyway 🫢)

(Maaf banget klu surat ini sangat alay 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻, sorry i’m sorry)

- Aulia P.

We carry that grief with us, we still have things that reminded us of pain - even though we never want to keep it in our mind. And I can't be the one who save us because I myself, was drowned and dead. All alone. I gave up on life. I'm just about to pick myself up again. And I told you countless times that I can't be myself with anyone because I don't think people would understand and I don't open up myself as much with people but I opened up myself to you and told you things I don't tell people. My first istikharah was you and i was sincere with you - all my intentions were genuine. But it felt like you didn't even try to understand me. You ignored me for months, kept me waiting, yearning. And I actually hated being treated with absence because I had worst experience. But I put away everything for you, the nervous the scared the self respect. Until I tried to stop caring for you every single day because I was trying so hard to clap but I only have one hand. And at some points I blame myself for everything. For letting myself be in the situation that makes me question my self worth and values. And I know you didn't mean to hurt me at all you were just protecting yourself. So I take a step back, because it hurts me too. I have feelings too. I have a very sensitive heart. And you don't know how much I cried because I grieved you. I feel so much pain until it doesn't feel hurt as much anymore. I let myself love you and care for you so much. I still do remember your smile and your laugh and it haunts me that so many things reminded me of you. Why can't you just come to me and tell me that you never loved me or just tell me straight to my face that I don't deserve you? Instead of main tarik tali and then leave me hanging again. I changed so many parts of myself for you. I let myself worry about you every single fucking day. And then in the end it looks like I'm the villain? It's so confusing.. siapa yang manipulative sebenarnya? All I ever did was try to talk to you. Try to reach out to you. Want to talk, want to confront and have difficult conversation to understand each other better. But now it's too late to even do that. I don't think we can fix things anymore. And the fact that you were never mine but I had too much of sadness to let you go? You just know how to fuck with my head, or maybe it's me. Fine I take all the blame. I'm the one who put myself in this situation but you're just so confusing? And I truly don't like being so confused and uncertain. You were so doubtful to me, you were questioning my loyalty the whole time when I told you what kind of person I am. I was transparent with you. I hate you. And I hate myself for loving you. I'm so exhausted. I want to end everything. I honestly don't know what to do anymore. I hope you're happy. I hope you get what you want. 😭 My sweet boy. I don't know how long will it take to recover. I want to tawakal, but I think of you and it kills me thinking you might not be fine right now. I know it's not my responsibility but how can I not care for you tell me?! Dah la. Saya taknak cakap apa2 dah. Saya nak tulis surat banyak2 and bawa hati saya jauh dari awak supaya saya boleh rawat sendiri. Awak, saya biar dalam jagaan Tuhan. Semoga awak baik2 saja dekat sana. I just hope I can see you in front of me one last time, but maybe itu bukan yang tertulis for us. If it's really the end, may Allah ease the hearts that are confused. May Allah angkat the emotional burden and all the pain. May Allah ease us untuk jumpa takdir kita yang sebenarnya, dan semoga ditunjukkan jalan, ke arah hidup yang sebetulnya. Hello, Theodore. Hello to the man who handled every part of me gently, the one who broke the cycle.

I know I seem nonchalant. It's because I never learned how to actually express myself, unlike you na healthy ang family, kabaliktaran ang sa akin. At some point, I felt ashamed. Kasi sobrang fxxked up ng buhay ko (I know you hate profanities pero my bad I can't find a different word). Naiisip ko, kapag kaya nalaman mo kung ano talaga ako, matatanggap mo ako?

I have this weird habit of sabotaging my own happiness. Kada may nagagawa ako, I already expect a negative reaction. Na iiwan ako, or ako na aalis kapag ganito gan'yan. Gano'n ine-expect ko kasi gano'n ang nakasanayan ko, gano'n kasi ako itrato ng ibang tao. Palaging tumatama 'yung gano'n kong mindset sa ibang tao. Kung ano ine-expect kong magiging treatment nila sa akin, gano'n ang nangyayari. Pero ikaw, sa hindi malamang dahilan, iba ka. You changed the cycle and healed the parts of me that I thought would never heal. You didn't even do anything, like willingly trying to fix my traumas, kasi I rarely open up about them sa'yo. You know what healed them? You—even your mere existence can heal the pain, and I am so much more thankful than you could ever imagine.

We never even argued. What we had was so healthy to the point na even after I asked to end everything, our feelings are still mutual and parang nagtuloy-tuloy pa rin siya. Sa ikli ng panahon ng atin, parang humaba pa rin kasi in the end, we knew what we had was real kaya hirap din tayong i-let go ang isa't isa, but at some point, we know naman na we both have to. Kahit na masakit, kahit na deep inside gusto pa nating ayusin—kasi kailangan. 

Kasi we already tried pero hindi nag-work. Hindi dahil sa toxic reasons, but simply because our goals didn't align. Iba priorities mo, iba akin. Pareho naman tayong naka-focus sa future. Kaso ang pinagkaiba, parang ganito kasi e. 

A: willing to risk everything while chasing her dreams
B: wants to focus on his goals first and love doesn't fit his schedule 

Palagi kong iniisip na “right person, wrong time” 'to. Hirap na hirap akong makausad from you kasi for months, nabubuhay ako kakaisip ng what ifs. Kung sa ibang panahon or oras kaya tayo nagkakilala, magwo-work out 'to? Matutuloy kaya ang dates na napag-usapan natin?

But when I realized it's what's holding me back from moving forward, from accepting that things are already done between us, I stopped. Finally, I told myself, “it is what it is”.

Ang daming possibilities ng atin e, ang daming potential. Kaso anong magagawa natin? Hindi nag-work, bumitaw na rin ako. I'm sorry, napagod ako. I realized na hindi kasi ito ang gusto ko para sa sarili ko. Siguro nga, sayang. Madalas nanghihinayang ako. Gano'n din sinasabi ng iba sa atin. Gusto nila maging tayo. 

Siguro deserve mo ng taong naka-align ang goals niya sa goals mo. Siguro sa kan'ya, you don't have to apologize nang paulit-ulit. Hindi katulad ng sa atin. Siguro 'di lang talaga tayo.

As much as I want it to be you, a part of me is telling me to stop. So, Theodore, thank you for everything you taught me. At least, finally, I realized that a genuine person still exists in this generation. You deserve someone as genuine as you, not someone who's as broken as I am. 

I still hope for the best. I still hope you'd heal from everything you didn't deserve to suffer from. I still wish you'd be able to become an architect. You deserve all the good things in this world with that genuine heart of yours.

I know I never said this before but I love you, Theodore. I love you, my future architect. Padayon.

Love,
Rei

aku sayang sama kalian. satu-satu, meski kita beda cara nunjukin rasa.

walaupun cape, walaupun repot, tapi tetep bareng.

karena kenal kalian,
adalah salah satu hal paling hangat yang pernah dikasih semesta ke aku.

So moving on — the gospel is about believing in God and testing our faith. Naks, pastor ang atake HAHAHAHA. Mag-pastor na lang kaya ako? 😂. 
 Nevertheless, it’s true that our faith is always challenged, especially when we experience difficulties in life or when we feel like our prayers are not being heard. Valid naman, yes. Even I sometimes doubt too. But I remember our pastor once told us (or at least, as far as I can remember) we people tend to believe in the saying “To see is to believe.” But it doesn’t work that way, not with God. I believe it applies in some cases, but not with Him.
As someone who always tries to accept the challenges in my life, my faith is constantly tested. So I’ve learned to focus not on seeing things, but on believing in Him — only Him.

And faith isn’t about what’s seen — it’s about trust in what is, even when it’s unseen.

the one who traced your light from the dark, and called it enough. — 

some stories aren’t loud.
they unfold like dawn—slow,
soft on the edges,
never asking to be seen
but always arriving anyway.

and you—
you were that kind of light to me.
you were never mine,
but that never stopped me
from memorizing the way your light moved
across the hours we shared.
you didn’t need to know—
that’s the beauty and cruelty of silent care.
you just had to be,
and I became.

not all feelings demand grand entrances.
some simply exist—
like breath,
like the hush between heartbeats,
like a song you never meant to memorize
but hum in your quietest moments.

i won't wish to hold more than you offered.
maybe finally accepting that it was enough to be a page
in the book you’re still writing,
a line in your story
that didn’t need a plot twist to matter.

with you, even silence had meaning.
even ordinary days felt full.

i'm just here,
like rain watching flowers it couldn’t touch—
not out of distance,
but because sometimes it
means knowing your place
and still choosing to stay.

and if this is all we ever are—
two souls tracing the same horizon
without meeting in the middle—
know this:
i never measured our bond
by what we were allowed to be,
but by what we chose to hold
even without naming it.

you are still
one of the best truths
i never had to speak aloud.

and this—this is not goodbye.
this is just another quiet way of saying
i’m here.

still choosing,
still rooting,
still holding space for you
in every version of forever
we never had to define.
just someone you remembered
and felt warm about.

still yours, in the way the moon is—
distant,
but always looking.
with a heart full of unnamed things,
—Yang 🦊

hi, inigo everard jaiden kang. :)  
i thought of you today — maybe more than i usually do.  

it’s been a while since we last talked, and i don’t know if you’ll ever see this or even read it. but still, here i am, writing to you anyway.  

i hope you’re okay, wherever you are.  

when you left, it felt like something quietly broke inside me. you were someone i adored so deeply — someone who meant more to me than i ever allowed myself to admit. and i’m sorry, truly, if i realized that i liked you too late.  

so much has happened since then. i’ve met new people, stumbled through failed talking stages, and found myself constantly overwhelmed by stress, pressure, and everything in between. in the middle of all of it — when everything felt heavy and confusing — i always found myself searching for you. somehow, you remained the one person who made everything feel a little lighter, a little safer. you made me appreciate the little things. you added color to my world.  

i used to scroll through our old conversations whenever i missed you. it was my way of feeling close to you again, of remembering what once was. but when you deleted your account and all your messages disappeared, it hurt more than i expected. it felt like watching you slip through my fingers all over again. eventually, i chose to delete our entire conversation too, because deep down, i knew i wouldn’t be able to move forward if i kept holding onto something that had already let go of me.  

i also started writing again. it’s been a while since i’ve had the motivation to, but slowly, i’m finding comfort in it once more. and every time i post someone on my film account, i think of you. you were the reason i began that in the first place — and somehow, you still are.  

even now, you still cross my mind in the softest ways. a song, a photo, a quiet thought — and suddenly, i wish i could send it to you. i miss you. i miss the way you listened, the way you cared, the way you made things feel okay even when they weren’t. you were my best friend. my safe space. my constant.  

and lately, i’ve been learning to open my heart again. someone’s been courting me for the past two months. it’s still early, and i don’t know where it’s headed, but he’s gentle, kind, and patient. he reminds me of everything i once hoped someone would be. i hope he learns to care for me the way you did — with love, patience, understanding, and genuine warmth.  

you will always have a special place in my heart, jaibear. 🐻  
you’ll always be the person that comes to mind whenever i hear apple cider by beabadoobee. no matter where life takes you, i hope you’re surrounded by peace, by happiness, and by the kind of love that you deserve.  
i wish you godspeed — always, in all ways.  

i don’t know if you’re still here in the philippines, or if you’ve already gone back to canada. either way, please know that i’m proud of you — always. ❤️‍🩹  

lots of love,

I’m not really sure why I’m even writing this to be honest. Maybe I just felt like doing it. Maybe birthdays have a way of making us remember people who once meant so much… or maybe still do, in quiet ways.

I don’t know if you’ll ever come across this. I don’t even expect you to. But just in case the universe finds a way to let this reach you, I want you to know something.

After everything, I still pray for you. :) I still wish you well. I still hope life’s been treating you gently, and that you’re surrounded by the kind of peace you’ve always deserved. I hope you’re doing the things you love, surrounded by people who lift you up and understand your heart. I hope your dreams—whether whispered in silence or shouted out loud—are slowly, beautifully coming true.

There are things we never got to say. And maybe that’s just how some stories end—unfinished, unspoken, but deeply felt. Maybe silence was the only thing left we could give each other. Still, even now, I hope you know… there was never a time I wasn’t rooting for you. :)

I didn’t notice it then, but now I know—I gave you all of me. Not just time or effort, but parts of myself I didn’t even know I could give. I loved you in a way that was all-in. No holding back. You were the first person I ever loved that much—and I mean really loved. In a way that stayed with me, even when you didn’t. And I hope, in the quiet moments, you felt that. I hope you knew that. 

So yeah… Happy Birthday, Yen. :) I’m not saying this to bring anything back or stir anything up. You’re just still someone I silently root for. :> I hope you’re chasing dreams that make your soul feel alive. :)) You deserve good things—maybE not from me anymore, but from the world. Mungkin surat ini ngga akan pernah kamu baca.
Tapi aku tetap nulis, karena kalo aku simpan semuanya di kepala, aku takut meledak.

Aku cuma mau bilang: terima kasih.
Terima kasih karena pernah jadi rumah yang paling nyaman buat aku.
Terima kasih karena pernah jadi satu-satunya orang yang bikin aku merasa cukup, padahal dunia bilang kita enggak akan bisa.

Kita tahu, dari awal, kita nggak mungkin. Tapi kita tetap maksa. Kita tetap percaya kalau cinta cukup.
Ternyata... cinta doang nggak pernah cukup ya?

Aku masih inget, setiap kali kita bahas soal masa depan, kita selalu nyengir—kayak pura-pura yakin, padahal dalam hati kita tahu, waktunya terbatas.
Kita nggak pernah jahat ke satu sama lain. Kita cuma beda jalan.

Dan sekarang, setelah semua ini, aku gak nyalahin kamu. Gak nyalahin Tuhan. Gak nyalahin siapa pun.
Aku cuma... kangen.

Tapi aku tahu, kangen itu bukan alasan untuk melawan kenyataan.
Kita bisa cinta seseorang, dan tetap harus pergi.
Kita bisa sayang, dan tetap gak bisa bersama.

Dev,
Kalau suatu hari kamu lagi denger lagu kesukaan kita, dan inget aku—nggak apa-apa senyum dikit.
Aku juga bakal senyum, walau cuma di dalam hati.

Aku nggak akan lupa kamu. Tapi aku juga gak akan berhenti jalan.

Dev...
Kadang aku mikir, kalau kita ketemunya di waktu yang beda…
mungkin ceritanya bisa lebih panjang.
Mungkin kita nggak harus pura-pura kuat setiap kali ngobrolin hal yang sebenarnya bikin kita takut.
Mungkin kita nggak harus saling meyakinkan bahwa “kita bisa”—padahal dalam hati kita tahu, dunia nggak akan ngizinin.

Aku benci rasanya.
Benci banget harus ngelangkah pergi dari orang yang nggak pernah salah.
Kamu baik, Dev. Kamu terlalu baik bahkan.
Dan justru itu yang paling nyakitin—karena aku kehilangan kamu bukan karena kamu jahat, tapi karena semesta bilang kita beda.

Tau gak, sampai sekarang aku masih nahan diri buat nggak buka ulang chat kita.
Masih pura-pura sibuk biar gak keinget cara kamu bilang namaku.
Masih pura-pura kuat, padahal hati ini masih nyari bayangan kamu di tempat-tempat yang biasa kita datengin.

Aku gak tahu kamu juga ngerasa hampa gak setelah semuanya selesai.
Atau kamu udah belajar nerima lebih dulu dari aku?

Tapi Dev...
Kalau suatu hari nanti kamu nikah sama orang lain,
aku harap kamu bahagia.
Bener-bener bahagia.

Dan kalau aku duduk di barisan paling belakang,
mungkin aku senyum, pura-pura nggak sakit, sambil bilang dalam hati,
"Dulu aku yang dia genggam erat,
sekarang aku cuma bagian dari doa yang dia pernah ucapkan diam-diam."

Dev,
Kamu cinta yang gak akan pernah salah waktu datangnya,
tapi memang salah tempat tinggalnya.

Aku akan lanjut hidup.
Tapi aku nggak akan bohong: akan selalu ada satu bagian kecil dari hatiku yang tetap milik kamu.
Bukan karena aku belum move on, tapi karena kamu bukan cinta biasa.
Kamu itu pelajaran.

Pelajaran bahwa cinta pun harus tunduk pada kenyataan.

Selamat jadi orang baik, Dev.
Semoga Tuhan yang kita percayai dalam cara yang berbeda, tetap jaga kamu sebaik mungkin.
Karena aku udah gak bisa lagi.

Jaga diri baik-baik, ya.
Makasih karena pernah jadi pacarku yg lucu.

To the one I liked in silence,

It’s been two years. Two quiet, painful, beautiful years during which I held onto feelings I never dared to fully confess. I kept every longing, every hope, and every piece of my heart a secret, silently admiring you from afar. I memorized your smile, your words, and everything.I was content, or so I thought, to remain unseen, invisible in your world.Then, out of the blue, you followed me on IG. my heart pounded wildly, and for a moment, I believed that maybe you had seen me, too. That fleeting spark of hope made me wonder if perhaps our fates were shifting. But as quickly as it came, the moment passed, leaving behind a silence that spoke volumes. Just when I started to believe in the possibility of us, nothing changed.
Even more bittersweet our conversation is. Recently, we began chatting—just a few messages exchanged as if testing the waters of a new friendship. Yet, somehow, it feels like we’ve reverted to being strangers all over again. The conversation, brief and fleeting, reminds me that while our words bridge distances for a moment, the deeper connection remains elusive. We are, for now, merely strangers rediscovering the contours of conversation, and that transient spark has already started to fade.
I liked you for two years, and even now, despite these small chances, part of me still holds on to what might have been. It is a quiet, lingering ache—a mix of hope and resignation. I know I should move on, yet every shared word, every brief chat, only deepens the irony that we can be both so close and yet so painfully apart.
Sincerely,
Someone who tried to forget you but never could.

Hai...
Ini aku, versi kamu yang kecil.
Yang dulu suka senyum sendiri, yang percaya sama keajaiban,
yang mikir semua orang bakal baik-baik aja.

Aku nulis ini karena aku tahu… kamu sekarang lagi capek banget.
Lagi ngerasa sendirian, nggak dianggap, dan kayak semua orang lebih milih nyuruh kamu ngerti...
daripada mereka yang coba ngerti kamu.

Aku ingat waktu kita kecil, kita pengen banget bikin mama bangga.
Pengen bantuin rumah, jadi pintar, nurut...
Tapi sekarang aku lihat kamu kok makin disalahin terus, makin dipendam semua, makin jauh dari senyummu dulu.

Kamu jadi diem, padahal aku tahu kamu pengen banget ada yang peluk dan bilang:
“Kamu nggak salah, kamu cukup, kamu juga layak dimanja.”

Aku tau kamu cape…
Tapi aku bangga banget, kamu masih ada di sini. Masih bertahan, walau rasanya pengen hilang.
Masih senyum, walau hati sesak.
Masih mikirin orang lain, padahal kamu pun lagi butuh dimengerti.

Aku cuma mau bilang...
Jangan lupa sama aku ya. Aku yang dulu, masih ada di dalammu.
Yang penuh harapan, yang masih pengen hidup tenang,
yang masih pengen dicintai tanpa syarat.

Kalau kamu nggak kuat, nggak apa-apa.
Pegang tanganku. Kita jalanin bareng.

Dan kalau dunia terus bikin kamu ngerasa salah, aku mau kamu denger satu hal ini:

“Aku sayang kamu.”

Terima kasih udah jaga kita sampai sejauh ini.
Pelan-pelan ya. Kita pulang ke diri kita lagi — yang hangat, lembut, dan cukup.💕

Aku pertama kali kenal ONIC saat MSC 2023.

It was just another random moment—sampai aku nonton match mereka lawan Echo PH. I was hooked instantly. Bayangin aja, mereka bertahan dari 7 lord milik Echo, dan somehow... they did it. Mereka berhasil bertahan. Aku awalnya tertarik banget sama gameplay Kairi, but then—Kiboy caught my eye. The way he roamed, the chaos he created, it was insane. Dari situ aku langsung mikir, tim ini gila sih, kuat banget.

Jujur, saat itu aku belum terlalu ngikutin Mobile Legends. Tapi karena ONIC, I started to care. Aku mulai ngikutin mereka lebih dekat—dari MPL ID Season 12. Mereka benar-benar tim monster. Saat mereka juara, I was screaming like crazy. So proud.

Mereka lanjut ke M5. Sayangnya, satu kesalahan bikin kita harus puas sebagai runner-up. Dan ya... hujatan datang dari mana-mana. Tapi aku? I stayed. Karena ONIC bukan cuma soal menang. It’s about growth, chemistry, dan perjuangan.

Masuk ke MPL ID Season 13, awalnya berat. Tapi ONIC bangkit dan jadi juara lagi—empat kali berturut-turut. Itu momen bersejarah. Dan ya, Lutpi udah jadi bagian tim dari season ini, debut sebagai EXP laner. Gantikan peran besar Butss. Gameplay-nya keren banget—bikin aku yang nonton aja pengen belajar main EXP lane. That’s how much he inspired me.

Lanjut ke MSC 2024. Sakit sih—kita tumbang lagi, kali ini dari Team SYS. Rasa kecewa makin dalam ketika beberapa pemain pamit. Drian, sang legenda ONIC Kage, dan juga Butss—kapten tangguh yang pindah divisi. Even though Butss masih bagian ONIC, rasanya tetep kehilangan.

Season 14, kami gagal juara. Sakit. Tapi dukunganku gak luntur. Karena aku percaya, ONIC always fights back.

Masuk MPL ID Season 15. Awalnya goyah, roster sempat gonta-ganti. Lalu datanglah Savero, rookie baru yang mengisi posisi CW—gold laner andalan kami sebelumnya. Dan lagi-lagi, debut yang luar biasa. Kayak Lutpi dulu. Awalnya kita diragukan, tapi mereka buktikan semuanya. ONIC bangkit dan keluar sebagai juara MPL ID S15.

Finalnya? Gila. Outplay dari Sanz bener-bener bikin merinding. MVP yang sangat pantas. I’m beyond proud of this team.

Dan sekarang… MSC 2025 menanti.

Whatever happens, ONIC tetap di hati. Dari suka sampai duka, I’ll be here. Always cheering for the Yellow Hedgehogs.

Go ONIC! #LandakKuning #ONIC4Life

Hello ! It's been a year and 1 month. I know I have no right to even make this but god knows how much I missed you. Foul play to swear on God's name but I can't lie and turn back time, I've made my choices and I won't take them back. I just really miss you. I miss how I'd annoy you, valorant/genshin/roblox night with friends, and most importantly the games we played with just us two :) I absolutely loved those little game dates, even tho we didn't meet irl as much, I enjoyed every moment with you but I guess everyone had breaking points.

I've been making a fool of myself trying to deny that I didn't miss you, that I didn't want to look back because of how many times I hurt myself overthinking about things that were so shallow. I am so wrong– so damn wrong to think that I could move on from you so easily. 

Yk the night after I ended things? I cried, I broke down so bad, my friends were laughing at me because I was crying so hard. They kept telling me it'll be alright– that it needed to happen. IT DIDNT NEED TO HAPPEN. I should've kept talking to you but I gaslighted myself that I shouldn't because it was over and that I should hold accountability for my choices. My own consequences. I miss you. So much.

It's crashing out on me after a year and a month because I'm done fooling myself that I didn't suffer the consequences of my actions. 

Although seeing you have fun, expanding your social circle slowly, and living out your life after I've witnessed you crash out about your future, I can wholeheartedly say that I'm proud of how far you've came. That the kath I knew didn't like interacting with others, she'd rather stay alone, be alone, than to mingle with others. The one that used to hate having to speak to her classmates, choosing to not interact with others, and the one who kept saying she wasn't close with her friends, has finally grown her wings and fled from her safe nest and ventured out of her bubble. I am undoubtedly and irrevocably in awe of your glowing self. 

For the last time, Lia

Hi,

Six years ago, we were just in primary six—just kids.
And now, six years have passed in the blink of an eye.

When I went to take my driving test, I saw you again.
Honestly, my heart was all over the place—nervous, scared, but also really excited.
I never thought I’d see you again. After all this time, I wasn’t even sure if you’d still remember me.
But one thing I knew for sure: I still remember you.

At first, I wanted to avoid you.
But then, on the way home, our eyes met.
And in that moment, it felt exactly like it did back in primary school.
Somehow, I felt like maybe you did remember me—because you smiled.
And when you did, I panicked and ran away.
But I’ll be honest—I slowed down my steps on purpose, secretly hoping we might walk together.
Even after I got into the car, I kept looking back…
Because deep down, I was afraid I might never see you again.

Then later, during the (university) interview, we ran into each other once more.
You were sitting with your back facing me—maybe you didn’t notice.
But I noticed.
And I gathered my courage, 
I told myself, “Just do it.”
so I sat next to you.
because a part of me thought,
“What if this is my only chance to sit beside him?”

I was really nervous, but honestly, I was also really happy.
Maybe you didn’t recognize me. Maybe you didn’t notice.
But to me, that moment meant a lot.

If I had the courage,
I’d say all of this to you directly.
But right now… this is the only way I know how to tell you.

Not the ending—

How I was left to write the rest of the story by myself,
Trying to make sense of a chapter that didn’t end properly.

Not over you, but not chasing either.
Not waiting, but not really moving forward.
I’m just… here.
In the in-between.
Trying to be okay with not knowing what this feeling is,
And trusting that someday, I will.

message:
I know you won't find this message from this site but there’s something I’ve been meaning to share, and I think it’s important to express these feelings that have lingered for so long. You were my first love, and I want you to know that even after all this time, I can't seem to forget you. It's been a year since we last connected, and despite knowing that we’ve both moved on, my heart still holds onto the memories we created. I truly believe that our time together taught us valuable lessons, even if we weren't mature enough to fully understand them back then. I remember when we first met in grade 3. You were just being yourself, and that authenticity drew me to you. When we finally reunited in grade 7, my feelings only intensified. It was during that time that I started to understand what love really meant, even if it was just puppy love. I realize now how much I let my insecurities and mistakes affect our relationship, especially the influence of my cousin, which led to misunderstandings. I deeply regret the pain I caused you. It was never my intention to hurt you, and I carry that guilt with me. I remember you saying that we might come back together at the right time, and I held onto that hope. I still believe in the possibility of fate bringing us back together, even if I sometimes feel like a fool for doing so. I’ve seen your messages about uncertainty regarding the future, and I respect your feelings completely. We were young and still figuring ourselves out, and I understand that we weren’t ready for the relationship we attempted. But I want you to know that you are still the right person for me, even if it was the wrong time. I am genuinely happy to see that you’re doing well. Your happiness brings me joy, and I am proud of you for everything you’ve accomplished. If there’s ever a chance for us to reconnect, I want to be a better person for you. message:
I just want to leave this message here, and I know when you see it, you’ll know it’s for you.

It’s been months since we started talking, and somewhere along the way, I found myself getting attached to you. I want to thank you deeply—for your presence, for your patience, for the care and effort you’ve shown me. You’ve always treated me with so much kindness and understanding, and I will never forget how you stayed through every season I went through. You never made me feel alone. You reminded me that my emotions are valid, and I saw the ways you genuinely tried to make things easier for me. And I appreciated all of it—truly.

That’s why it’s difficult for me to say this.

Loving you felt natural, like breathing. It wasn’t hard to care about you. But despite everything, I’ve come to realize that what I feel right now isn’t enough—not to overcome the doubts, not to match the love you give. The truth is, I tried—really tried—to love you the way you deserve. But somewhere deep down, I know I’m not in the right place emotionally to give you the kind of love you’ve given me so freely.

And that’s unfair to you.

You don’t deserve a love that’s unsure, or one that constantly hesitates. You deserve peace, not confusion. I hate to admit it, but I think continuing what we have would only keep hurting us both—and most especially, you. I’ve seen how my presence has started to wear you down, and that’s the last thing I ever wanted to do. I know I should’ve done better, I should’ve communicated more, but I didn’t. And for all the pain and uncertainty I caused, I am deeply, deeply sorry.

So this is me choosing to step away completely. I don’t want to drag this out or confuse you further. This is me deciding to let go—even if it hurts—because you deserve someone who’s all in, not someone who's still figuring themselves out. I won’t be reaching out anymore, not because I didn’t care, but because I care too much to keep hurting you. I’m too weak to say this to you directly, and I’m sorry for that. I don’t want to disturb your peace anymore or take up more space in your life than I already have.

You will always have a special place in me, no matter where life takes us. Everything we shared—the laughter, the late-night talks, the quiet support—I’ll carry those memories with me. They meant more than you know.

Wishing you nothing but the best in everything you do. I know you'll become the amazing architect you're meant to be. Keep building beautiful things—not just with your hands, but with your heart too.

Goodbye, archi
and thank you… for everything.

to the one i never needed to own, to call mine—only to hold gently in thought,

you were never a destination.
you were the northern star—distant,
but enough to guide my steps
even when you didn’t see me walking.

i never knocked on your door
expecting it to open.
it was enough for me to sit by the threshold,
leaving small notes in the breeze—
words i folded into leaves,
hoping the wind would deliver them to you
on the days your chest felt heavy
and no one else noticed.

i wanted to be that kind of soft.
the quiet shoulder.
the warmth at your back when you don’t look.
not a storm, not a sunrise—
just dusk.
gentle. familiar.
like a moment that doesn't ask to be remembered
but still lingers in the skin.

people say it should be loud,
that it should burn or blaze or bloom.
but what if mine was water?
still, deep, unmoving—
a sanctuary
you never knew you had,
until you needed to rest your tired reflection
somewhere that didn’t ask for anything in return.


but if this is how affection tastes
before it fully ripens—
then god, how sweet
and how quietly terrifying it already is.

you don’t owe me your eyes,
or your hours.
but know this:

you are a poem
i have never tried to rewrite.
just one i read over and over again,
in the hush between seconds,
grateful for every stanza
that sounds like home.

and if ever,
one soft night,
you wonder why the air feels gentler
when you speak—

it’s because someone,
somewhere,
loved the shape of your name enough
to whisper it into the wind
without asking it to echo back.

—

always the calm tide,
never the storm.
still here, Yang. 🦊

It’s strange, isn’t it? You will never anything, no label, no commitment, no promises to hold onto. Just two people who happed to cross parts, shared a few stories, exchange, laughter, and then, just like that, it was over. But if we were nothing, why does losing feel like everything? I keep telling myself that this shouldn’t hurt, you were just passing moment. Fleeting presence in my life, but no matter how many times I try to convince myself, the remains the same, your absence feels heavier than it should. I shouldn’t be feeling this way, yet here I am, caught  in a whirlwind of emotions I don’t know how to explain. Maybe because for a short while, you made life a little brighter. Maybe it’s because in those brief conversations, I found a comfort. I didn’t realize I needed. You made me laugh, you made me feel heard, and in such a short time, you became someone I look forward to. And now, without you, there’s an emptiness I can’t seem to fill.  You weren’t just another person I met along the way. You’re different you mean the ordinary feel special, our conversations weren’t just small talk. They meant something.,  even in silence between us felt comfortable, like we understood each other without needing to say much. There was something effortless about being around you, something so rare that I didn’t even realize how much I valued it until it was gone. I can explain to anyone why this loss feels so real because there’s no logical reason for it. All I can do is carry this feeling in silence, pretending that I’m fine when deep down I’m still thinking about you. I tried to act like it doesn’t bother me, like I’ve moved on effortlessly, but then, out of nowhere, something reminds me of you like a song, phrase you used to say suddenly, it all comes rushing back. I remember the way you laughed, the way you spoke, the way you made me feel like it mattered, even if just for a moment. And I realize, once again, that forgetting you is much harder than I ever expected. I don’t know what made you so unforgettable, was it the way you listened? The way you laughed? Or was it simply the way we understood each other in a way that felt effortless? Maybe it was the way you made me feel seen in the world that often feels to chaotic. Whatever it was, it’s left mark on me, when the time doesn’t seem to erase. I wish I could go back to before I met you, before I knew what it was like to have you in my life, maybe then, this wouldn’t hurt so much, maybe then, I wouldn’t feel this sense of loss over something that was never mind to begin with. But at the same time, I didn’t regret knowing you because even though this hurts, even though losing you feels like losing a piece of myself, I would still choose to meet you all over again if I give the chance. But maybe that’s just how life is, some people come into our lives not to stay, but to teach us something. Maybe you were meant to be a lesson, a reminder that even the smallest connections can leave the deepest impressions. Maybe you were never meant to stay, but simply to show me that certain people can change your world, even if only for a little while.

Yow, I arrived here sa Bulacan today. The moment I stepped foot here, everything felt so painfully quiet. It’s the same streets, the same air, the same buildings… Pero it all feels unfamiliar now. Hollow. Like time passed too quickly and took something from this place I once called home. I used to think coming back here would bring me peace. That it would fill the parts of me that have been aching for so long. But all I feel now is this heavy emptiness, a kind of silence that screams louder than anything. It’s like I’m surrounded by ghosts, echoes of laughter, of soft conversations, of memories that feel so close yet so far away. Even yunh smokes from the old jeeps, the same kind we used to ride together, felt different today. Thicker. Suffocating. I sat there, staring out the window, trying not to cry, but the tears still fell. I told myself na this place would make me feel like I belonged again. But I was wrong. Without you, this isn’t home. Not anymore. I passed by Barasoain Church earlier. Do you remember that day? It was nothing grand, but it mattered kasi you were beside me. Nung tumingin ako sa church, I didn’t see the details of the architecture or the people praying inside. I saw you. I saw us. I saw the moments we once shared like they were happening all over again, but through glass I couldn’t touch. I wanted to smile, but instead, I broke.

Inside this house, in one of the quiet corners, I’ve placed a box. It holds the little things you left behind, the jacket, the toys, the letters, and the memories that clung to them. I couldn’t bring myself to throw them away. They belong here, where it all once made sense. Where love used to live. That box will stay closed now. It’s the only place where those pieces of us belong. And despite everything, kahit masakit, the tears, and the ache that refuses to leave, I want you to know this, I don’t regret meeting you. I don’t regret what we had. I’d live it all over again, even if it meant ending like this, just to feel what it was like to be loved by you. Pero today, I realize na I need to stop chasing what’s gone. 

I’m suffering, Raine. I hate na ganito padin siya kasakit. I want to leave again, as soon as I can. Gusto kong kalimutan lahat... the places, the memories, the laughter... all the things that used to mean the world to me. Napapagod na'ko. I’m tired of wishing and waiting and wondering. I want to stop waking up with this weight on my chest. I want to stop avoiding places we used to go to, or remember you in every song I play. I want to stop aching every time I remember that you’re not mine anymore. Kaya I’m letting go na po ah? This'll be my last message.

Hindi because I stopped loving you, but because I finally love myself enough to walk away. I wish you nothing but the best in life. I hope you find the peace, the love, and the happiness you deserve. I really do. Goodbye, Raine. Even in this ending, I still love you. Always.

Hai Greg,

Entah kamu membaca ini suatu hari nanti, atau tidak pernah sama sekali.
Tapi izinkan aku menuliskannya… bukan karena aku masih menunggu,
melainkan karena aku ingin membebaskan diriku dari segala yang menggantung.

Pernah, kamu adalah rumah tempat hatiku berpulang.
Aku tidak pernah mencintai seseorang seperti aku mencintaimu —
dengan ketulusan yang bahkan mengikis egoku sendiri.
Tapi cinta tidak selalu bermuara pada kebersamaan, bukan?

Ada bagian dalam diriku yang masih mengingat suaramu, senyummu, caramu membuatku merasa istimewa.
Tapi juga ada bagian yang mengingat ketakutanmu, diam-mu, dan caramu perlahan berjalan menjauh.
Aku menyimpan semuanya — tanpa menyalahkanmu.

Karena kini aku tahu,
kita bertemu bukan untuk selamanya,
tapi untuk menyadarkan aku akan nilai diriku sendiri.

Jika suatu hari kamu datang kembali —
mungkin dalam bentuk tanya, senyum, pesan, atau hanya pandangan dari jauh —
aku akan menerimanya bukan sebagai tanda “kita kembali”,
melainkan sebagai bukti bahwa aku sudah bisa berdiri tanpa menggenggammu lagi.

Greg, aku tidak lagi menunggu.
Tapi aku juga tidak akan menyangkal bahwa dulu kamu sangat berarti.
Dan kamu akan selalu menjadi bagian dari lembar cerita jiwaku —
yang telah membentuk siapa aku sekarang.

Terima kasih,
Untuk cinta yang pernah ada.
Untuk luka yang menguatkanku.
Dan untuk kepergian yang pada akhirnya… mengembalikanku pada diriku sendiri.

Jika kamu bahagia,
maka doaku sampai ke sana.

Tetap aku ingat dan kamu adalah  puzzle yang aku rindukan untuk aku susun kembali
Tapi tidak ku coba lagi.

Dengan damai,
**Aku, yang akhirnya belajar melepaskan.**

i still remember, at the start, i didn’t love you. 
but i cared about you, so, so much, as a friend. 
and from there, i tried to love you. i opened my heart. i accepted your flaws. i held on to the relationship, even when i wasn’t sure about my own feelings. why? because i didn’t want to hurt someone who I thought truly loved me. because i was your first girlfriend. the thought of "where will you run when I'm the one who hurts you?" breaks me. because i knew what it felt like to be left without explanation, and i didn’t want you to go through that.

ironically, you ended up doing that to me. 
i used to believe that if i stayed, you would change. but instead, you opened doors for other girls. i knew everything, nis. i just didn’t have the heart to walk away. i thought we could fix it. i thought that if i stayed patient, you’d realize. but you didn’t. the only thing you chose wasn’t growth, it was escape. 
and the only “mature” decision you made in our relationship, was breaking up with me. 

and somehow, after everything, i’m the one who got blamed. they said i was controlling, possessive. but no one saw how i got there danish. they didn’t know i became that way because i had been betrayed and still chose to stay. they didn’t know i cried quietly while forgiving you again and again and again. they didn’t know you made me feel like i had to be the man in our relationship, carrying everything alone. and now that you’re gone, i’m also healing alone. so this letter isn’t to beg you to come back. it’s not to lash out either. this is the last letter, for everything i held back but never got to say. so this time, i get to finish, not because you forced me to, but because i finally know i deserve peace, even without you. 

thank you for coming. and i’m sorry, that in loving you, i once lost myself. i hope one day, you get to become the man you’ve always wanted to be, and finally grow out of the boy you’ve always hated being.

from the girl who once loved you with all she ever had. love you as always

Hi baby,
Haha, I’m calling you that baby because that’s what I’ve always wanted to call you. Even if I never had the real chance to say it out loud, that’s what you were to me. My baby. My person. The one who made my heart soft and full.It feels a little funny saying this now, especially when we’re no longer what we used to be or what I hoped we could be. But in this little message, let me pretend for a moment. Let me say the words I’ve been keeping inside for so long.

I love you.
I love you in a way that’s hard to explain. A love that’s patient and gentle and constant. A love that didn’t need to be returned to feel real. A love that saw all your flaws, your silence, your confusion, your distance and still stayed.I had all these dreams.Dreams that had you in them.Dreams where I’d be the one beside you as you chase your goals, celebrate your wins, cry through your losses, and grow into the person you were meant to be. I imagined us building a life, not perfect, but real. Full of understanding, forgiveness, and quiet support.But the truth is…Not all love stories are meant to last. Some are meant to shape us, not to stay. And I’m slowly learning to accept that we are one of those.And so, baby… I’m letting go.Not because I stopped loving you.Not because you did something wrong.But because holding on is starting to hurt more than it heals.I’m doing this because I want you to be happy even if that happiness is no longer found with me. I hope she makes you smile the way I imagined I could. I hope you hold her the way I dreamed you’d hold me. I hope you look at her the way I always wanted you to look at me.But more than anything… I hope you’re safe.I hope you take care of yourself.I hope that when life gets heavy and no one seems to understand, you remember to pray. Please talk to God when the world gets quiet He’ll listen even when no one else does. And even if you feel alone, you won’t be. Not really.
Because somewhere out there, there’s me praying for you. Always.Wishing you light in your darkest nights, and peace on your restless days.And just so you know, I’m proud of you. Even from a distance.
Even if I’m not the one beside you.Even if we don’t talk anymore.Even if I’m just a quiet memory in your heart I’ll always cheer for you in silence.I may not be the one who gets to stay by your side, but loving you has changed me. You’ll always be part of my story. And maybe, one day, when we’ve both healed and grown, we’ll meet againnot to rewrite our past, but simply to smile and say, we made it.
But until then…
Go love her the way I wished you’d love me.
Go be happy. Go be free.

As for me, I’ll love you silently. From afar. Always.

—
Goodbye, baby.
My love. My almost. My once upon a time.

to the one i cared for in quiet excess —

i was the tide that reached too far onto the shore.
i knew the sand could never hold me —
but still, i came back
again and again,
just to prove that devotion
doesn’t need permission to exist.

maybe i bloomed too soon in your season of drought —
too eager, too full of rain.
maybe my presence was a little too much sun
for someone who only wanted shade.

i admit it:
i asked questions not to pry,
but to understand the architecture of your silence.
i stayed up not to be needed,
but to witness the flicker of your light
even when the world had gone dim.

you didn’t ask for this.
but neither did i ask my heart
to beat this loudly in a room
that was never mine to echo in.

you were a quiet sky,
and i was a storm that didn’t know how to arrive softly.
but what a gift it was —
to feel this deeply,
in a world that calls detachment a virtue.

i became the soft overpour —
a flood of little things:
warm messages, unspoken concern,
affections folded in origami-like restraint,
care delivered in lowercase.

and still,
i knew what happened to things offered too fully —
they overflow the vessel.
they’re loved briefly,
then left behind
like a poem someone wasn’t ready to finish reading.

i held you gently,
but i maybe held you too much.
and when i felt the drift —
your hands pulling away like shorelines at low tide —
i didn’t chase.
i just receded,
gracefully.
because some storms don’t rage when denied.
they bow.

if i was ever too much,
know it wasn’t to overwhelm,
but to remind you that even the quietest hearts
can roar with tenderness.

you see —
i never wanted to be your fire.
just a candle left by your window,
flickering soft,
in case you ever needed light
without having to ask for it.

and maybe someday,
when someone tries to hold you with conditions,
with caution, with cold hands —
you’ll remember me,
the girl who holds like wind through open curtains:
uninvited,
but always gentle.

because even if I had to shrink
to fit within the frame of friendship,
even if i had to erase the “more”
from every sentence i wrote of you,
i’d still do it.

not because I hoped to be chosen,
but because it was an honor
to feel this much
for someone who never asked me to.

you were a universe I never entered,
but I learned the constellations by heart anyway.

and i—
i was just the moon,
pulling at your tides
knowing every wave I caused
would bring you further from me.

but what a beautiful ache it was,
to orbit someone
even when gravity was never promised.

—
still orbiting,
just from a little farther away, Yang.🦊

It's been months, I know I seemed like I've moved on from you and am happy na. The truth is I'm still hoping, hoping that one day you would come back to me being the best version of yourself, hoping that we could restart what was us before. I've tried to move on and look past our unsaid goodbyes because I always think na it was better that way. What happened between us hurt, it hurt so bad to the point na I started hating you, your name, your sports, your passion, you, all of you and everything of you. I was deeply hurt because I never thought that you could do that to me, I was disappointed. But no matter how much I hate you in my mind, no matter how much I say that you are the worst, no matter how much I moved on, you still exist in a part of my heart. You still belong to that spot, the spot where you have always been, you never left that part. When you left a part of me left as well, a missing piece of me that I could not find no matter how many times I search for it. You are the only one who could fill that void, you are the only one who could make me pray to God about love. I forgive you for the past mistakes and for everything, I hope you forgive me too. But even if I forgave you, I will never forget everything that happened as it left a wound and scar on me. That's why I'm hoping you would prove to me that you are willing to change and you are going to make things better between us, if you still want to. I'm hoping that you would become the better version of yourself, the one that I've met, my seby boy. I want us both to be back to each others arms when we are better, more healed and more ready to risk. I'm still waiting for you, I'm still waiting for us. Please do something, anything, everything. I'll let God handle everything, I'll let you do something. I miss you and I always love you Sebastian, that never changed. I left without saying goodbye because I know once I said goodbye, I won't be able to let go and make myself better. Isn't improvement in actions better than promises with words? I've done my part, please do what should be done and prove yourself to me. By then, when the time is right I will be back to you when God permits it. I love you always and deeply, Zaki Sebastian.

to the one i held in hushed hues😺—
not all feelings bloom into love.
some simply stay—tucked between admiration and longing,
growing gently in silence.

i like you.
more than i meant to.
more than i should have.
and maybe that’s what made this ache so quiet, yet so heavy.
somewhere between all the could-have-beens,
i found something real.
even if we never called it love.
even if I had to fold my feelings
into smaller shapes just to make them fit
within the lines of friendship.

and that’s the hardest part—
not the distance,
not the silence,
but the nearness that doesn’t reach far enough.

still, i stayed.
not out of hope,
but out of quiet devotion.
because sometimes, choosing not to ruin something
is the most faithful thing you can do.

so i’ll carry this quietly—
like a letter i never send,
like a favorite song I only hum in the dark.
not to be heard.
not to be returned.
but because it’s true.

and maybe someday,
when you speak my name
not out of need,
not out of habit—
but just because the moment feels kind…

i hope a part of you remembers:
someone once chose to stay—
not because she was waiting,
but because she cared enough
to never ask for more than she was given
because sometimes, the strongest kind of feeling
is the one you learn to set free
before it even learns to call itself love.

I don't really know why I'm writing this now—
maybe because it's your birthday.
Maybe because there's something I’ve been holding for too long
and today feels like a good time to finally let it go.

You probably don’t know who this is.
But I know you.
I've known you since everything felt simpler,
when we were just kids trying to figure out the world.

You were never the loudest in the room,
never the person everyone looked at first.
But for some reason, you were the only one I saw.
I never had a clear reason why I liked you.
You’re not my “type,” you’re not perfect.
But I guess your smile—
that smile, the one that feels like sunlight breaking through clouds—
it stayed with me.

Time moved on.
I thought the feeling would, too.
But even as years passed,
even when you were with someone else and looked so happy,
I still found myself smiling for you.
Even when it hurt,
because you mattered more than my pride.

I never needed you to like me back.
I just wanted you to know that once,
someone loved you quietly.
Loved the way you laughed,
noticed the little things about you that no one else did.
Someone who never stopped carrying your name in their heart,
even when the world kept turning.

It's 16 june so… happy birthday, Chelsea.
I hope you're surrounded by love, laughter, and warmth today.
And I hope, somehow,
you feel the echo of someone’s silent love
reaching out to you from a quiet corner of the past. Even if I never said anything, I was always there—watching you win, laugh, live.


Thank you—
for being the first person who ever made me feel this way.

Hello, kuya Kian!

How are you? How's SHS for you? I'm sorry that I didn't greet you on your birthday. I couldn't.

These past few months made me think of you. Why? I don't have an answer to that question. As much as I want to forget you and bury you deep within my memories, your name always flash in my mind. 

I miss you. My friends don't know that. After all, it's stupid to even miss you. Why should I miss you? Why so random? After almost 2 years ('til now) of not talking to each other, I suddenly miss you.

Kuya Kian, were you affected as much as I was when we stopped talking? Were you hurt? Did you want me to reach out to you? Did you miss me? Even just a bit? I doubt it.

You were the first to ever read my poems. Poetry leads to you, your name is etched unto my poems. No one ever appreciated and was so eager to listen to me rant about poetry except you. Thank you for that.

About the thing about you holding me back from being my best version. I would prove to you that my best version is when I was with you. You made me bring out the best in me, you made me want to achieve so high.

In those times that I feel drained, I know I could crawl back into your arms for comfort. Your hugs were my home. No words could ever express how your hugs had healed me. It's as if, when I'm on your arms; I feel safe, I feel at home. Hugs had always been our thing. No one ever brings that much comfort in a hug except you.

You made me love you so purely. I might have loved you in a different way but when I uttered those words, don't you know that I didn't care about how you see me or how I see you. I just wanted to keep you in my life as someone I can lean to, someone I trust, someone I can be myself with. Someone I can express my feelings to, just.. someone.

I'm sorry for the times that I insulted you or shouted profanities at you. I'm sorry.

Dalam diam, aku menuliskan ini bukan untuk menggugat, bukan pula untuk menuntut kembali apa pun yang telah menjauh. Tapi karena ada sesuatu dalam diriku yang belum selesai sejak engkau perlahan menghilang, seperti kabut yang surut tanpa sempat diucap selamat tinggal.

Kita tak pernah bersua. Tak ada jabat tangan, tak ada pertemuan mata. Namun, betapa ajaib takdir bekerja: rasa ini tumbuh, rindu ini mekar, meski dunia hanya mempertemukan kita lewat layar yang dingin dan suara yang tak bisa disentuh.

Kini engkau jauh, kembali ke negerimu yang tak pernah aku jejaki, dan aku hanya bisa menatap hari-hari yang kehilangan satu nama yang biasa hadir, bukan dalam wujud, melainkan dalam pesan, tawa, dan percakapan kecil yang dulunya sederhana, tapi kini terasa begitu berharga.

Tali penghubung di antara kita telah terurai. Tapi aku tahu, masih terbuka jalan bagimu untuk menyapa meski tak lagi langsung ke hatiku, namun lewat jalan tak langsung, lewat perantara yang menyimpan jejakmu dan menyampaikan bayanganmu dari kejauhan. Aneh rasanya, mengetahui kau masih ada, namun tak lagi menjangkauku seperti dulu. Seolah aku masih bisa mendengar suaramu dari balik dinding waktu, tapi tak mampu memanggilmu kembali.

Zico, jika surat ini sampai padamu entah dibaca atau sekadar lewat di tepian hatimu ketahuilah aku tidak menunggumu dengan tangan tergenggam, tapi dengan hati yang tetap menyisakan ruang. Bukan karena aku tak bisa melupakan, tapi karena aku percaya apa yang pernah nyata di hati, tak mudah pupus hanya oleh jarak dan senyap.

Mungkin rindu ini hanya milikku. Mungkin juga, diam-diam, kau menyimpannya dengan cara yang berbeda. Dan jika demikian, itu sudah cukup. Sebab tak semua rasa harus kembali, tapi sebagian hanya perlu dikenang... dengan tenang.

Dengan hati yang pernah tersentuh oleh kehadiranmu,
Aku, Faza.

of connection between these two bodies
looks like only in words. And if you asked me
about the weather,I’d tell you:
the sea embraces the sun not to extinguish it,
but to make it more beautiful.

with me felt like it wasn’t something passing 
from the very first moment.

I’m not doing well.
How could you ever think my happiness could exist without you?
Every time something good happens in my life, the first thing I feel is regret because I can’t share it with you.

You once said you wanted to stay in my life. After everything, I still can’t tell… did you really miss me? Or did you just miss the comfort of my presence?
Do you even know how deeply I loved you?

Over time, I realized something painful:
You only seemed to miss me when you were feeling low.
And me? I loved you more in those moments. I always told you—I didn’t care about being part of your happy times.
You could cut me off in your joy, but in your darkest hours, I just wanted to be the one beside you.

But what can I do when the person I love most ends up being the one who makes me feel most broken?
You left me… for someone else. So tell me—do I even have the right to speak now?

I cry, silently, every time.
You said you see my progress, but why don’t you ever see the tears behind it?
Why can’t you see how empty I feel without you—like an ocean with no waves, no life, just silence.

I’m not a weak person.
But everything I feel… comes from a heart that was made only for you.

You chose others over me.
Even when I would’ve given you the whole world of mine just to see you smile, you listened to their voices, not mine.
Still… you are not a terrible chapter in my life. You are unforgettable.

You said you want to die early then why not die with me? Or better, live with me.

You still have so much to do.
So much to achieve. So much happiness waiting for you.
Please, just hold my hand . Even if it’s just once.
We still have a long way to go.

I don’t want anything in return.
Whatever happened… please forgive me.
My heart is still innocent.
It still belongs to you.

And… if I can make just one last request—
Could you unblock me from everywhere?
I promise, I’ll never disturb you.
I won’t post anything that makes you feel uncomfortable.
I won’t even message you.
Just let me stay in touch silently.
If that’s too much… then block me forever.
But if there’s even a small space in your heart left for me… just let me exist in your world from a distance. Please forgive me my best freind 🙏🥲💕💫

I know you’re with someone else now. And I know she probably makes you laugh, and maybe she gives you the kind of peace I never could. I hope she loves you well. I hope you’re truly happy, even if it’s not with me. And yet… it feels like you put a curse on me, amor. Un hechizo. Porque no puedo dejar de amarte. No importa cuánto lo intente, no importa cuánto me duela te sigo amando. You haunt me. In my sleep, in songs, in random moments when the world goes quiet and I’m alone with the ache in my chest.

Every time I close my eyes, I remember stupid things. How you laughed. How we did stupid silly things in games. How I called you Gigi, Green Pea, whatever silly name that made you mine for a second. I romanticized the hell out of you. I still do. It’s pathetic, I know. Pero es que eras mi lugar seguro, y ahora ya no sé dónde estoy. You were my favorite what if. My almost. My forever that never happened.

And the truth is… I don’t think I’ll ever stop loving you. Even if you forget me. Even if you never say my name again. Even if I disappear from your memory like I never existed. I will still be here, quietly loving you from a distance, hoping one day you’ll feel it, like a ghost in the wind, like a whisper that follows you home. Maybe in another life, Green Pea, we’d get it right. Maybe in that life, you’d stay. (I’ll most likely be writing more because maybe if I pour out every last drop of love I have left for you, I’ll finally be able to move on… if I even can. I don’t know. Maybe this is just me screaming into nothing, trying to empty a heart that never stops bleeding your name. Maybe if I write enough, I’ll stop waiting for someone who’s already forgotten me.)
