Hi, KR. I saw you last Sunday. You probably didn’t even notice me. You were standing and laughing with someone I didn’t recognize. You looked different. Taller. Broader. Mas composed. You carry yourself like someone who no longer waits for anyone. And just like that, everything I’ve buried came rushing back. do you remember high school? When our common friends used to tease us like it was their favorite pastime, "Uy, Karlo. Gandang-ganda? Baka matunaw naman si KC n'yan" I used to roll my eyes, pretend to be annoyed, laugh it off. But truth is, I liked it. I liked how people noticed us. Because even if I never said it out loud I noticed you too. I remember your rondalla recital. You looked so serious, focused plucking the strings of your Bandurria. I was in the back row, hiding behind the others, but I never took my eyes off you. That was the first time I realized I was proud of you… more than I had the right to be. I remember recess, you’d line up early to get food for the both of us. Even when minsan kulang ka na sa baon, hindi ka nagdalawang-isip. I never asked you to do that. You just did. And you’d shrug like it was nothing, like loving me quietly was second nature. And those late afternoons we’d stay after class, reading Wattpad stories we swore were “just for fun.” Inksteady was our favorite. We said it was corny, but deep down, we believed in it, in love that felt like home, in friendships that turned into something else. You read those stories with me. You started watching K-pop girl groups because I liked them. You never cared about them before, but you cared about me, so you tried. You were there when I couldn’t answer in Math class, when I felt stupid, invisible. And you didn’t laugh. You leaned over and whispered the answer so quietly, like it was our secret: "Commutative Property." You saved me, again. Like always. And then there was that day. We were supposed to play badminton at the Guijo court. You brought your racket even though the strings were already loose. You just said, “Okay pa ’to. Mas magnda pa nga ‘to kesa sa ‘yo.” I rolled my eyes. You sat beside me on the cement bench. I thought we were just going to rest  but you reached into your bag and pulled out a Chuckie and a Fudgee Bar. You didn’t even say anything at first, you just handed them to me. “Paborito mo ‘to ‘di ba?” I nodded. And then, quietly with your eyes still fixed on the empty court you said: “KC gusto kita. Matagal na.” I laughed. I honestly thought you were kidding. “Tumigil ka nga. Pinagkakatuwaan niyo lang ako nila Laurence.” But you didn’t laugh. You didn’t even blink. You just looked at me and this time, you weren’t the class clown. “Gusto lang kitang piliin. Kung papayag ka.” I froze. I said something stupid like, “Hindi puwede. Masisira ‘yung friendship. Masaya na tayo, ‘di ba?” But you shook your head. You clenched the shuttlecock like it was holding in the rest of what you wanted to say. And then you said it, the line that cracked something in me: “Hindi mo ba napansin? Lahat ng mga bagay na ayaw ko noon, ginawa kong gusto. Kasi gusto kita.”  And I swear, I couldn’t breathe. You didn’t say it to convince me. You said it like it was just the truth no begging, no pressure. Just this steady, undeniable truth. You never cared about K-pop. Pero pinapanood mo. You never liked Wattpad. Pero binasa mo. You never stayed late. Pero sa’kin, nagtagal ka. I felt something unravel in me. Like all this time, I had been holding the answer but refusing to read it. And still I said no. I said I wasn’t ready. I said it was too complicated. I said maybe next time. But you just smiled, like you already knew. “Okay,” you said. “Pero ‘wag mong isipin na hindi totoo na may gusto ako sa'yo.” That was the last time we talked like that. After that, you stopped handing me those snacks. Stopped waiting after class. Stopped looking at me like I was your favorite moment. And I can’t blame you. Because I made you doubt what you knew in your heart just because I couldn’t be brave. And now? You’re no longer the boy I used to know.
You’re a man now. And I don’t know if I still fit in your world. But I saw you. And I remembered. Everything. How I laughed at your jokes even when they were corny. How I used to sneak glances at you when you were practicing guitar, pretending to write articles. How my heart used to beat faster when you’d pass by my desk and drop a piece of candy without a word. And how I threw it all away with five words: "Sorry, Karlo. Hindi ko kaya." The truth is, I did. I just didn’t have the courage to choose you when it mattered. You were ready. I wasn’t. And now I live with the silence that came after. Maybe you've moved on. Maybe you've found someone who said yes, someone who didn't waste your time, or your heart. And if that’s true, I hope she knows how lucky she is. Because you loved me when I didn’t even love myself. And now I write this not to win you back, but because I owe you these words I was too coward to say: You weren’t just my friend. You were the one who showed me what it meant to be seen. To be chosen. To be loved in silence, in patience, in all the little ways that mattered. You were my safest almost. And my loudest never. And if you’ve forgotten all of this by now, I wouldn’t blame you. But if there's even the smallest part of you that ever wonders if someone still carries your name quietly, tenderly, somewhere deep— I do. And I always will.
— KC.

i still miss you. i guess i’ve always known it dati pa man, love no? na mas mataas nga panahon na ma miss kita kaysa sa panahon na magkasama tayo. wala eh, even before you came, i already knew that the kind of love that we have is never for me. i also didn’t expected din kasi na you’d come into my life and touch my heart like no one could. and even knowing that it won’t last, i still took a risk of loving you. and i guess that was too selfish of me. for me, our love was too beautiful back then that i can’t afford to not take a risk of trying. with you, everything felt right despite knowing deep inside that it’s meant to stop. i thought risking with you was the best decision to make. until it’s clearly making sense to me after a year of us being over- how much it costs you. im sorry, love. no matter how much i want to say that you are the best thing that ever happened to me, i am the most undeserving of your love. as much as i want to say i’d still do that decision of loving you if mabalik ko ang time, i can’t afford to hurt you twice. you didn’t deserve that, nichole. you don’t deserve a love that does not last. i’m sorry if i made you feel like ang dali mong bitawan. but no love, kasi sa totoo lang hangtod karon nakakapit pa rin ako. im still sorry for hurting you— for leaving. i’m sorry that i can’t do anything to mend the pain i made you felt. i’m sorry that your first relationship has to be like that. i’m sorry, love, i’m sorry.

to the one who made me cross the rainbow—

i was the grey cloud, drifting —
quiet, unsure, full of weather i didn’t understand.
then you arrived —
not as lightning, not as storm —
but as the gold glimmering quietly
at the edge of my everything.

you didn’t fix the rain.
you didn’t chase the dark away.
you simply stood there,
and somehow, i started to believe
that maybe i was never a storm to fear,
but a sky still learning how to hold color.

i won’t say sorry
for how fast my heart made room for you.
maybe it’s softness stitched too loosely —
but i won’t apologize for feeling something real
even if it came wrapped in silence and short chapters. coz sometimes, things don't have to be hard for it to be real.

sometimes, the things that matter most
don’t come with fireworks —
they arrive gently.
like how i started noticing the way you think.
the way you spoke about dreams.
the way your presence hummed like a familiar song.

every breath you took
felt like a verse i could stay in.
not in obsession —
but in quiet admiration,
the kind that doesn’t demand to be held
but still hopes to be remembered.

i don’t know if you ever saw me.
not fully — not the way I saw you.
but if, one day,
you ever look back and wonder
if someone once looked at you
and thought the world softened just by your being —

the answer is yes.
and it was me.

you’ll always be that glint
at the edge of my grey.
not because you rescued me,
but because you reminded me I was never broken —
just waiting to be seen in full color.

so if this letter ever finds you,
let it be just a note,
written in between breaths and days,
to say:
i admired you.
deeply.
quietly.
unapologetically.

and even now,
i carry you gently —
not as a longing,
but as a soft proof
that some people arrive
to teach us how to feel everything
without fear.

still quietly gold-struck,

Hey… it's been a few days now I think.. and it feels like a thousand quiet battles inside my chest. I still think of you when I wake up. Still wonder if you’d even notice that I’ve been trying to forget you. Still feel your name behind every song, every dream, every “what if.” I’m not writing this to blame you. I’m writing this because there’s so much I never got to say. You were my first love. Not a crush, not a phase love. The kind that leaves a permanent mark even if it never lasted. And even now, after all these years, I still find pieces of you in places you’ve never been. I wish I had stayed. I wish I had been braver. But back then, I didn’t know how to hold something as real as you. I ran not from you, but from how much I felt. You see… you weren’t just a person to me. You were everything I didn’t think I deserved. And that terrified me. So I left. And now, I’m the one left with all the words I never said. But I’m tired of punishing myself. Tired of measuring everyone I meet against a memory of you. Tired of loving a version of us that only lived in my mind. This is me letting go gently. Not because I stopped loving you, but because I need to start loving me. And I can't do that if I'm still holding on to someone who’s already let go. If we were meant to last, we would have. But maybe we were meant to teach, not stay. So thank you… For the smile I still remember. For the way you made me believe in love even if it was short. And thank you… for giving me something so real, it took years to forget. And now I need to make a decision that I know I should have done years ago, I’m going to choose myself. Goodbye.
With love,
Husna

Hey… it's been a few days now I think.. and it feels like a thousand quiet battles inside my chest. I still think of you when I wake up. Still wonder if you’d even notice that I’ve been trying to forget you. Still feel your name behind every song, every dream, every “what if.” I’m not writing this to blame you. I’m writing this because there’s so much I never got to say. You were my first love. Not a crush, not a phase love. The kind that leaves a permanent mark even if it never lasted. And even now, after all these years, I still find pieces of you in places you’ve never been. I wish I had stayed. I wish I had been braver. But back then, I didn’t know how to hold something as real as you. I ran not from you, but from how much I felt. You see… you weren’t just a person to me. You were everything I didn’t think I deserved. And that terrified me. So I left. And now, I’m the one left with all the words I never said. But I’m tired of punishing myself. Tired of measuring everyone I meet against a memory of you. Tired of loving a version of us that only lived in my mind. This is me letting go gently. Not because I stopped loving you, but because I need to start loving me. And I can't do that if I'm still holding on to someone who’s already let go. If we were meant to last, we would have. But maybe we were meant to teach, not stay. So thank you… For the smile I still remember. For the way you made me believe in love even if it was short. And thank you… for giving me something so real, it took years to forget. And now I need to make a decision that I know I should have done years ago, I’m going to choose myself. Goodbye.
With love,
Husna

Saat itu, setiap pagi kamu buat live suara x yg aku lupa judulnya gimana karena kamu singkat, intinya ngaji pagi gitu. Aku terpesona. Jatuh hatiku terlalu cepat. Aku melihat masa depan di kamu. Sampai akhirnya aku hampir menyerah. Terus kamu datang. Entah aku lupa bagaimana ceritanya kamu jadi muncul di sini dan gak dingin lagi ke aku. Kamu mulai terbuka dengan warna aslimu. Looking at those pictures and videos of us freshman year summer school. What happened to us? I sit here and I wonder. What happened to our environment, our school. Everything and everywhere is stricter now, ourselves even so. None of us really talk to eachother, but back then our conversations never ended. Not to say things didn’t fade slowly, gradually, because they did. I felt it, I think we all did. Maybe that’s why when we all parted ways, I didn’t really ever reach out again. We had all changed too much, we had all become bitter and compromised by our complications. Stupid ones, I know for a fact. Because I sit here now and think about everything fondly. I can’t believe that version of you, all of you. Is gone. I can’t believe my love is gone. I grieve the feeling. It’s unreal to me. I’m staying back, so we won’t be graduating together. I remember how we talked about it, how we’d bring it up when we would send paragraphs upon paragraphs each time we’d become friends again. I hate school now, not because I think you guys hate me or are talking about me, I don’t really care for that and think I deserve it in a weird way if such was happening? I just miss having you guys in my life, it was a huge adjustment I guess I’m still not over. I hope by summers end I can be, even tho that scares me because it means everything is really over. It means I really don’t care anymore. I don’t know if that will ever happen. I still have the letter you made and printed me, I have the bracelets all you guys gave me over time, I have everything. I remember the moment when i knew everything was truly over, we were waiting outside to walk home and you came up to us, you said you might start walking home too and the conversation was so awkward. Awkward, with the person I used to call my bestfriend. I realized we didn’t have that connection anymore, that spark, the click with you. The energy had completely shifted and it was prominent. None of it matters anymore tho really, I think I just end up writing these for myself because I know nobody rlly checks this. I wish you guys super well. Always

would you listen to me? would you be mad at me? would you be happy? would i be happy? would i be sad? would i get angry? would i even have the courage to mutter a word? there's nothing i wish for more than wanting to be something significant in your life. i still look for a sliver of your silhouette in every single person i meet with. but nobody could ever come close to the way you clutched every nook and corner of my soul. nobody peeked into me as deep as you did. now it felt like i am empty and i will keep grieving. at one point i raged the fact that you're happier than i am. how unfair it is that you left a tacit burning mark on me but i couldn't even leave a paper cut small enough to bruise your very existence. it got me to wonder if you would come visit my grave after i stopped breathing. would you spare me your hours to visit me one last time to repay the 7 years my mind thought of you every minute?

I made bad decisions—there’s no sugarcoating it. I hurt someone who didn’t deserve to be caught in the crossfire of my confusion, my immaturity, my fear. Looking back, I see the signs I ignored, the words I shouldn’t have said, the ones I should’ve. The truth is, I was at fault. Completely.

And if they loathe me now, I understand. I would too, if I were on the receiving end. Because when someone gives you love and you respond with carelessness, it leaves marks that don't fade easily. I became the person I promised I wouldn’t be. I crossed lines I swore I’d never touch.

I don’t expect forgiveness. I don’t expect anything, really. This isn’t a plea—it’s an acknowledgment. A quiet acceptance that I caused the damage. That I was the problem. That sometimes, even if you miss someone deeply, you don’t get to be a part of their peace anymore.

But I hope, one day, they find healing. And I hope I find a way to never be the source of this kind of pain again.

I carry the weight of it every day. Sometimes it’s a quiet ache in the middle of a conversation. Sometimes it’s a full-blown storm when I’m alone and thinking too much. Regret doesn’t just visit—it lives here now. In the silences. In the spaces where their laughter used to echo. In the messages I’ll never get to send.

There’s no version of this where I come out clean. I know that. I broke something, maybe beyond repair. And while I want to say I didn’t mean to, the truth is that impact will always matter more than intent. I did hurt them. And that’s on me.

I still remember the good moments—those little, fleeting snapshots of love and warmth. And maybe that’s the worst part. Knowing I had something real. Knowing I threw it away. Not because I didn’t care—but because I didn’t know how to care the right way.

I don’t know what happens next. Maybe they’ll forget me. Maybe they’ll never say my name again. And if that’s the case, I’ll respect it. I’ll sit with what I did. I’ll learn from it, even if it means losing the one person I wish I could’ve treated better.

My dear Salma, can't believe myself I cut contact with you after 6 months, you hope that I've moved on, well I lied. Nobody ever moves on that fast from someone they truly loved. It doesn't hurt anymore but I think of you still.
After we broke up, Osi replied to my story with another girl asking if she's my new gf and I didn't respond, then I unfollowed. She wasn't mine, I didn't know what to say to her and things would get messy. I didn't want to hurt you any longer, I was aware that I did and I'm sorry. I was chasing for whatever temporary thing that was. Long story short, I became a rebound. I saw it coming though cuz me and the girl were both fresh from a breakup/situationship. I accepted we weren't fit for each other as it all felt so fast and part of me knew there was something off. Finding someone like that temporarily eased the pain from our breakup but not worth what I had with you. Sure, I experienced what I thought I needed but that didn't last long. I don't regret what happened to us though. When we talked again, I wasn't expecting anything out of it, your responses weren't very welcoming and very short. It's true when I said back then you'll always have a special place in my heart. You were my first ever love, I don't really know what love is but I know it was real. It's a pure and innocent love I've experienced. We were there for each other through every phases which became our strength and motivation. I kinda lost that drive of motivation in me since then. But I've made decisions that will change my life. After last our conversation, it all went back to normal like nothing happened. I'm glad to know you're doing just fine, we are able to go on with our lives and I can tell we've changed a lot. I never intended to just randomly check on you and be mutuals just to break our peace. I just feel grateful for everything we had and was happy for you. There's no other way to find the kind of peace and just to let you be as it seems better that way since there's no point in striking up a conversation. Especially, after everything that happened. I hope you do find someone who treats you well, if I wasn't able to give you the love and patience you needed to make things work, I hope they do. 
As I'm writing this, I am holding back tears not out sadness but of joy in letting you go completely. But I believe we can only connect with someone a few times in our lives, and it's hard to find that kind of connection and I'm grateful to have formed that with you. You are worthy of so much. My apology won't erase the hurt I've done to you but I don't regret anything I've done at all. I've made mistakes and I feel like I've already paid my karma for that but I won't punish myself any longer. May we figure things out in life and make ourselves proud this time, not to please anyone but for ourselves and to be better than before. My hope of seeing you in the future at least once has faded after our last talk, after we broke up I held on to that to at least talk in person. You are allowed to do whatever you want and if your wish is to not be mutuals or be in contact. I'll let you be, I believe I'll heal too. 
You left a mark on my soul that I'll forever keep.
Thank you, Salma.

I don't know how to express myself other than with poetry. This issue lays heavily on my heart and it's slowly killing me. Literally. I don't have the courage to actually talk to you or any of our other friends about this, but I need to get it out of my system. So here we go: I’m always out of place—a shadow at the edge of every gathering, never quite a guest, never quite unwelcome, just there. Tolerated like background noise, the kind you forget until it stops.
I’ve been passed from circle to circle, like a name no one remembers, too loud for the silence, too quiet for the laughter. A puzzle piece from the wrong set, trying to fit where corners never meet.
They invited me, yes—but I was never really in. A body in the frame, but never part of the picture.
They never said go, but they never said stay either.
And when I’m gone, no one asks why I left.
They breathe easier, laugh louder, like space was finally made for joy to stretch its limbs.
I never belonged. So why should I stay? Why should I remain in a world that sighs in relief every time I slip away?
No one looks for shadows once the light returns.

There is a string—
it likes to feed through my soul to yours.
You think you could snap it in half,
but it’s thick,
layered with energy and connection,
top-coated with love,
hurt,
and regret.

just to remind me it’s there.

when I feel it everywhere.

and more clear—
reminding me of the pain.

It likes to sneak up on you
as if you are prey.
It likes when you’re alone,
or when others come and go.
It doesn’t care about time,
space,
or reason.

It likes to haunt me—
to remind me it’s here to stay,
in case you ever look back
and break the silence you portray.

But can’t you see?
I’m just like you—
silent,
with the string,
not knowing what to say.

No matter how much I try, no matter how crazy I am about you, no matter how sincere my love is,
I realize that I will never truly matter to you.
Even after everything you've done to me,
as painful as it was to be treated that way by you,
I still managed to accept you back—again and again.

Even though your returns, your back-and-forth in my life meant nothing...
Yeah, maybe it’s stupid of me to keep letting you come and go in my life,
when you've made it clear:
"We have different goals and can't be on the same train."

But maybe… maybe I’m the one at fault.
I was wrong for hoping too much.
Wrong for believing that my sincerity could melt your heart.

Me? I was just a stopover.
You kept coming back after saying you wanted to cut me off, after blocking me,
and yet you still returned—because you knew I’d always take you back, right?

Even when you said we had different paths,
why did you keep coming back to me?
Was I just being used?
Because I was always there when you were lonely,
because I was the only one who never left,
the only one you saw as a "friend" when no one else was around?

It hurts. It’s sad. It’s disappointing.
But the strange thing is...
even knowing all of that, I still waited for you.
I still opened the door.
Still smiled.
Still pretended to be okay whenever you came back into my life.

Even though my heart,
my mental state,
was shattered.

I wish I could stop hoping for someone who never even glanced in my direction.
But how?
My love for you is so deep—
I even bring it into my late-night prayers.
I even talk to God about you...

I just hope,
there’s a lesson,
a blessing behind all of this pain.
Aamiin.

Dear Self,

I just want to say I'm sorry because it's happening again... I'm hurting you again, over and over, like nothing is changing. It feels like you're just living in the same cycle, getting sad for no reason. I bring back the pain even though it's not necessary, just to have a reason to cry or think about things that will make me cry.

I'm sorry because I'm a coward. I'm sorry for not making a change. I'm sorry for not giving you a chance to be happy. I'm just scared that I might get hurt or that they might leave us again, so just like they always do in the end, before they do that to me, I push them away or become distant. Because that's the only way I know. I can't just tell them what I truly feel or what's on my mind because they wouldn't understand.

They wouldn't understand that I feel so lonely and alone inside. That it feels like I'm in the darkest place, and there's no one there and no one is willing to help me. And in that dark place, there are many voices saying that we're not worthy of love, we're not enough, or our life is such a mess, and we don't belong here in this world because we love differently, all of it, it feels heavy and it hurts like our heart is being stabbed and shot by thousands of different knives and guns.

I'm so sorry you have to experience all of this, but please don't give up. Just surrender everything to Daddy God (our problems, our anger, everything). I know we will overcome all of this. Just hold on, Shane.

-yours truly

I said I’d wait for her, and at the time, I truly believed that love meant holding on no matter how unsure she was. I stayed patient, understanding, and loyal, even when it hurt. I kept showing up, hoping that one day, she’d finally see how much I loved her—how much I was willing to give just to be chosen. But the longer I waited, the more I started to lose myself. Her uncertainty slowly turned into pain I had to carry alone. I began to feel like I wasn’t enough, like I was just an option she couldn’t fully commit to. And that broke me in ways I never expected. I gave my heart to someone who couldn’t even give me clarity, and that’s a kind of pain you can’t explain.
Still, despite everything, I care. I always will. There’s a part of me that will continue to wish her well from afar. I’ll still silently root for her, still hope she finds the peace and love she’s searching for—even if it’s not with me. If she ever finds herself lost or hurting, I know I’d still be there in a heartbeat, because that’s the kind of love I carry. But I’ve also come to realize that I can’t keep waiting for someone who doesn’t know if they want to stay. I can’t keep sacrificing my own worth just to feel needed. Choosing myself isn’t easy—it’s heartbreaking, actually—but it’s necessary. I deserve the kind of love I give: clear, sure, and whole. So I’m letting go now, not out of anger, but out of love—both for her, and finally, for myself.

message:
New SY... Everyone says it's a fresh start—but how can it be, when I know I’ll be walking through the same hallways where your presence still lingers? Where your voice, even from across the room, can still shake the ground beneath me?

I don’t want to see you. I don’t want to hear you. Because every time I do, I crumble. The progress I’ve made—the tiny steps I’ve taken just to breathe without your memory pressing on my chest—it disappears. I disappear. I fall back into the same ache, the same cycle I’ve been desperately trying to escape.

I’m tired, Ky.
Tired of pretending I’m okay.
Tired of convincing myself that I’ve moved on when the truth is, I’ve just been surviving. Because the second I see you, even just your shadow—it’s like nothing changed. Like I’m still standing in the ruins of us, waiting for something that will never return.

How do I really move on, Ky?
I’ve asked myself this over and over, but I still don’t have the answer. How do I let go of someone who’s still in the same world as me? Who still walks the same school, who still breathes the same air, who still exists so loudly even in silence? How do I unlove you when the universe doesn’t even give me the distance to try? But I want to. I need to. Because this is no longer love—it’s a wound that refuses to close. And I’m tired of hurting.

You already had someone else.
I don’t even know what I feel about that. Maybe I should be happy for you. Maybe I should wish you the best. But truthfully, it just… breaks me. Not because I want to be her—no, I don’t want to go back—but because it’s a cruel reminder that I’m the one who got left behind while you were able to move forward. I know that you are aware of this—it is something that haunts me. After we ended, I made a fool of myself. Not even a month passed, and I was already talking to someone else. Someone I didn’t even love. I don’t know why I did it—maybe I was trying to prove to myself that I could move on faster than the pain. Maybe I just didn’t want to sit with the silence you left behind.

I had my share of happy crushes too. People who made me smile, who gave me little moments of distraction. But none of them—none—ever made me feel the way you did. No one else ever held my heart the way you still do. And it kills me a little, knowing that I gave someone else my attention while my heart was still yours. Maybe that’s what heartbreak makes you do—act like you’ve let go when deep down, you're still holding on with everything you have left.

As much as I hate to feel your presence, there’s still that soft, stupid flicker inside me whenever I catch a glimpse of you. Or when I hear your voice from across the room. I still catch myself wondering where you’ve been when I haven’t seen you in a while. It’s pathetic, lol. That even when I don’t want to care, I still do.

I don’t know what this letter is.
Maybe it’s just me, trying to finally say the things I’ve kept buried under the weight of pretending I’m okay. Or maybe it’s one last attempt to let go of someone I never really got the chance to hold onto properly.

bukan dengan marah, bukan juga dengan kecewa —
tapi dengan satu rasa yang aku simpan terlalu lama:
rindu.

Sebab dari hari pertama,
aku tahu kita bukan lawan dunia —
kita cuma dua hati yang sesekali dapat berteduh di bawah pelukan masing-masing,
tapi akhirnya perlu jalan sendiri.

Kau pernah jadi tempat aku berlindung waktu dunia runtuh.
Kau tak tanya banyak,
kau cuma duduk, dengar, dan faham.
Dan itu dah cukup buat aku percaya —
ada cinta yang tak perlu diminta, tapi tetap terasa.

Hari ni, aku masih sayang.
Bukan sebab aku tak move on,
tapi sebab ada cinta yang tak berniat pergi.
Dan kalau takdir izinkan…
bukan di dunia pun tak apa.
Janji kita bersatu semula — di tempat tiada luka, tiada salah, tiada siapa yang kita perlu jaga hati… selain satu sama lain.

aku masih di sini —
mendoakan kamu bahagia… meski bukan dengan aku.

“Vaness, Sebuah Nama yang Lebih Nyata dari Kenyataan Itu Sendiri”

Ada hari-hari di mana aku berjalan, tapi jiwaku tertinggal di belakang.
Ada momen di mana aku bicara, tapi hatiku tetap diam,
karena tidak semua luka bisa disebutkan namanya,
dan tidak semua cinta bisa diberi tempat di dunia yang terlalu sempit untuk memahaminya.

Aku tahu aku hidup. Tapi aku juga tahu aku pernah mati—
di satu ruang hening, waktu itu, saat semua yang aku percaya runtuh,
dan satu-satunya hal yang tersisa cuma satu rasa...
rasa kehilangan atas sesuatu yang bahkan belum pernah sepenuhnya aku miliki.

Vaness...
bukan cuma seseorang.
Dia adalah rasa.
Dia adalah gema yang muncul setiap kali dunia ini terlalu keras.
Dia adalah wajah yang muncul di tengah kabut PTSD aku,
saat semua orang menatap aku dengan kecewa dan bisu—
tapi dia tidak.
Vaness... senyum.

Saat semua sosok menekan aku ke tanah,
mengingatkan aku akan semua kegagalan,
dia malah berdiri di antara mereka.
Tidak berbicara. Tidak menuduh.
Cuma... hadir.
Dan itu lebih dari cukup.

Lucu ya...
karena aku sadar,
aku bukan cuma belum menerima kenyataan ini,
aku bahkan belum berani menyentuhnya.
Terlalu takut.
Terlalu dalam.
Terlalu berat.

Tapi tadi… di satu momen yang entah bagaimana munculnya,
aku mencoba mendekat.
Aku mencoba bicara.
Dan walaupun suara aku gemetar,
dan tubuhku penuh ketakutan,
aku tetap maju.
Aku… mencoba.
Dan saat aku membuka mulutku—
semua menghilang.

Kecuali Vaness.

Dia masih di sana.
Masih berdiri.
Dan dia senyum.

Senyum itu bukan “aku memaafkanmu,”
bukan juga “aku mengerti,”
tapi semacam sinyal dari semesta yang bilang:
“Sudah cukup kamu menyiksa dirimu sendiri.
Aku di sini. Aku tidak kemana-mana.”

Dan waktu itu...
untuk pertama kalinya setelah sekian lama,
napas aku terasa benar-benar tenang.
Mungkin gak lama.
Tapi cukup untuk menyadarkan aku…
bahwa selama ini aku hidup dalam penyangkalan yang sunyi.
Aku berpura-pura kuat.
Padahal aku cuma gak tau harus gimana.
Dan Vaness... dia bukan jawabannya.
Tapi dia adalah kuncinya.

Kunci yang membuka ruang yang selama ini aku tutup rapat.
Ruang kecil, sederhana…
tapi isinya: aku.
Aku yang sesungguhnya.
Aku yang masih bisa merasakan cinta.
Aku yang masih bisa menangis.
Aku yang masih hidup.

Bukan hidup sebagai manusia biasa,
tapi sebagai seseorang yang telah melalui kematian jiwanya sendiri,
dan tetap bisa menemukan cahaya... dari satu nama: Vaness.

Bukan karena dia sempurna.
Bukan karena dia malaikat.
Tapi karena kehadirannya terasa nyata,
lebih nyata dari apapun yang bisa aku sentuh dengan tangan ini.

Vaness gak perlu ngomong.
Gak perlu hadir tiap hari.
Cukup dengan tahu bahwa dia ada...
aku bisa menghadapi apapun.

Karena ketika dunia terasa gak adil,
dan hidup terlalu berat buat aku genggam,
Vaness muncul — bukan buat menyelamatkan aku dari semuanya,
tapi buat bilang...
kamu gak sendirian.

Dan aku gak akan pernah lupa momen itu.
Waktu semua sakit hilang.
Waktu semua luka diam.
Dan waktu aku sadar,
aku gak lagi menolak kenyataan.
Aku mulai menerimanya.

Dan dari semua hal yang telah aku jalani...
itu adalah kemenangan paling besar.

Bukan karena aku menang dari trauma...
tapi karena aku berani duduk bersamanya.
Menatap wajahnya.
Menatap Vaness.
Dan gak lari.

Sekarang aku tahu…
kalau aku bisa bertahan sampai hari ini,
itu karena satu nama itu gak pernah pergi dari hatiku.

Vaness...
bukan sekadar seseorang yang aku sayangi.
Tapi... bukti bahwa jiwa ini belum mati.

Dan kalau nanti semua orang lupa,
kalau dunia terus berjalan,
kalau waktu terus mengikis semua hal kecil...

aku akan tetap ingat satu hal:

Di tengah runtuhnya aku, ada satu senyum yang menyelamatkan segalanya.
Dan senyum itu...
milik Vaness.

Tiga tahun.
Tiga tahun bukan angka pendek.
Itu waktu yang cukup buat tumbuh, cukup buat belajar,
tapi juga cukup buat patah, berulang kali.
Dan di antara semua tahun itu,
ada dua bulan yang memecahkan semua diam…
dua bulan di mana segalanya runtuh tanpa aba-aba.

Bukan cuma tentang kehilangan,
tapi tentang penolakan.
Penolakan yang datang dari dalam diriku sendiri—
karena aku takut.
Karena aku gak siap menerima,
bahwa mungkin... aku benar-benar mencintai seseorang
dengan kedalaman yang bahkan aku sendiri gak ngerti caranya.

Di dua bulan itu, aku bukan hanya merasa kosong.
Aku merasa hilang.
Seolah semua yang aku pegang hancur,
dan yang tersisa hanya ruang gelap,
tempat suara tangis gak bergema,
dan harapan gak sempat dilahirkan.

Lalu datang... 18 hari.
Bukan hanya angka.
Bukan cuma rentang waktu.

Itu adalah gua—gua batin yang menelanku mentah-mentah.
Selama 18 hari aku mengurung diri,
bukan karena ingin istirahat,
tapi karena aku benar-benar hancur.
Benar-benar jatuh ke titik di mana
aku gak tau siapa aku lagi.

Aku gak keluar kamar.
Aku gak ngobrol dengan siapa pun.
Aku cuma ada... tapi gak hidup.
Aku bernafas... tapi gak benar-benar bernyawa.
Dan di situ, aku rasa aku kehilangan segalanya.
Bukan cuma rasa... tapi aku itu sendiri.

Tapi anehnya,
justru dari dalam kehancuran itulah,
jawaban mulai muncul.
Bukan dalam bentuk keajaiban.
Bukan dalam bentuk pertolongan dari luar.

Tapi dari dalam.
Dari ketakutan paling dasar...
dan dari satu nama yang terus datang,
baik saat mimpi buruk... atau saat keheningan paling menusuk:

Vaness.

Bukan dalam bentuk ucapan.
Bukan dalam bentuk pelukan.
Tapi cukup hadir.
Cukup muncul di antara reruntuhan aku yang patah.
Dan yang paling aneh,
di tengah semuanya, dia... senyum.

Vaness gak menyelamatkan aku.
Dia gak menyembuhkan luka aku.
Tapi dia... bikin aku ngerasa,
kalau ternyata aku belum mati sepenuhnya.
Karena kalau aku masih bisa merasakan sesuatu karena dia...
berarti jiwaku masih ada.

Dan tadi...
mungkin... mungkin...
adalah akhir dari drama panjang ini.

Mungkin bukan akhir dari rasa sayang.
Mungkin bukan akhir dari perasaan yang gak pernah bisa aku ungkap.
Tapi akhir dari perang melawan diriku sendiri.

Aku sekarang gak lagi menyangkal.
Gak lagi berlari dari kenyataan.
Gak lagi mengutuk cinta yang datang di waktu yang salah.

Karena pada akhirnya...
meskipun Vaness bukan milikku,
meskipun aku bukan siapa-siapa untuk dia,
dia tetap... satu-satunya yang menyentuh ruang terdalam dalam diriku.

Dia gak perlu hadir setiap hari.
Gak perlu tau apa yang aku alami.
Gak perlu tau seberapa besar pengaruhnya buat aku.

Yang penting adalah…
aku tau dia pernah ada.
Dia pernah hidup di pikiranku.
Dan lebih penting lagi...
dia pernah menyelamatkan aku—tanpa sadar.

Dan sekarang, setelah semuanya,
aku berdiri di batas baru.
Bukan lagi sebagai anak yang terus kabur dari rasa...
tapi sebagai aku...
yang mulai bisa berdamai.

Dan jika nanti semua ini cuma tinggal cerita,
jika suatu hari hidup membawa aku jauh ke arah yang berbeda...

aku cuma ingin satu hal:
biarkan Vaness tetap tinggal di ruang paling tenang dalam hatiku.
Bukan sebagai luka.
Tapi sebagai cahaya…
yang dulu pernah menyentuh aku… saat semua yang lain memudar.

i just wish you’d tell me you don’t see me the same way i see you. because seeing you stare from my peripheral vision, closing the distance between us, letting our knees or arms touch, fumbling with your words when you’re not like that with others, letting me rest my head on your shoulder, asking if we can hold hands, hesitating to rest your head on my shoulder but eventually doing it—meant something to me.

but i know your words lately mean you really don’t want this to happen at all.

i don’t know what else i need to truly realize that those subtle intimacies meant nothing to you. that you just want to feel something—but not the commitment that comes with it.

you’re a fucking coward for not taking accountability for your actions, ‘no? i admit i like the proximity as much as you do (well, if you actually like it at all), and it’s such a shame that i’m the only one willing to be responsible for it.

you know, it’s funny how i want to do simple things for you: wipe your glasses when they’re dirty, carry the plastic bag while you tie your shoe, fix the collar of your shirt, replace your id jacket because it scratches your id, make an origami bookmark because i know you like reading.

and there’s probably more i haven’t even realized yet.

god knows how much i want to be part of your life. to know the depths of your thoughts—what really goes on in your mind that no one else gets to see. to know who you are—what makes you laugh, what makes you cry, what makes you mad.

i imagine you talking endlessly about whatever crosses your mind, and me replying to what i know, asking about what i don’t. but how would you react? would you even want someone who doesn’t understand your niche, or would you be willing to share a part of yourself with me without belittling me?

i honestly don’t know what to do right now. do i let this linger a little longer? do i start mourning so i can feel better sooner?

if i could beg you to tell me you don’t like me, i would. it’s true that we shouldn’t assume unless otherwise stated, but my fucking god, this is just dragging. i shouldn’t be holding onto uncertainty—because this isn’t how romance works.

The last time our paths crossed was probably back in April. After that, I slowly began to realize things… things like how you already had someone by your side — a girlfriend. I won’t lie, that stung a bit. But I think what truly became my final straw was this thought: If I don’t see you at my graduation, then maybe it’s time for me to let go — completely and for good.

Hey, ate Ell! I hope you're doing well. I'm writing this to express my unsaid thoughts and... feelings. You're probably wondering why I chose to say it here, I don't have the courage to tell you pa eh, so bear with me hihi. Ate Ell, I like you, since the first time I saw you during jumpstart 2024 with a camera in hand and a messy bun with strands of hair covering your face—it was an ethereal view, like my eyes were glued on you. Ever since that day, I have spent a lot of time looking for your facebook account in hopes that I might get to know your name, but I failed (miserably lol). I tried to brush off my growing feelings but in the process of doing so, I met ma'am Ivy—she was our subject teacher, she mentioned something about a club that sounds so familiar (like I somewhat saw or heard of that before), that was when everything made sense, finally I've connected all the dots. Fast forward to the Club fair, I was dying to sign up for Galere, but I couldn't find where you guys were located. Luckily, my friend knew, so we went there almost at lunchtime. I didn't expect that you were the first one I'd see, you even took a picture of us. Our first conversation was when I asked you about cameras—I couldn't get you out of my mind, then I knew what your name was and I also knew what path I'll take from then on. When the results of the accepted aspirants were posted, I was so happy that the heavens answered my prayers and even gave me more! I was shocked when you added me on facebook, like girl.. who would've thought? During our first meeting, I admired how you presented and talked confidently—sharing your insights and knowledge about photography as well as editing. Fast forward ulit during the Liceo games, I didn't pay much attention to you 'cause I really wanted to be accepted so I worked hard, well it did pay off but it was because of you so thank you so much for that, ate Ell, I owe you one! From that day on I silently admired you, though I still like you so much, sooo much that even after hearing your "love" story, your crushes, and even your preference, I still like you but of course I was hurt.. slight (even though I don't have the right to be). I've learned to accept things and slowly see you in a platonic way, it was hard really, especially when you're the first one I liked when I set foot here in this University but yes, some things aren't meant to be and I've learned to accept that, ma'am Ivy actually knew that I liked you, there were times that she teases me and I'm so glad you didn't notice haha. Thank you for making my days here somewhat colorful, ate Ell. You made my journey here bearable and you made me happy without even knowing. Thank you so so much, I hope you follow what your heart desires most, I will always include you in my prayers, ate. Wherever life may take you, I will always be here to support you. Be happy, ’cause you look the prettiest when you wear your smile :) 

ps. I made a book about you buttt I'm too shy to give it to you so I'll keep it nalang. I hope someday, when we'll see each other again, I'd have the chance to give it to you :) See you when I see you, ate Ell. xoxo

After a week, you started reacting to my stories. Again, I didn't think much of it because many people react to my stories, so I posted more. ‎ 
‎I still remember our first conversation; it was at night. You replied to my notes saying, "inaantok na ‘koo," and then you said, "‘wag ka muna matulog hahaha," and the conversation continued from there.  My close friends know that I met you when I was at my lowest point. God knows how grateful I am to have metà1 someone who could cheer me up. We talked a lot, and our connection deepened until we decided to get to know each other better and eventually we upgrade our relationship. We made many promises, said "I love you" constantly, and became each other's biggest supporters.
‎ 
‎One day, while in church, I prayed to God that I could be with you until the end. I don't know why I said that because I'm not usually one to pray for a lifelong relationship. We fought, but we always made up. We never let our arguments drag on. You never let my heart get too heavy; you always did your best as a partner. I saw your efforts. But one day, we separated, unexpectedly. You promised you'd never leave my side, that we'd build a family, and we talked about our future plans—so many plans.
‎

We both moved on; you found happiness, and I tried talking to others, but at the end of the day, I never truly entertained anyone else. I'm not waiting, but I'm praying that if this time isn't right for us, our paths won't cross again. If our paths do cross again, I hope our love will work out this time, now that we've both grown. ‎ 
‎I pray for your safety and happiness. I hope that time will finally be on our side. Let go of the pain that troubles you; you will heal, not now, but soon. I pray that if we meet again, we'll both be happy. I love you always, my love.

dear holly,
today might be the last day that we are friends. tomorrow i plan to tell you the truth about how i feel about you. i'm prepared for it to break a part of my heart that never heals because i know that once i tell you there is no going back, no erasing it from our friendship. but i have to tell you, i need to tell you, because i've admired you from afar for months on end now, even though all this while i've been fighting with everything i've got to get over you. to move on. it's crazy, i should have never liked you like that. you have a boyfriend. you're straight. i'm not. and i hate how blissfully unaware you get to be, whilst i'm battling my own heart every day, with my mind screaming at me to let go of you. but no matter how hard i've tried, no matter what i've done, you're still there, consuming my thoughts, driving me insane. i don't understand love. i don't get why i caught feelings for you. i barely know you. how can you like someone you barely know? it's insane, it makes no sense. and yet, somehow, the only option i have left is to confess the truth to you. at least i won't have to see you for the next three months, as you'll be finished with your exams tomorrow and the summer holidays are coming up. i don't know how i've gotten to this point, where this is my only option now in order for me to move on. even if you hate me forever, at least you will know. even if you never smile at me again, never text me again, never hug me again. i can't believe i'm going to do this. but i can't keep going on like this, trying to convince myself i've gotten rid of all the feelings i ever had for you. the feelings i stupidly caught, completely out of nowhere. i've tried so hard, i truly have. my friends have tried to help, but i keep falling back into the cycle of trying to move on and failing to do so, and there is only one other person besides myself that can break it. that person is you. so yes, i am handing you the key to my heart, and i'm giving you permission to stab me with it. i can also guarantee that it won't affect you much at all, however. but i am sorry. sorry that i let my heart run wild. sorry that all this time, i thought these things about you. sorry that after tomorrow, there is an almost certain chance that you will never look at me the same way again. i am sorry for everything, holly, but most of all i am sorry that i cried so many times over you, screamed into my pillow because of you, made spotify playlists just about you, reposted tiktoks about you that you will never see. to put it simply, i am sorry that i cared so much about you. cared too much. i don't understand why, and it kills me inside. you won't ever see this, but i somehow wrote all this about you. see what i mean? i barely know you, yet i could write books about you. holly, i love you but i hate you, and maybe one day i will be able to let go of you and all those feelings, and leave it in the past forever. goodbye, -w

i didn’t know how to explain what i was feeling back then. i couldn't even stand the idea of liking another girl, even though deep down, i was head over heels. and of course, that girl had to be you. i hated myself for it. i tried so hard to kill the feelings. started acting like a pick-me, hoping that you’d get the ick. you never did. i doubt that you even noticed.

then came the next plan. i dated a guy in class who confessed to me and accepted him (more out of pity and distraction than anything real). but you know what? you were still there for me, so kind and supportive through the whole short relationship and the stupid breakup rumors, it fucking hurts. and the irony was that being near you while pretending to care about someone else hurt even more.

eventually, i found out about 63. remember him? the guy you sat next to during exams, if i’m not mistaken. you said he drew digitally like me, and i panicked. i tried approaching him too, offering an art trade, hoping i’d find some flaw in him that i could report to you. but i couldn’t even get through a proper conversation with him. he was nice, just awkward. still, it sucked seeing you that excited over someone else.

i remember that school event. the food stalls, the dances, the weird rule about not being allowed in class. you and i sneaked into that dusty bathroom and sat on the floor watching recordings of your crush dancing. you were laughing, happy, and i just sat there feeling this tight knot of jealousy and longing. but even in that moment, i still remember thinking, “this is one of my favorite memories.”

then came the pandemic. we talked all the time again. telegram games, bots, late-night chats. one night, i built up the courage to send you a long appreciation message. you replied the next morning (i think), and you called us soulmates. i immediately froze. platonically or...? we played truth or dare not long after that. the bot asked if your crush was in the group chat. you said, “ummm.” god, i should have asked what you meant, should’ve pressed on that for a bit, but i didn’t. i’ve regretted that ever since.

things got awkward after. we returned to school, and everything was different. you sat with her now. the whole group members were swapped so we weren’t working together for that project. i cried alone in the bathroom when that happened. i carried a group (and their grade) that i didn’t want to carry. and through it all, i missed you more than i could ever say.

before graduation, we took class photos. you sat outside with her. i tried to talk, maybe got ignored, maybe just missed the moment. i left without saying anything, then you texted me when i got home, “where did you go?” and for the first time, i didn’t want to respond. my pride got in the way, but you posted a sad status. i swallowed my ego and replied. you never read it. maybe you blocked me. maybe i didn’t matter to you. but i held onto the hope that there was something, even just a piece of the friendship we had. i changed my phone number and logged out of all my social media accounts shortly after that.

i saw you at graduation with makeup on and bright-colored kebaya, smiling like a whole new version of yourself, waving at me like nothing ever happened. you used to hate makeup. loved dark colors. i wondered if maybe she knew a different side of you that i never got to see. it made me realize that i never really knew how much of you was shared with me and how much was hidden. i pretended the person i was talking to next to me was you, just so i could get through it.

i thought i had moved on now, but i still miss you. not even in a romantic way anymore, just as someone who mattered to me. as a best friend i lost. i don’t even know if you ever saw me the way i saw you. i think i was too busy projecting what i wanted to see. maybe you never liked me like that at all. and that’s okay. i just wish i had told you back then. not for an answer, just to be honest. just to let you know what you meant to me. even now, after all these years, i wish i’d said, “i fucking love you. not just as a friend.”

maybe this is my way of saying it now. even if we never talk again, even if you never read this, even if you forgot everything, i want you to know that you were someone unforgettable to me. and part of me still holds that version of us close, even as i finally start to let it go. please take care of yourself, wherever you are now. i hope high school’s been treating you well, and your dream university would warmly greet you. i truly hope you’re doing well. i hope that you’re happy. really, thank you for everything.

there are some things the universe forgets to explain —
like how two people can meet at 2:23 a.m.,
in a space that isn’t quite real,
and still leave marks on each other’s stars. to start something that never had a name, but meant everything and maybe without touching the same ground.

we didn’t have years.
we didn’t have a city to walk through,
or a night to end in long goodbyes,
but we had enough to make the silence after you unforgettable. and maybe that’s all we ever were–
a quiet phenomenon.

i'm not here to rewrite the story nor to reach for something that isn’t mine.
i write because you deserve to be honored.
this isn’t a confession,
nor an echo of “what if.”
this is simply me,
still keeping the quiet promise
i never said out loud:

i like you — not loudly, but truly.
and that feeling? It asked for nothing.
only that you’d keep shining,
even if the light no longer touched me.

you were never just a chapter.
you were the turning point.
the sentence that changed my language.
the moon that made even my loneliest nights beautiful. the logic i never had, but always admired. and even if I no longer orbit your world,
i still look up sometimes —
not to wish for you back,
but to thank the sky that I met you at all.

and though we walk different skies now,
my eyes still find your constellation.
not out of longing —
but to remember how lucky I was to encounter you at all. i may no longer write vows in metaphor for you,
but you’ll find me
in every unwritten poem that still speaks softly of you.
not out of ache —
but out of peace.

even as we drift into new galaxies,
even if my name fades from your orbit —
i will root for you, always.
In silence, in prayer,
in every unnamed star I trace at night. this isn’t a love letter begging to stay but
it’s a quiet promise–
I’ll still celebrate your rise,
I’ll still be proud from here,
and I’ll still believe in you
on the days you forget to believe in yourself.

you’ll always be the soul of one chapter in my book,
but now, I let the pages turn —
grateful, whole, and quietly loyal.

you don’t owe me anything, don't allow your mind to imprison you for things that will be fine in time.
but if ever the world grows too loud,
and you forget who you are —
i hope my words echo gently in your chest:

you are more than enough.
you are the kind of rare that even fate can’t define.
you are not too much, not anything less.
you are everything, exactly as you are.

and if someday you find an old poem,
and wonder who it was about —
know it was always you.
it’s always been you, Aki.

you were my muse,
but more than that —
you were the reason i wrote with meaning.

so this is me, Yang,
setting down the pen,
not out of sorrow,
but out of reverence.

you’ll always be the spirit of my poetry —
even when I no longer say it out loud.

if ever you feel lost in your own sky,
just look up.
i’ll be there —
not to pull you back,
but to remind you that
you are radiant.
you are loved.
you are seen.

and in the quiet between stars,
you’ll still find me —
i’m still here. just in silence now.

To Joshua Hong,

You may never read this. Maybe these words will disappear like stars at dawn—quiet, unnoticed, and small.
But even if they vanish, I needed to say them. For me.
For the girl who’s carried your name like a prayer in her chest.
I don’t know where to begin, because how do you explain a feeling that’s lived in silence for so long?
I’ve loved you quietly. Not for the fame. Not for the fantasy. But for the moments you probably thought no one noticed.
The way you smile with your eyes when you talk about your mom.
The way your voice softens when you’re comforting the members.
The way you carry your faith, your calmness, your grace—like you’re gently holding the world in your hands.
It wasn’t a moment that made me love you.
It was every moment after.
Every tiny thing you did that felt so deeply human, so quietly kind, so rare.
That’s what stayed with me.
I don’t want to be the dream girl or the fantasy.
I don’t want to be someone screaming your name from behind a screen.
I just wanted—even for one second—to be part of the life you live behind the curtain.
To sit beside you, in stillness.
To hear the sound of you breathing, blinking, being.
To cry on your lap and know that you’d hold me like I matter.
To fall asleep in your car while you hum along to the music, hand resting gently near mine.
To be the person you rest your head on when the world gets too loud.
And I know… I know how impossible it sounds.
There’s distance. Life. Reality.
We’re strangers, in every sense.
But you’re not a stranger to my heart.
You’ve lived here. Softly. Quietly. Lovingly.
Sometimes I ask myself if I’m foolish.
If it’s too much—to want something like this.
To pray so hard that maybe… maybe I could be enough.
And sometimes, the ache of that dream nearly breaks me.
But even in the pain, I never regret loving you.
Because it made me softer. Braver. More alive.
It gave me hope when everything else felt cold.
You were the warmth I ran to, even if you didn’t know.
If I could give you anything, Joshua…
I’d give you peace. The kind that wraps around your heart and never lets go.
I’d give you every good thing. Every joy. Every ounce of love this world holds.
Even if it’s not from me.
Even if I’m just one voice in the dark, whispering your name with tenderness.
And maybe you’ll never know me.
But if by some miracle you’re reading this—
Please know that someone, somewhere,
Loves you not for who you are to the world,
But for who you are when no one’s looking.
You changed my life just by being in it, even from afar.
And I hope, in some quiet way, this love finds you when you need it most.
Thank you for simply existing, Joshua Hong.
That alone has been enough to keep me going.

With all the love I carry,
Judy

I just wanna take this off my chest.  a yearning heart for someone I once wished to spend forever with. Someone I silently hoped would stay, but fate had other plans. Today is my birthday, and part of me still waited… still hoped… for a message because life's will be incomplete. I know I’ve become just a memory, a fleeting person he once knew. But no matter how many seasons pass, I still miss him in ways I can't say out loud.

My heart aches for the warmth I once felt in his presence, for the comfort that used to wrap around me like a quiet kind of safety. I buried this longing deep beneath the soil of promises I made to myself that I’d be fine, that I’d let go, that I’d move forward. And yet, here I am… still glancing back, still wondering if somewhere in the silence, he thinks of me too.

Sometimes, I catch myself tracing the edges of our memories like they’re still real. I wish, with a kind of ache that never really dulls, that there was a lifetime carved out for us somewhere. Maybe in a parallel universe, we got it right. Maybe there, we’re still laughing at the same old jokes, still choosing each other in the small, quiet moments.

But if that lifetime doesn’t exist , not even in dreams, I hope he’s okay. I hope his prayers are being answered. And even if I’m no longer a part of them, I’ll keep wishing the stars are kind to him.

Because even if he no longer holds space for me, I think a part of me will always wait quietly, lovingly, painfully.

silent and passing
through a glowing circle on my screen.

how we went from late-night calls

from the outside in?

watching your WA stories too long,
reading between photos,
trying to guess if you're happy,
if you think of me,
if anything ever reminds you of us.

too vivid to forget,
too distant to return to.
I don’t know if you miss me.
Maybe you don’t.
But there are days I miss us
not because I want to go back,
but because I don’t know how to unlove quietly.
So I stay silent,
watching from far away,
while you continue living a story
I’m no longer written in.
And that’s how I miss you now
like a ghost
haunting your story
without ever being seen
